title: 喧哗与骚动
author: William Faulkner
translation: Google Translate with name glossary and selected corrections; not professionally reviewed

paragraphs.en: Through the fence, between the curling flower spaces, I could see them hitting. They were coming toward where the flag was and I went along the fence. Luster was hunting in the grass by the flower tree. They took the flag out, and they were hitting. Then they put the flag back and they went to the table, and he hit and the other hit. Then they went on, and I went along the fence. Luster came away from the flower tree and we went along the fence and they stopped and we stopped and I looked through the fence while Luster was hunting in the grass.
paragraphs.zh: 透过栅栏，在卷曲的花枝空隙之间，我看得见他们打球。他们朝插着旗子的地方走来，我沿着栅栏走。勒斯特在花树旁的草里找东西。他们拔出旗子，打起球来。随后又把旗子插回去，走到台子那里，他打了一下，另一个也打了一下。然后他们往前走，我沿着栅栏走。勒斯特离开花树，我们沿着栅栏走，他们停下来，我们也停下来，勒斯特在草里找东西的时候，我透过栅栏看着。

paragraphs.en: “Here, caddie.” He hit. They went away across the pasture. I held to the fence and watched them going away.
paragraphs.zh: “这儿，球童。”他打了一下。他们穿过牧场走远了。我扶着栅栏，看着他们走远。

paragraphs.en: “Listen at you, now.” Luster said. “Aint you something, thirty-three years old, going on that way. After I done went all the way to town to buy you that cake. Hush up that moaning. Aint you going to help me find that quarter so I can go to the show tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “听听你，又来了。”勒斯特说。“你可真行，三十三岁了，还这个样子。我大老远跑到镇上给你买了那块蛋糕，你却这样。别再哼哼了。你不帮我找那枚二十五美分硬币，让我今晚能去看戏吗。”

paragraphs.en: They were hitting little, across the pasture. I went back along the fence to where the flag was. It flapped on the bright grass and the trees.
paragraphs.zh: 隔着牧场，他们打球的身影小小的。我沿栅栏走回插旗子的地方。旗子在明亮的草地和树木前飘动。

paragraphs.en: “Come on.” Luster said. “We done looked there. They aint no more coming right now. Lets go down to the branch and find that quarter before them niggers finds it.”
paragraphs.zh: “走吧。”勒斯特说。“那儿我们找过了。眼下不会再有人过来了。咱们到溪沟那边去，在那些黑鬼找到之前找到那枚二十五美分硬币。”

paragraphs.en: It was red, flapping on the pasture. Then there was a bird slanting and tilting on it. Luster threw. The flag flapped on the bright grass and the trees. I held to the fence.
paragraphs.zh: 旗子是红的，在牧场上飘着。随后一只鸟斜斜地飞来，在旗子上摇晃。勒斯特扔了个东西。旗子在明亮的草地和树木前飘着。我扶着栅栏。

paragraphs.en: “Shut up that moaning,” Luster said. “I cant make them come if they aint coming, can I. If you dont hush up, mammy aint going to have no birthday for you. If you dont hush, you know what I going to do. I going to eat that cake all up. Eat them candles, too. Eat all them thirty-three candles. Come on, let’s go down to the branch. I got to find my quarter. Maybe we can find one of they balls. Here. Here they is. Way over yonder. See.” He came to the fence and pointed his arm. “See them. They aint coming back here no more. Come on.”
paragraphs.zh: “别哼哼了，”勒斯特说。“他们不来，我还能把他们弄来不成。你再不安静，妈妈就不给你过生日了。你再不安静，知道我要干什么吗。我要把那块蛋糕全吃掉。连蜡烛也吃掉。三十三根蜡烛统统吃掉。来吧，咱们到溪沟那边去。我得找到我的二十五美分。说不定还能捡到他们的一个球。那儿。他们在那儿。老远那边。瞧。”他走到栅栏前，伸出胳膊指着。“瞧他们。他们不会再到这儿来了。走吧。”

paragraphs.en: We went along the fence and came to the garden fence, where our shadows were. My shadow was higher than Luster’s on the fence. We came to the broken place and went through it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着栅栏走，走到花园的栅栏旁，我们的影子在那里。我在栅栏上的影子比勒斯特的高。我们走到破了的地方，钻了过去。

paragraphs.en: “Wait a minute.” Luster said. “You snagged on that nail again. Cant you never crawl through here without snagging on that nail.”
paragraphs.zh: “等一下。”勒斯特说。“你又被那颗钉子挂住了。你就不能有一回钻过去不叫那颗钉子挂住吗。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy uncaught me and we crawled through. Uncle Maury said to not let anybody see us, so we better stoop over, Caddy said. Stoop over, Benjy. Like this, see. We stooped over and crossed the garden, where the flowers rasped and rattled against us. The ground was hard. We climbed the fence, where the pigs were grunting and snuffing. I expect they’re sorry because one of them got killed today, Caddy said. The ground was hard, churned and knotted.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂替我解开挂住的衣服，我们爬了过去。莫里舅舅说别让人看见咱们，所以咱们最好弯下腰，凯蒂说。弯下腰，班吉。像这样，瞧。我们弯着腰穿过花园，花枝擦着我们沙沙作响。地很硬。我们爬上栅栏，猪在那儿哼哼着，呼噜着。我想它们很难过，因为今天有一头被杀了，凯蒂说。地很硬，翻得疙疙瘩瘩。

paragraphs.en: Keep your hands in your pockets, Caddy said. Or they’ll get froze. You don’t want your hands froze on Christmas, do you.
paragraphs.zh: 把手放进口袋，凯蒂说。不然会冻坏的。你不想大圣诞节的把手冻坏吧。

paragraphs.en: “It’s too cold out there.” Versh said. “You dont want to go out doors.”
paragraphs.zh: “外头太冷了。”弗许说。“你不会想出去的。”

paragraphs.en: “What is it now.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “这会儿又怎么了。”母亲说。

paragraphs.en: “He want to go out doors.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “他想出去。”弗许说。

paragraphs.en: “Let him go.” Uncle Maury said.
paragraphs.zh: “让他出去吧。”莫里舅舅说。

paragraphs.en: “It’s too cold.” Mother said. “He’d better stay in. Benjamin. Stop that, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “太冷了。”母亲说。“他最好待在屋里。本杰明。现在别闹了。”

paragraphs.en: “It wont hurt him.” Uncle Maury said.
paragraphs.zh: “冻不坏他的。”莫里舅舅说。

paragraphs.en: “You, Benjamin.” Mother said. “If you dont be good, you’ll have to go to the kitchen.”
paragraphs.zh: “你，本杰明。”妈妈说。“如果你不乖，你就得去厨房了。”

paragraphs.en: “Mammy say keep him out the kitchen today.” Versh said. “She say she got all that cooking to get done.”
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈说今天别让他进厨房。”弗许说道。“她说她要把所有的饭菜都做完。”

paragraphs.en: “Let him go, Caroline.” Uncle Maury said. “You’ll worry yourself sick over him.”
paragraphs.zh: “放开他，卡罗琳。”莫里舅舅说道。“你会为他担心得要命。”

paragraphs.en: “I know it.” Mother said. “It’s a judgment on me. I sometimes wonder”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道。”妈妈说。“这是对我的判断。我有时会想”

paragraphs.en: “I know, I know.” Uncle Maury said. “You must keep your strength up. I’ll make you a toddy.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道，我知道。”莫里舅舅说道。“你一定要保持体力。我给你做一杯棕榈酒。”

paragraphs.en: “It just upsets me that much more.” Mother said. “Dont you know it does.”
paragraphs.zh: “这让我更难过。”妈妈说。“你难道不知道吗？”

paragraphs.en: “You’ll feel better.” Uncle Maury said. “Wrap him up good, boy, and take him out for a while.”
paragraphs.zh: “你会感觉好一些。”莫里舅舅说道。“小伙子，把他包裹好，带他出去一会儿。”

paragraphs.en: Uncle Maury went away. Versh went away.
paragraphs.zh: 莫里舅舅走了。弗许走了。

paragraphs.en: “Please hush.” Mother said. “We’re trying to get you out as fast as we can. I dont want you to get sick.”
paragraphs.zh: “请安静。”妈妈说。“我们正在尽快让你离开。我不想让你生病。”

paragraphs.en: Versh put my overshoes and overcoat on and we took my cap and went out. Uncle Maury was putting the bottle away in the sideboard in the dining-room.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许给我穿上套鞋和大衣，我们拿上帽子就出去了。莫里舅舅正在把瓶子收进餐厅的餐具柜里。

paragraphs.en: “Keep him out about half an hour, boy.” Uncle Maury said. “Keep him in the yard, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “让他出去大约半个小时，孩子。”莫里舅舅说道。“现在把他留在院子里。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, sir.” Versh said. “We dont never let him get off the place.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生。”弗许说道。“我们永远不会让他离开这个地方。”

paragraphs.en: We went out doors. The sun was cold and bright.
paragraphs.zh: 我们出了门。阳光寒冷而明亮。

paragraphs.en: “Where you heading for.” Versh said. “You dont think you going to town, does you.” We went through the rattling leaves. The gate was cold. “You better keep them hands in your pockets.” Versh said, “You get them froze onto that gate, then what you do. Whyn’t you wait for them in the house.” He put my hands into my pockets. I could hear him rattling in the leaves. I could smell the cold. The gate was cold.
paragraphs.zh: “你要去哪里。”弗许说道。“你不会以为你要去城里吧。”我们穿过嘎嘎作响的树叶。门口很冷。“你最好把手插在口袋里。”弗许说：“你把他们冻到那扇门上，然后怎么办。不如你在屋子里等他们。”他把我的手放进口袋里。我能听到他在树叶上嘎嘎作响。我能闻到寒冷的味道。门口很冷。

paragraphs.en: “Here some hickeynuts. Whooey. Git up that tree. Look here at this squirl, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “这里有一些坚果。哇哦。把那棵树吊起来。看看这只松鼠，班吉。”

paragraphs.en: I couldn’t feel the gate at all, but I could smell the bright cold.
paragraphs.zh: 我根本感觉不到大门，但我能闻到刺鼻的寒冷。

paragraphs.en: “You better put them hands back in your pockets.”
paragraphs.zh: “你最好把他们的手放回口袋里。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy was walking. Then she was running, her book-satchel swinging and jouncing behind her.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂正在走路。然后她跑了起来，她的书包在她身后晃来晃去。

paragraphs.en: “Hello, Benjy.” Caddy said. She opened the gate and came in and stooped down. Caddy smelled like leaves. “Did you come to meet me.” she said. “Did you come to meet Caddy. What did you let him get his hands so cold for, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “你好，班吉。”凯蒂说。她打开门进来，弯下腰。凯蒂闻起来像树叶。“你是来接我的吗？”她说。“你是来见凯蒂的吗。弗许，你让他的手这么冷干什么。”

paragraphs.en: “I told him to keep them in his pockets.” Versh said. “Holding onto that ahun gate.”
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉他把它们放在口袋里。”弗许说道。“守住那扇阿洪门。”

paragraphs.en: “Did you come to meet Caddy.” she said, rubbing my hands. “What is it. What are you trying to tell Caddy.” Caddy smelled like trees and like when she says we were asleep.
paragraphs.zh: “你是来见凯蒂的吗？”她一边说，一边揉着我的手。“这是什么。你想告诉凯蒂什么。”凯蒂闻起来像树的味道，就像她说我们睡着了一样。

paragraphs.en: What are you moaning about, Luster said. You can watch them again when we get to the branch. Here. Here’s you a jimson weed. He gave me the flower. We went through the fence, into the lot.
paragraphs.zh: 你哼哼什么呀，勒斯特说。到了溪沟那里你又能看见他们了。给。这儿有朵曼陀罗花。他把花给了我。我们穿过栅栏，进到地里。

paragraphs.en: “What is it.” Caddy said. “What are you trying to tell Caddy. Did they send him out, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “那是什么。”凯蒂说。“你想告诉凯蒂什么？他们把他送出去了吗，弗许。”

paragraphs.en: “Couldn’t keep him in.” Versh said. “He kept on until they let him go and he come right straight down here, looking through the gate.”
paragraphs.zh: “不能留他在里面。”弗许说道。“他一直坚持下去，直到他们放他走，然后他径直来到这里，透过大门往外看。”

paragraphs.en: “What is it.” Caddy said. “Did you think it would be Christmas when I came home from school. Is that what you thought. Christmas is the day after tomorrow. Santy Claus, Benjy. Santy Claus. Come on, let’s run to the house and get warm.” She took my hand and we ran through the bright rustling leaves. We ran up the steps and out of the bright cold, into the dark cold. Uncle Maury was putting the bottle back in the sideboard. He called Caddy. Caddy said,
paragraphs.zh: “那是什么。”凯蒂说。“你以为我放学回家的时候就是圣诞节吗？你是这么想的吗？后天就是圣诞节。圣诞老人，班吉。圣诞老人。来吧，我们跑到家里取暖吧。”她拉着我的手，我们跑过明亮、沙沙作响的树叶。我们跑上台阶，走出明亮的寒冷，进入黑暗的寒冷。莫里舅舅正把瓶子放回餐具柜里。他打电话给凯蒂。凯蒂说，

paragraphs.en: “Take him in to the fire, Versh. Go with Versh.” she said. “I’ll come in a minute.”
paragraphs.zh: “把他带进火里，弗许。和弗许一起去。”她说。“我一会儿就来。”

paragraphs.en: We went to the fire. Mother said,
paragraphs.zh: 我们去了火场。妈妈说，

paragraphs.en: “Is he cold, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “弗许，他冷吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Nome.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “诺姆。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “Take his overcoat and overshoes off.” Mother said. “How many times do I have to tell you not to bring him into the house with his overshoes on.”
paragraphs.zh: “把他的大衣和套鞋脱掉。”妈妈说。“我跟你说了多少次了，不要把他穿着套鞋带进屋。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Versh said. “Hold still, now.” He took my overshoes off and unbuttoned my coat. Caddy said,
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”弗许说道。“别动，现在。”他脱掉我的套鞋，解开我外套的扣子。凯蒂说，

paragraphs.en: “Wait, Versh. Cant he go out again, Mother. I want him to go with me.”
paragraphs.zh: “等等，弗许。他不能再出去吗，妈妈。我想让他跟我一起去。”

paragraphs.en: “You’d better leave him here.” Uncle Maury said. “He’s been out enough today.”
paragraphs.zh: “你最好把他留在这里。”莫里舅舅说道。“他今天已经出去够了。”

paragraphs.en: “I think you’d both better stay in.” Mother said. “It’s getting colder, Dilsey says.”
paragraphs.zh: “我认为你们最好都留在家里。”妈妈说。“天气越来越冷了，迪尔西说。”

paragraphs.en: “Oh, Mother.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “哦，妈妈。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Nonsense.” Uncle Maury said. “She’s been in school all day. She needs the fresh air. Run along, Candace.”
paragraphs.zh: “废话。”莫里舅舅说道。“她一整天都在学校。她需要新鲜空气。跑吧，坎迪斯。”

paragraphs.en: “Let him go, Mother.” Caddy said. “Please. You know he’ll cry.”
paragraphs.zh: “放开他吧，妈妈。”凯蒂说。“求你了。你知道他会哭的。”

paragraphs.en: “Then why did you mention it before him.” Mother said. “Why did you come in here. To give him some excuse to worry me again. You’ve been out enough today. I think you’d better sit down here and play with him.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你为什么要在他面前提起这件事。”妈妈说。“你为什么来这里。给他一个借口让我又担心了。你今天已经出去够了。我想你最好坐下来陪他玩。”

paragraphs.en: “Let them go, Caroline.” Uncle Maury said. “A little cold wont hurt them. Remember, you’ve got to keep your strength up.”
paragraphs.zh: “放了他们吧，卡罗琳。”莫里舅舅说道。“一点冷不会伤害他们。记住，你必须保持体力。”

paragraphs.en: “I know.” Mother said. “Nobody knows how I dread Christmas. Nobody knows. I am not one of those women who can stand things. I wish for Jason’s and the children’s sakes I was stronger.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道。”妈妈说。“没有人知道我有多害怕圣诞节。没有人知道。我不是那种能忍受一切的女人。我希望为了杰生和孩子们，我能变得更坚强。”

paragraphs.en: “You must do the best you can and not let them worry you.” Uncle Maury said. “Run along, you two. But dont stay out long, now. Your mother will worry.”
paragraphs.zh: “你必须尽力而为，不要让他们担心你。”莫里舅舅说道。“你们两个快跑吧。不过现在别在外面呆太久。你妈妈会担心的。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, sir.” Caddy said. “Come on, Benjy. We’re going out doors again.” She buttoned my coat and we went toward the door.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生。”凯蒂说。“走吧，班吉。我们又要出去了。”她扣好我的外套扣子，我们朝门口走去。

paragraphs.en: “Are you going to take that baby out without his overshoes.” Mother said. “Do you want to make him sick, with the house full of company.”
paragraphs.zh: “你要把那个孩子不穿鞋套带出去吗？”妈妈说。“你想让他生病吗？家里挤满了人。”

paragraphs.en: “I forgot.” Caddy said. “I thought he had them on.”
paragraphs.zh: “我忘了。”凯蒂说。“我以为他戴着它们。”

paragraphs.en: We went back. “You must think.” Mother said. Hold still now Versh said. He put my overshoes on. “Someday I’ll be gone, and you’ll have to think for him.” Now stomp Versh said. “Come here and kiss Mother, Benjamin.”
paragraphs.zh: 我们回去了。“你必须想一想。”妈妈说。弗许说道。他给我穿上鞋。“总有一天我会离开，你就得为他着想。”弗许现在跺脚说道。“本杰明，过来亲亲妈妈。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy took me to Mother’s chair and Mother took my face in her hands and then she held me against her.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂把我带到母亲的椅子上，母亲用手捧住我的脸，然后把我抱在她身上。

paragraphs.en: “My poor baby.” she said. She let me go. “You and Versh take good care of him, honey.”
paragraphs.zh: “我可怜的宝贝。”她说。她让我走了。“你和弗许好好照顾他，亲爱的。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Caddy said. We went out. Caddy said,
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”凯蒂说。我们出去了。凯蒂说，

paragraphs.en: “You needn’t go, Versh. I’ll keep him for a while.”
paragraphs.zh: “你不用走，弗许。我会留他一段时间。”

paragraphs.en: “All right.” Versh said. “I aint going out in that cold for no fun.” He went on and we stopped in the hall and Caddy knelt and put her arms around me and her cold bright face against mine. She smelled like trees.
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”弗许说道。“那么冷，我不会出去玩。”他继续往前走，我们在大厅停下来，凯蒂跪下来，用双臂搂住我，用她冰冷而明亮的脸贴着我的脸。她闻起来像树。

paragraphs.en: “You’re not a poor baby. Are you. You’ve got your Caddy. Haven’t you got your Caddy.”
paragraphs.zh: “你不是一个可怜的孩子。是吗。你有你的凯蒂。你没有得到你的凯蒂吗。”

paragraphs.en: Cant you shut up that moaning and slobbering, Luster said. Aint you shamed of yourself, making all this racket. We passed the carriage house, where the carriage was. It had a new wheel.
paragraphs.zh: 你就不能闭嘴吗？勒斯特说。你发出这样的喧闹，不是让自己感到羞耻吗？我们经过了马车房，马车就在那里。它有一个新轮子。

paragraphs.en: “Git in, now, and set still until your maw come.” Dilsey said. She shoved me into the carriage. T. P. held the reins. “’Clare I don’t see how come Jason wont get a new surrey.” Dilsey said. “This thing going to fall to pieces under you all some day. Look at them wheels.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在就进去，别动，直到你的肚子出来。”迪尔西说道。她把我推进了马车。蒂·皮掌握着缰绳。“克莱尔，我不明白杰生为什么不买新的萨里。”迪尔西说道。“总有一天，这东西会在你脚下摔成碎片。看看它们的轮子。”

paragraphs.en: Mother came out, pulling her veil down. She had some flowers.
paragraphs.zh: 妈妈走了出来，拉下了面纱。她有一些花。

paragraphs.en: “Where’s Roskus.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “罗斯库斯在哪儿？”她说。

paragraphs.en: “Roskus cant lift his arms, today.” Dilsey said. “T. P. can drive all right.”
paragraphs.zh: “罗斯库斯今天手臂抬不起来。”迪尔西说道。“蒂·皮可以开车。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m afraid to.” Mother said. “It seems to me you all could furnish me with a driver for the carriage once a week. It’s little enough I ask, Lord knows.”
paragraphs.zh: “我害怕。”妈妈说。“在我看来，你们每个人都可以为我提供一名马车司机，每周一次。我要求的还不够，上帝知道。”

paragraphs.en: “You know just as well as me that Roskus got the rheumatism too bad to do more than he have to, Miss Cahline.” Dilsey said. “You come on and get in, now. T. P. can drive you just as good as Roskus.”
paragraphs.zh: “你和我一样清楚，罗斯库斯得了严重的风湿病，无法做他必须做的事情，卡林小姐。”迪尔西说道。“现在，你上车吧。蒂·皮可以像罗斯库斯一样开着你。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m afraid to.” Mother said. “With the baby.”
paragraphs.zh: “我害怕。”妈妈说。“带着孩子。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey went up the steps. “You calling that thing a baby,” she said. She took Mother’s arms. “A man big as T. P. Come on, now, if you going.”
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西走上台阶。“你管那个东西叫婴儿，”她说。她挽着母亲的手臂。“一个像蒂·皮一样大的男人，来吧，现在，如果你要去的话。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m afraid to.” Mother said. They came down the steps and Dilsey helped Mother in. “Perhaps it’ll be the best thing, for all of us.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “我害怕。”妈妈说。他们走下台阶，迪尔西扶着母亲进来。“也许这对我们所有人来说都是最好的事情。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you shamed, talking that way.” Dilsey said. “Dont you know it’ll take more than a eighteen year old nigger to make Queenie run away. She older than him and Benjy put together. And dont you start no projecking with Queenie, you hear me, T. P. If you dont drive to suit Miss Cahline, I going to put Roskus on you. He aint too tied up to do that.”
paragraphs.zh: “你这样说话，不觉得羞耻吗？”迪尔西说道。“你难道不知道需要一个超过十八岁的黑鬼才能让奎妮逃跑吗？她比他和班吉加起来还要大。你别开始和奎妮开玩笑，你听我说，蒂·皮如果你不开车去迎合卡琳小姐，我会把罗斯库斯放在你身上。他不会太束缚而做不到。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “I just know something will happen.” Mother said. “Stop, Benjamin.”
paragraphs.zh: “我只知道会发生一些事情。”妈妈说。“住手，本杰明。”

paragraphs.en: “Give him a flower to hold.” Dilsey said, “That what he wanting.” She reached her hand in.
paragraphs.zh: “给他一朵花让他拿着。”迪尔西说：“这就是他想要的。”她把手伸了进去。

paragraphs.en: “No, no.” Mother said. “You’ll have them all scattered.”
paragraphs.zh: “不，不。”妈妈说。“你会把他们都分散的。”

paragraphs.en: “You hold them.” Dilsey said. “I’ll get him one out.” She gave me a flower and her hand went away.
paragraphs.zh: “你拿着它们。”迪尔西说道。“我去给他拿一个出来。”她给了我一朵花，然后她的手就放开了。

paragraphs.en: “Go on now, ’fore Quentin see you and have to go too.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “快走吧，不然昆丁见到你也得走了。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “Where is she.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “她在哪儿。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “She down to the house playing with Luster.” Dilsey said. “Go on, T. P. Drive that surrey like Roskus told you, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “她到家里和勒斯特一起玩。”迪尔西说道。“继续吧，蒂·皮驾驶萨里，就像罗斯库斯告诉你的那样，现在。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” T. P. said. “Hum up, Queenie.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”蒂·皮说。“哼，奎妮。”

paragraphs.en: “Quentin.” Mother said. “Don’t let”
paragraphs.zh: “昆丁。”妈妈说。“不让”

paragraphs.en: “Course I is.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “我当然是。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: The carriage jolted and crunched on the drive. “I’m afraid to go and leave Quentin.” Mother said. “I’d better not go. T. P.” We went through the gate, where it didn’t jolt anymore. T. P. hit Queenie with the whip.
paragraphs.zh: 马车在车道上颠簸、嘎吱作响。“我不敢离开昆丁。”妈妈说。“我最好别走。蒂·皮”我们穿过大门，大门不再摇晃了。蒂·皮用鞭子打奎妮。

paragraphs.en: “You, T. P.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “你，蒂·皮”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Got to get her going.” T. P. said. “Keep her wake up till we get back to the barn.”
paragraphs.zh: “必须让她走。”蒂·皮说。“让她保持清醒，直到我们回到谷仓。”

paragraphs.en: “Turn around.” Mother said. “I’m afraid to go and leave Quentin.”
paragraphs.zh: “转身。”妈妈说。“我不敢离开昆丁。”

paragraphs.en: “Cant turn here.” T. P. said. Then it was broader.
paragraphs.zh: “这里不能转弯。”蒂·皮说。然后范围就更广了。

paragraphs.en: “Cant you turn here.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “你不能转到这里吗？”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “All right.” T. P. said. We began to turn.
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”蒂·皮说。我们开始转身。

paragraphs.en: “You, T. P.” Mother said, clutching me.
paragraphs.zh: “你，蒂·皮，”母亲抓着我说道。

paragraphs.en: “I got to turn around somehow.” T. P. said. “Whoa, Queenie.” We stopped.
paragraphs.zh: “我必须以某种方式转身。”蒂·皮说。“哇哦，奎妮。”我们停了下来。

paragraphs.en: “You’ll turn us over.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “你会让我们翻身的。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “What you want to do, then.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “那你想做什么就做什么吧。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “I’m afraid for you to try to turn around.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “我担心你会试图转身。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Get up, Queenie.” T. P. said. We went on.
paragraphs.zh: “起来吧，奎妮。”蒂·皮说。我们继续前行。

paragraphs.en: “I just know Dilsey will let something happen to Quentin while I’m gone.” Mother said. “We must hurry back.”
paragraphs.zh: “我只知道我不在的时候迪尔西会让昆丁出事。”妈妈说。“我们得赶紧回去。”

paragraphs.en: “Hum up, there.” T. P. said. He hit Queenie with the whip.
paragraphs.zh: “哼，就在那里。”蒂·皮说。他用鞭子打奎妮。

paragraphs.en: “You, T. P.” Mother said, clutching me. I could hear Queenie’s feet and the bright shapes went smooth and steady on both sides, the shadows of them flowing across Queenie’s back. They went on like the bright tops of wheels. Then those on one side stopped at the tall white post where the soldier was. But on the other side they went on smooth and steady, but a little slower.
paragraphs.zh: “你，蒂·皮，”母亲抓着我说道。我能听到奎妮的脚步声，两侧明亮的形状平滑而稳定，它们的影子在奎妮的背上流过。它们像明亮的轮子顶部一样继续前进。然后一侧的人停在士兵所在的白色高柱前。但另一边，他们走得平稳，只是慢了一点。

paragraphs.en: “What do you want.” Jason said. He had his hands in his pockets and a pencil behind his ear.
paragraphs.zh: “你想要什么。”杰生说道。他双手插在口袋里，耳后挂着一支铅笔。

paragraphs.en: “We’re going to the cemetery.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “我们要去墓地。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “All right.” Jason said. “I dont aim to stop you, do I. Was that all you wanted with me, just to tell me that.”
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”杰生说道。“我的目​​的不是阻止你，是吗？你只是想告诉我这件事，这就是你想要的吗？”

paragraphs.en: “I know you wont come.” Mother said. “I’d feel safer if you would.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道你不会来。”妈妈说。“如果你愿意的话，我会觉得更安全。”

paragraphs.en: “Safe from what.” Jason said. “Father and Quentin cant hurt you.”
paragraphs.zh: “免受什么伤害。”杰生说道。“父亲和昆丁伤不了你。”

paragraphs.en: Mother put her handkerchief under her veil. “Stop it, Mother.” Jason said. “Do you want to get that damn loony to bawling in the middle of the square. Drive on, T. P.”
paragraphs.zh: 母亲把手帕放在面纱下面。“别这样了，妈妈。”杰生说道。“你想让那个该死的疯子在广场中央大哭吗？继续前进，蒂·皮”

paragraphs.en: “Hum up, Queenie.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “哼，奎妮。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “It’s a judgment on me.” Mother said. “But I’ll be gone too, soon.”
paragraphs.zh: “这是对我的审判。”妈妈说。“但我也会离开，很快。”

paragraphs.en: “Here.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “这里。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “Whoa.” T. P. said. Jason said,
paragraphs.zh: “哇哦。”蒂·皮说。杰生说，

paragraphs.en: “Uncle Maury’s drawing on you for fifty. What do you want to do about it.”
paragraphs.zh: “莫里舅舅向你抽了五十，你想怎么办。”

paragraphs.en: “Why ask me.” Mother said. “I dont have any say so. I try not to worry you and Dilsey. I’ll be gone soon, and then you”
paragraphs.zh: “为什么问我。”妈妈说。“我没有什么可说的。我尽量不让你和迪尔西担心。我很快就会走，然后你”

paragraphs.en: “Go on, T. P.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “继续吧，蒂·皮”杰生说。

paragraphs.en: “Hum up, Queenie.” T. P. said. The shapes flowed on. The ones on the other side began again, bright and fast and smooth, like when Caddy says we are going to sleep.
paragraphs.zh: “哼，奎妮。”蒂·皮说。形状继续流动。另一边的声音又开始了，明亮、快速、平稳，就像凯蒂说我们要睡觉的时候一样。

paragraphs.en: Cry baby, Luster said. Aint you shamed. We went through the barn. The stalls were all open. You aint got no spotted pony to ride now, Luster said. The floor was dry and dusty. The roof was falling. The slanting holes were full of spinning yellow. What do you want to go that way for. You want to get your head knocked off with one of them balls.
paragraphs.zh: 哭吧宝贝，勒斯特说。你不感到羞耻吗？我们穿过谷仓。摊位都开着。“你现在没有斑点小马可以骑了，”勒斯特说。地板干燥且布满灰尘。屋顶正在塌陷。倾斜的洞里充满了旋转的黄色。你要走那条路干什么。你想用其中一颗球打掉你的头。

paragraphs.en: “Keep your hands in your pockets.” Caddy said, “Or they’ll be froze. You dont want your hands froze on Christmas, do you.”
paragraphs.zh: “把手插在口袋里。”凯蒂说：“否则它们会被冻住。你不想让你的手在圣诞节被冻住吧。”

paragraphs.en: We went around the barn. The big cow and the little one were standing in the door, and we could hear Prince and Queenie and Fancy stomping inside the barn. “If it wasn’t so cold, we’d ride Fancy.” Caddy said, “But it’s too cold to hold on today.” Then we could see the branch, where the smoke was blowing. “That’s where they are killing the pig.” Caddy said. “We can come back by there and see them.” We went down the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 我们绕着谷仓走了一圈。大牛和小牛站在门口，我们可以听到普林斯、奎妮和芬西在谷仓里跺脚的声音。“如果不是那么冷，我们会骑 Fancy。”凯蒂说：“但是今天太冷了，坚持不了。”然后我们就看到了溪沟，那里正冒着烟。“这就是他们杀猪的地方。”凯蒂说。“我们可以回来看看他们。”我们下了山。

paragraphs.en: “You want to carry the letter.” Caddy said. “You can carry it.” She took the letter out of her pocket and put it in mine. “It’s a Christmas present.” Caddy said. “Uncle Maury is going to surprise Mrs Patterson with it. We got to give it to her without letting anybody see it. Keep your hands in your pockets good, now.” We came to the branch.
paragraphs.zh: “你想带着这封信。”凯蒂说。“你可以带着它。”她从口袋里拿出信，放进我的口袋里。“这是一份圣诞礼物。”凯蒂说。“莫里舅舅要用它给帕特森夫人一个惊喜。我们必须把它交给她，不要让任何人看到。现在，把手插在口袋里。”我们来到了溪沟。

paragraphs.en: “It’s froze.” Caddy said, “Look.” She broke the top of the water and held a piece of it against my face. “Ice. That means how cold it is.” She helped me across and we went up the hill. “We cant even tell Mother and Father. You know what I think it is. I think it’s a surprise for Mother and Father and Mr Patterson both, because Mr Patterson sent you some candy. Do you remember when Mr Patterson sent you some candy last summer.”
paragraphs.zh: “它冻住了。”凯蒂说：“看。”她把水面打碎，拿一块放在我脸上。“冰。这意味着天气有多冷。”她扶我过去，我们就上了山。“我们甚至不能告诉妈妈和爸爸。你知道我是怎么想的。我想这对妈妈、爸爸和帕特森先生来说都是一个惊喜，因为帕特森先生给你送了一些糖果。你还记得去年夏天帕特森先生给你送了一些糖果吗？”

paragraphs.en: There was a fence. The vine was dry, and the wind rattled in it.
paragraphs.zh: 有栅栏。藤蔓干枯了，风在里面嘎嘎作响。

paragraphs.en: “Only I dont see why Uncle Maury didn’t send Versh.” Caddy said. “Versh wont tell.” Mrs Patterson was looking out the window. “You wait here.” Caddy said. “Wait right here, now. I’ll be back in a minute. Give me the letter.” She took the letter out of my pocket. “Keep your hands in your pockets.” She climbed the fence with the letter in her hand and went through the brown, rattling flowers. Mrs Patterson came to the door and opened it and stood there.
paragraphs.zh: “只是我不明白莫里舅舅为什么不派弗许来。”凯蒂说。“弗许不肯说。”帕特森夫人正看着窗外。“你在这里等着。”凯蒂说。“现在就在这里等一下。我一会儿就回来。把信给我。”她从我的口袋里拿出那封信。“把手插在口袋里。”她手里拿着信爬上栅栏，穿过那些嘎嘎作响的棕色花朵。帕特森夫人来到门口，打开门并站在那里。

paragraphs.en: Mr Patterson was chopping in the green flowers. He stopped chopping and looked at me. Mrs Patterson came across the garden, running. When I saw her eyes I began to cry. You idiot, Mrs Patterson said, I told him never to send you alone again. Give it to me. Quick. Mr Patterson came fast, with the hoe. Mrs Patterson leaned across the fence, reaching her hand. She was trying to climb the fence. Give it to me, she said, Give it to me. Mr Patterson climbed the fence. He took the letter. Mrs Patterson’s dress was caught on the fence. I saw her eyes again and I ran down the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 帕特森先生正在砍绿色的花朵。他停止砍刀，看着我。帕特森夫人跑过花园。当我看到她的眼睛时，我开始哭泣。你这个白痴，帕特森夫人说，我告诉过他不要再单独送你了。把它给我。快的。帕特森先生拿着锄头很快就来了。帕特森夫人探过栅栏，伸手。她正试图翻过栅栏。把它给我，她说，把它给我。帕特森先生爬上了栅栏。他接过信。帕特森夫人的裙子挂在栅栏上。我再次看到她的眼睛，然后我跑下了山。

paragraphs.en: “They aint nothing over yonder but houses.” Luster said. “We going down to the branch.”
paragraphs.zh: “那边除了房子什么都没有。”勒斯特说。“我们去溪沟吧。”

paragraphs.en: They were washing down at the branch. One of them was singing. I could smell the clothes flapping, and the smoke blowing across the branch.
paragraphs.zh: 他们正在溪沟洗澡。其中一人正在唱歌。我能闻到衣服飘动的味道，还有溪沟上飘过的烟雾的味道。

paragraphs.en: “You stay down here.” Luster said. “You aint got no business up yonder. Them folks hit you, sho.”
paragraphs.zh: “你就留在这里吧。”勒斯特说。“你在那边没啥事。他们打你了，嘘。”

paragraphs.en: “What he want to do.”
paragraphs.zh: “他想做什么。”

paragraphs.en: “He dont know what he want to do.” Luster said. “He think he want to go up yonder where they knocking that ball. You sit down here and play with your jimson weed. Look at them chillen playing in the branch, if you got to look at something. How come you cant behave yourself like folks.” I sat down on the bank, where they were washing, and the smoke blowing blue.
paragraphs.zh: “他不知道自己想做什么。”勒斯特说。“他认为他想去他们敲球的地方。你坐在这里玩你的曼森草。如果你想看点什么，看看他们在溪沟上玩耍。你为什么不能表现得像个普通人呢。”我坐在岸边，他们正在那里洗衣服，蓝色的烟雾在飘扬。

paragraphs.en: “Is you all seen anything of a quarter down here.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “你们都在这里看到过二十五美分硬币的东西吗？”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “What quarter.”
paragraphs.zh: “什么二十五美分硬币。”

paragraphs.en: “The one I had here this morning.” Luster said. “I lost it somewhere. It fell through this here hole in my pocket. If I dont find it I cant go to the show tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “就是我今天早上在这里吃的那个。”勒斯特说。“我把它丢在什么地方了。它从我口袋里的这个洞掉下来了。如果我找不到它，我今晚就不能去看演出了。”

paragraphs.en: “Where’d you get a quarter, boy. Find it in white folks’ pocket while they aint looking.”
paragraphs.zh: “你从哪里弄来的硬币，孩子。趁白人不注意的时候在他们的口袋里找到它。”

paragraphs.en: “Got it at the getting place.” Luster said. “Plenty more where that one come from. Only I got to find that one. Is you all found it yet.”
paragraphs.zh: “在取货地点拿到了。”勒斯特说。“还有很多这个东西是从哪里来的。只有我找到了那个。你们都找到了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “I aint studying no quarter. I got my own business to tend to.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有一刻学习。我有自己的事要处理。”

paragraphs.en: “Come on here.” Luster said. “Help me look for it.”
paragraphs.zh: “到这里来吧。”勒斯特说。“帮我找找。”

paragraphs.en: “He wouldn’t know a quarter if he was to see it, would he.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果他看到了，他连二十五美分硬币都不会知道，不是吗？”

paragraphs.en: “He can help look just the same.” Luster said. “You all going to the show tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “他可以帮助看起来一模一样。”勒斯特说。“今晚你们都去看演出。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont talk to me about no show. Time I get done over this here tub I be too tired to lift my hand to do nothing.”
paragraphs.zh: “别跟我说缺席的事。等我洗完这里的浴缸后，我已经累得抬不起手了，什么也不做。”

paragraphs.en: “I bet you be there.” Luster said. “I bet you was there last night. I bet you all be right there when that tent open.”
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌你一定会在那儿。”勒斯特说。“我打赌你昨晚就在​​那里。我打赌当帐篷打开时你们都在那里。”

paragraphs.en: “Be enough niggers there without me. Was last night.”
paragraphs.zh: “没有我，那里的黑鬼已经够多了。昨晚就是这样。”

paragraphs.en: “Nigger’s money good as white folks, I reckon.”
paragraphs.zh: “我认为，黑人的钱和白人一样好。”

paragraphs.en: “White folks gives nigger money because know first white man comes along with a band going to get it all back, so nigger can go to work for some more.”
paragraphs.zh: “白人给黑鬼钱，因为知道首先白人会带着一支乐队来把钱全部拿回来，这样黑鬼就可以去工作赚更多的钱。”

paragraphs.en: “Aint nobody going make you go to that show.”
paragraphs.zh: “没人会逼你去看那个演出。”

paragraphs.en: “Aint yet. Aint thought of it, I reckon.”
paragraphs.zh: “还没有。我想还没想到。”

paragraphs.en: “What you got against white folks.”
paragraphs.zh: “你对白人所做的一切。”

paragraphs.en: “Aint got nothing against them. I goes my way and lets white folks go theirs. I aint studying that show.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有反对他们。我走我的路，让白人走他们的路。我不会研究那个节目。”

paragraphs.en: “Got a man in it can play a tune on a saw. Play it like a banjo.”
paragraphs.zh: “一个人在里面可以用锯子弹奏曲子。像班卓琴一样弹奏。”

paragraphs.en: “You go last night.” Luster said. “I going tonight. If I can find where I lost that quarter.”
paragraphs.zh: “你昨晚就走了。”勒斯特说。“我今晚就去。如果我能找到那个二十五美分硬币我输在哪里的话。”

paragraphs.en: “You going take him with you, I reckon.”
paragraphs.zh: “我想你会带他一起去。”

paragraphs.en: “Me.” Luster said. “You reckon I be found anywhere with him, time he start bellering.”
paragraphs.zh: “我。”勒斯特说。“你认为，只要他开始大喊大叫，我就会和他在一起。”

paragraphs.en: “What does you do when he start bellering.”
paragraphs.zh: “当他开始咆哮时你会做什么？”

paragraphs.en: “I whips him.” Luster said. He sat down and rolled up his overalls. They played in the branch.
paragraphs.zh: “我鞭打他。”勒斯特说。他坐下来，卷起工作服。他们在溪沟里玩耍。

paragraphs.en: “You all found any balls yet.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “你们都找到球了。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you talking biggity. I bet you better not let your grandmammy hear you talking like that.”
paragraphs.zh: “你是不是在说大话。我打赌你最好别让你奶奶听到你这样说话。”

paragraphs.en: Luster got into the branch, where they were playing. He hunted in the water, along the bank.
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特走进溪沟，他们在水里玩。他沿着岸边在水中找。

paragraphs.en: “I had it when we was down here this morning.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “今天早上我们来这里的时候我就得到了它。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Where ’bouts you lose it.”
paragraphs.zh: “你在哪里失去它。”

paragraphs.en: “Right out this here hole in my pocket.” Luster said. They hunted in the branch. Then they all stood up quick and stopped, then they splashed and fought in the branch. Luster got it and they squatted in the water, looking up the hill through the bushes.
paragraphs.zh: “就在我口袋里的这个洞里。”勒斯特说。他们在溪沟上寻找。然后他们都迅速站起来停了下来，然后他们在溪沟上打了起来。勒斯特明白了，他们蹲在水里，透过灌木丛往山上看。

paragraphs.en: “Where is they.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “他们在哪儿。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Aint in sight yet.”
paragraphs.zh: “还没有看到。”

paragraphs.en: Luster put it in his pocket. They came down the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特把它放进口袋里。他们下了山。

paragraphs.en: “Did a ball come down here.”
paragraphs.zh: “有一个球落到这里了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “It ought to be in the water. Didn’t any of you boys see it or hear it.”
paragraphs.zh: “它应该在水里。你们小伙子们没有看到它或听到它吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Aint heard nothing come down here.” Luster said. “Heard something hit that tree up yonder. Dont know which way it went.”
paragraphs.zh: “没有听到这里有什么声音。”勒斯特说。“听到有东西撞到了那边的那棵树。不知道它朝哪个方向飞去。”

paragraphs.en: They looked in the branch.
paragraphs.zh: 他们在溪沟上看了看。

paragraphs.en: “Hell. Look along the branch. It came down here. I saw it.”
paragraphs.zh: “见鬼。沿着溪沟看。它掉下来了。我看到了。”

paragraphs.en: They looked along the branch. Then they went back up the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 他们顺着溪沟望去。然后他们又回到山上。

paragraphs.en: “Have you got that ball.” the boy said.
paragraphs.zh: “你拿到那个球了吗？”男孩说。

paragraphs.en: “What I want with it.” Luster said. “I aint seen no ball.”
paragraphs.zh: “我想要什么。”勒斯特说。“我没看到球。”

paragraphs.en: The boy got in the water. He went on. He turned and looked at Luster again. He went on down the branch.
paragraphs.zh: 男孩掉进水里了。他继续说下去。他转身再次看着勒斯特。他继续沿着溪沟走下去。

paragraphs.en: The man said “Caddie” up the hill. The boy got out of the water and went up the hill.
paragraphs.zh: 那人喊着“凯迪”上山。男孩从水里爬了上山。

paragraphs.en: “Now, just listen at you.” Luster said. “Hush up.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在，就听你说吧。”勒斯特说。“安静点。”

paragraphs.en: “What he moaning about now.”
paragraphs.zh: “他现在在抱怨什么。”

paragraphs.en: “Lawd knows.” Luster said. “He just starts like that. He been at it all morning. Cause it his birthday, I reckon.”
paragraphs.zh: “法律知道。”勒斯特说。“他就是这样开始的。他整个上午都在做这件事。我想是因为那天是他的生日。”

paragraphs.en: “How old he.”
paragraphs.zh: “他多大了。”

paragraphs.en: “He thirty-three.” Luster said. “Thirty-three this morning.”
paragraphs.zh: “他三十三岁了。”勒斯特说。“今天早上三十三点。”

paragraphs.en: “You mean, he been three years old thirty years.”
paragraphs.zh: “你的意思是，他三岁了，三十岁了。”

paragraphs.en: “I going by what mammy say.” Luster said. “I dont know. We going to have thirty-three candles on a cake, anyway. Little cake. Wont hardly hold them. Hush up. Come on back here.” He came and caught my arm. “You old loony.” he said. “You want me to whip you.”
paragraphs.zh: “我就按妈妈说的办。”勒斯特说。“我不知道。无论如何，我们的蛋糕上要放三十三根蜡烛。小蛋糕。几乎撑不住它们。安静点。回到这里来。”他过来抓住了我的手臂。“你这个老疯子。”他说。“你想让我鞭打你。”

paragraphs.en: “I bet you will.”
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌你会的。”

paragraphs.en: “I is done it. Hush, now.” Luster said. “Aint I told you you cant go up there. They’ll knock your head clean off with one of them balls. Come on, here.” He pulled me back. “Sit down.” I sat down and he took off my shoes and rolled up my trousers. “Now, git in that water and play and see can you stop that slobbering and moaning.”
paragraphs.zh: “我已经完成了。嘘，现在。”勒斯特说。“我是不是告诉过你，你不能上去。他们会用其中一个球把你的头打下来。来吧，这里。”他把我拉了回来。“坐下。”我坐下来，他脱掉我的鞋子，卷起我的裤子。“现在，跳进水里玩，看看你能停止流口水和呻吟吗？”

paragraphs.en: I hushed and got in the water and Roskus came and said to come to supper and Caddy said,
paragraphs.zh: 我安静下来，钻进水里，罗斯库斯走过来说要来吃晚饭，凯蒂说：

paragraphs.en: It’s not supper time yet. I’m not going.
paragraphs.zh: 还没到晚饭时间。我不去。

paragraphs.en: She was wet. We were playing in the branch and Caddy squatted down and got her dress wet and Versh said,
paragraphs.zh: 她浑身湿透了。我们在溪沟上玩耍，凯蒂蹲下来，把衣服弄湿，弗许说：

paragraphs.en: “Your mommer going to whip you for getting your dress wet.”
paragraphs.zh: “你妈妈会因为你把衣服弄湿而鞭打你。”

paragraphs.en: “She’s not going to do any such thing.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “她不会做这样的事。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “How do you know.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么知道。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “That’s all right how I know.” Caddy said. “How do you know.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道的就这些。”凯蒂说。“你怎么知道。”

paragraphs.en: “She said she was.” Quentin said. “Besides, I’m older than you.”
paragraphs.zh: “她说她是。”昆丁说道。“而且，我比你大。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m seven years old.” Caddy said, “I guess I know.”
paragraphs.zh: “我七岁了。”凯蒂说：“我想我知道。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m older than that.” Quentin said. “I go to school. Dont I, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “我比那还老。”昆丁说道。“我去上学。不去吗，弗许。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m going to school next year.” Caddy said, “When it comes. Aint I, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “我明年就要去上学了。”凯蒂说：“当它到来时。不是我，弗许。”

paragraphs.en: “You know she whip you when you get your dress wet.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “你知道，当你弄湿你的衣服时，她会鞭打你。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “It’s not wet.” Caddy said. She stood up in the water and looked at her dress. “I’ll take it off.” she said. “Then it’ll dry.”
paragraphs.zh: “没湿。”凯蒂说。她在水中站起来，看着自己的衣服。“我会把它脱下来。”她说。“然后就干了。”

paragraphs.en: “I bet you wont.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌你不会。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “I bet I will.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌我会的。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I bet you better not.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌你最好不要。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: Caddy came to Versh and me and turned her back.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂来到弗许和我身边，转过身去。

paragraphs.en: “Unbutton it, Versh.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “解开扣子，弗许。”她说。

paragraphs.en: “Dont you do it, Versh.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “弗许，你别这么做。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “Taint none of my dress.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “不要弄脏我的衣服。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “You unbutton it, Versh.” Caddy said, “Or I’ll tell Dilsey what you did yesterday.” So Versh unbuttoned it.
paragraphs.zh: “弗许，你把扣子解开。”凯蒂说：“不然我就告诉迪尔西你昨天做了什么。”于是弗许解开了扣子。

paragraphs.en: “You just take your dress off.” Quentin said. Caddy took her dress off and threw it on the bank. Then she didn’t have on anything but her bodice and drawers, and Quentin slapped her and she slipped and fell down in the water. When she got up she began to splash water on Quentin, and Quentin splashed water on Caddy. Some of it splashed on Versh and me and Versh picked me up and put me on the bank. He said he was going to tell on Caddy and Quentin, and then Quentin and Caddy began to splash water at Versh. He got behind a bush.
paragraphs.zh: “你把衣服脱了就行了。”昆丁说道。凯蒂脱下衣服扔到岸边。然后她只穿了紧身胸衣和内裤，昆丁打了她一巴掌，她脚下一滑，掉进了水里。当她起身时，她开始向昆丁泼水，昆丁也向凯蒂泼水。有些溅到了弗许和我身上，弗许把我抱起来放到岸上。他说他要告发凯蒂和昆丁，然后昆丁和凯蒂开始向弗许泼水。他躲到灌木丛后面。

paragraphs.en: “I’m going to tell mammy on you all.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “我要把你们的事都告诉妈妈。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: Quentin climbed up the bank and tried to catch Versh, but Versh ran away and Quentin couldn’t. When Quentin came back Versh stopped and hollered that he was going to tell. Caddy told him that if he wouldn’t tell, they’d let him come back. So Versh said he wouldn’t, and they let him.
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁爬上岸，试图抓住弗许，但弗许逃跑了，昆丁不能。当昆丁回来时，弗许停了下来，大声喊道他要告诉。凯蒂告诉他，如果他不说，他们会让他回来。所以弗许说他不会，他们就同意了。

paragraphs.en: “Now I guess you’re satisfied.” Quentin said, “We’ll both get whipped now.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在我想你应该满意了。”昆丁道：“现在我们都要挨鞭子了。”

paragraphs.en: “I dont care.” Caddy said. “I’ll run away.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不在乎。”凯蒂说。“我会逃跑。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes you will.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，你会的。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “I’ll run away and never come back.” Caddy said. I began to cry. Caddy turned around and said “Hush.” So I hushed. Then they played in the branch. Jason was playing too. He was by himself further down the branch. Versh came around the bush and lifted me down into the water again. Caddy was all wet and muddy behind, and I started to cry and she came and squatted in the water.
paragraphs.zh: “我会逃走，再也不会回来。”凯蒂说。我开始哭泣。凯蒂转身说：“嘘。”于是我沉默了。然后他们就在溪沟里玩耍。杰生也在玩。他独自一人在溪沟的更深处。弗许绕过灌木丛，再次把我抱到水里。凯蒂身后浑身湿透，泥泞不堪，我开始哭泣，她过来蹲在水里。

paragraphs.en: “Hush now.” she said. “I’m not going to run away.” So I hushed. Caddy smelled like trees in the rain.
paragraphs.zh: “现在安静点。”她说。“我不会逃跑。”于是我沉默了。凯蒂闻起来像雨中的树木。

paragraphs.en: What is the matter with you, Luster said. Cant you get done with that moaning and play in the branch like folks.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么了，”勒斯特说。你能不能停止呻吟，像人们一样在溪沟上玩耍。

paragraphs.en: Whyn’t you take him on home. Didn’t they told you not to take him off the place.
paragraphs.zh: 你为什么不带他回家。他们不是告诉过你不要把他带离这个地方吗？

paragraphs.en: He still think they own this pasture, Luster said. Cant nobody see down here from the house, noways.
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特说，他仍然认为他们拥有这片牧场。没人能从房子里看到这里吗？

paragraphs.en: We can. And folks dont like to look at a loony. Taint no luck in it.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以。人们不喜欢看疯子。没有运气。

paragraphs.en: Roskus came and said to come to supper and Caddy said it wasn’t supper time yet.
paragraphs.zh: 罗斯库斯过来说要吃晚饭，凯蒂说还没到晚饭时间。

paragraphs.en: “Yes tis.” Roskus said. “Dilsey say for you all to come on to the house. Bring them on, Versh.” He went up the hill, where the cow was lowing.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，就是这样。”罗斯库斯说道。“迪尔西吩咐你们都到家里来。弗许，带他们来。”他上了山，那里牛正在哞哞叫。

paragraphs.en: “Maybe we’ll be dry by the time we get to the house.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “也许我们到家的时候就已经干了。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “It was all your fault.” Caddy said. “I hope we do get whipped.” She put her dress on and Versh buttoned it.
paragraphs.zh: “都是你的错。”凯蒂说。“我希望我们真的会被鞭打。”她穿上衣服，弗许扣上纽扣。

paragraphs.en: “They wont know you got wet.” Versh said. “It dont show on you. Less me and Jason tells.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们不会知道你被淋湿了。”弗许说道。“这不会表现在你身上。少我和杰生告诉。”

paragraphs.en: “Are you going to tell, Jason.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “杰生，你要说吗？”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Tell on who.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “告诉谁。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “He wont tell.” Quentin said. “Will you, Jason.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不会告诉。”昆丁说道。“杰生，你愿意吗？”

paragraphs.en: “I bet he does tell.” Caddy said. “He’ll tell Damuddy.”
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌他确实会说。”凯蒂说。“他会告诉外婆的。”

paragraphs.en: “He cant tell her.” Quentin said. “She’s sick. If we walk slow it’ll be too dark for them to see.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不能告诉她。”昆丁说道。“她病了。如果我们走慢的话，天就太黑了，他们看不到。”

paragraphs.en: “I dont care whether they see or not.” Caddy said. “I’m going to tell, myself. You carry him up the hill, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不在乎他们是否看到。”凯蒂说。“我亲自告诉你。弗许，你把他抱上山。”

paragraphs.en: “Jason wont tell.” Quentin said. “You remember that bow and arrow I made you, Jason.”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生不会告诉。”昆丁说道。“杰生，你还记得我给你做的弓箭吗。”

paragraphs.en: “It’s broke now.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “现在已经坏掉了。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “Let him tell.” Caddy said. “I dont give a cuss. Carry Maury up the hill, Versh.” Versh squatted and I got on his back.
paragraphs.zh: “让他说吧。”凯蒂说。“我才不骂人呢。弗许，把莫里抱上山吧。”弗许蹲下来，我坐到他的背上。

paragraphs.en: See you all at the show tonight, Luster said. Come on, here. We got to find that quarter.
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特说，今晚演出中见。来吧，这里。我们必须找到那个二十五美分硬币。

paragraphs.en: “If we go slow, it’ll be dark when we get there.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我们走慢一点，到那里的时候天就黑了。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not going slow.” Caddy said. We went up the hill, but Quentin didn’t come. He was down at the branch when we got to where we could smell the pigs. They were grunting and snuffing in the trough in the corner. Jason came behind us, with his hands in his pockets. Roskus was milking the cow in the barn door.
paragraphs.zh: “我不会慢的。”凯蒂说。我们上山了，昆丁没有来。当我们到达可以闻到猪味的地方时，他已经在溪沟上了。它们在角落里的槽里咕噜咕噜地吸鼻子。杰生双手插在口袋里，来到我们身后。罗斯库斯正在谷仓门口挤牛奶。

paragraphs.en: The cows came jumping out of the barn.
paragraphs.zh: 奶牛从谷仓里跳出来。

paragraphs.en: “Go on.” T. P. said. “Holler again. I going to holler myself. Whooey.” Quentin kicked T. P. again. He kicked T. P. into the trough where the pigs ate and T. P. lay there. “Hot dogs.” T. P. said, “Didn’t he get me then. You see that white man kick me that time. Whooey.”
paragraphs.zh: “继续吧。”蒂·皮说。“又喊了。我要喊自己了。哎哟。”昆丁又踢了蒂·皮一脚。他把蒂·皮踢进了猪吃东西的食槽里，蒂·皮躺在那里。“热狗。”蒂·皮说：“他当时没有抓住我吗？你看那次白人踢了我。哎哟。”

paragraphs.en: I wasn’t crying, but I couldn’t stop. I wasn’t crying, but the ground wasn’t still, and then I was crying. The ground kept sloping up and the cows ran up the hill. T. P. tried to get up. He fell down again and the cows ran down the hill. Quentin held my arm and we went toward the barn. Then the barn wasn’t there and we had to wait until it came back. I didn’t see it come back. It came behind us and Quentin set me down in the trough where the cows ate. I held on to it. It was going away too, and I held to it. The cows ran down the hill again, across the door. I couldn’t stop. Quentin and T. P. came up the hill, fighting. T. P. was falling down the hill and Quentin dragged him up the hill. Quentin hit T. P. I couldn’t stop.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有哭，但我无法停止。我没有哭，但地面并没有静止，然后我就哭了。地面不断倾斜，牛群往山上跑。蒂·皮试图站起来。他又摔倒了，牛群也跑下了山。昆丁拉着我的胳膊，我们向谷仓走去。然后谷仓就不在那里了，我们不得不等到它回来。我没看到它回来。它来到我们身后，昆丁把我放在牛吃食的食槽里。我坚持了下来。它也正在消失，而我坚持着它。奶牛又跑下山，穿过门。我无法停下来。昆丁和蒂·皮上山来，打斗着。蒂·皮从山上掉了下来，昆丁把他拖上了山。昆丁打蒂·皮我停不下来。

paragraphs.en: “Stand up.” Quentin said, “You stay right here. Dont you go away until I get back.”
paragraphs.zh: “站起来。”昆丁道：“你就在这里待着，我回来之前你不要走开。”

paragraphs.en: “Me and Benjy going back to the wedding.” T. P. said. “Whooey.”
paragraphs.zh: “我和班吉回去参加婚礼。”蒂·皮说。“哎哟。”

paragraphs.en: Quentin hit T. P. again. Then he began to thump T. P. against the wall. T. P. was laughing. Every time Quentin thumped him against the wall he tried to say Whooey, but he couldn’t say it for laughing. I quit crying, but I couldn’t stop. T. P. fell on me and the barn door went away. It went down the hill and T. P. was fighting by himself and he fell down again. He was still laughing, and I couldn’t stop, and I tried to get up and I fell down, and I couldn’t stop. Versh said,
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁又打了蒂·皮。然后他开始用力捶蒂·皮在墙上。蒂·皮在笑。每次昆丁把他撞到墙上时，他都想说“哎呀”，但他因为笑而说不出来。我哭了，但我无法停止。蒂·皮落在我身上，谷仓的门消失了。下山了，蒂·皮孤身奋战，又摔倒了。他还在笑，我停不下来，我想站起来却摔倒了，停不下来。弗许说，

paragraphs.en: “You sho done it now. I’ll declare if you aint. Shut up that yelling.”
paragraphs.zh: “你现在就做吧。如果你不做，我就宣布。闭嘴。”

paragraphs.en: T. P. was still laughing. He flopped on the door and laughed. “Whooey.” he said, “Me and Benjy going back to the wedding. Sassprilluh.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮还在笑。他扑通扑通地敲门，笑了起来。“哎哟。”他说：“我和班吉要回去参加婚礼了。Sassprelluh。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Versh said. “Where you get it.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”弗许说道。“你从哪里得到的。”

paragraphs.en: “Out the cellar.” T. P. said. “Whooey.”
paragraphs.zh: “出地窖。”蒂·皮说。“哎哟。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush up.” Versh said, “Where’bouts in the cellar.”
paragraphs.zh: “安静点。”弗许说：“在地窖里。”

paragraphs.en: “Anywhere.” T. P. said. He laughed some more. “Moren a hundred bottles left. Moren a million. Look out, nigger, I going to holler.”
paragraphs.zh: “任何地方。”蒂·皮说。他又笑了一些。“还剩下一百瓶。还有一百万瓶。小心，黑鬼，我要大喊大叫了。”

paragraphs.en: Quentin said, “Lift him up.”
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁道：“把他抬起来。”

paragraphs.en: Versh lifted me up.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许把我举了起来。

paragraphs.en: “Drink this, Benjy.” Quentin said. The glass was hot. “Hush, now.” Quentin said. “Drink it.”
paragraphs.zh: “班吉，喝这个。”昆丁说道。玻璃很热。“嘘，现在。”昆丁说道。“喝了。”

paragraphs.en: “Sassprilluh.” T. P. said. “Lemme drink it, Mr Quentin.”
paragraphs.zh: “萨斯普里鲁。”蒂·皮说。“昆丁先生，让我喝吧。”

paragraphs.en: “You shut your mouth.” Versh said, “Mr Quentin wear you out.”
paragraphs.zh: “你闭嘴。”弗许说：“昆丁先生累死你了。”

paragraphs.en: “Hold him, Versh.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “抓住他，弗许。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: They held me. It was hot on my chin and on my shirt. “Drink.” Quentin said. They held my head. It was hot inside me, and I began again. I was crying now, and something was happening inside me and I cried more, and they held me until it stopped happening. Then I hushed. It was still going around, and then the shapes began. “Open the crib, Versh.” They were going slow. “Spread those empty sacks on the floor.” They were going faster, almost fast enough. “Now. Pick up his feet.” They went on, smooth and bright. I could hear T. P. laughing. I went on with them, up the bright hill.
paragraphs.zh: 他们抱着我。我的下巴和衬衫上都很烫。“喝。”昆丁说道。他们按住我的头。我心里很热，我又开始了。我现在在哭，我内心发生了一些事情，我哭得更厉害，他们抱着我直到它停止发生。然后我沉默了。它仍然在旋转，然后形状开始出现。“打开婴儿床，弗许。”他们走得很慢。“把那些空袋子铺在地板上。”他们走得更快，几乎足够快了。“现在。把他的脚抬起来。”他们继续前行，平稳而明亮。我能听到蒂·皮的笑声。我和他们一起继续前行，登上了明亮的山坡。

paragraphs.en: At the top of the hill Versh put me down. “Come on here, Quentin.” he called, looking back down the hill. Quentin was still standing there by the branch. He was chunking into the shadows where the branch was.
paragraphs.zh: 在山顶弗许把我放下。“昆丁，你过来一下。”他一边喊道，一边回头看向山下。昆丁还站在溪沟旁。他正钻进溪沟所在的阴影里。

paragraphs.en: “Let the old skizzard stay there.” Caddy said. She took my hand and we went on past the barn and through the gate. There was a frog on the brick walk, squatting in the middle of it. Caddy stepped over it and pulled me on.
paragraphs.zh: “让老雪人留在那里吧。”凯蒂说。她拉着我的手，我们继续前行，经过谷仓，穿过大门。砖砌的人行道上有一只青蛙，蹲在中间。凯蒂跨过它，拉着我继续前行。

paragraphs.en: “Come on, Maury.” she said. It still squatted there until Jason poked at it with his toe.
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，莫里。”她说。它还蹲在那里，直到杰生用脚趾戳它。

paragraphs.en: “He’ll make a wart on you.” Versh said. The frog hopped away.
paragraphs.zh: “他会在你身上留下疣子。”弗许说道。青蛙跳走了。

paragraphs.en: “Come on, Maury.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，莫里。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “They got company tonight.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “今晚他们有伴。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “How do you know.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么知道。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “With all them lights on.” Versh said, “Light in every window.”
paragraphs.zh: “所有灯都亮着。”弗许说：“每一扇窗户都有光。”

paragraphs.en: “I reckon we can turn all the lights on without company, if we want to.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “我想，如果我们愿意的话，我们可以在无人陪伴的情况下打开所有的灯。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I bet it’s company.” Versh said. “You all better go in the back and slip upstairs.”
paragraphs.zh: “我打赌是公司。”弗许说道。“你们最好到后面去，溜上楼。”

paragraphs.en: “I dont care.” Caddy said. “I’ll walk right in the parlor where they are.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不在乎。”凯蒂说。“我会直接走到他们所在的客厅。”

paragraphs.en: “I bet your pappy whip you if you do.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “我敢打赌，如果你这样做了，你的爸爸就会鞭打你。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “I dont care.” Caddy said. “I’ll walk right in the parlor. I’ll walk right in the dining room and eat supper.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不在乎。”凯蒂说。“我会直接走进客厅。我会直接走进餐厅吃晚饭。”

paragraphs.en: “Where you sit.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “你坐哪儿。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “I’d sit in Damuddy’s chair.” Caddy said. “She eats in bed.”
paragraphs.zh: “我会坐在外婆的椅子上。”凯蒂说。“她在床上吃饭。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m hungry.” Jason said. He passed us and ran on up the walk. He had his hands in his pockets and he fell down. Versh went and picked him up.
paragraphs.zh: “我饿了。”杰生说道。他从我们身边经过，沿着人行道跑去。他双手插在口袋里，然后摔倒了。弗许去接他。

paragraphs.en: “If you keep them hands out your pockets, you could stay on your feet.” Versh said. “You cant never get them out in time to catch yourself, fat as you is.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果你把他们的手从口袋里拿出来，你就可以站起来。”弗许说道。“你永远不可能及时把它们赶出去，让自己抓到自己，尽管你这么胖。”

paragraphs.en: Father was standing by the kitchen steps.
paragraphs.zh: 父亲站在厨房的台阶旁。

paragraphs.en: “Where’s Quentin.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “昆丁在哪儿。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “He coming up the walk.” Versh said. Quentin was coming slow. His shirt was a white blur.
paragraphs.zh: “他沿着人行道走来。”弗许说道。昆丁来得很慢。他的衬衫一片模糊。

paragraphs.en: “Oh.” Father said. Light fell down the steps, on him.
paragraphs.zh: “哦。”父亲说。光芒从台阶上洒下来，落在他身上。

paragraphs.en: “Caddy and Quentin threw water on each other.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “凯蒂和昆丁互相泼水。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: We waited.
paragraphs.zh: 我们等待着。

paragraphs.en: “They did.” Father said. Quentin came, and Father said, “You can eat supper in the kitchen tonight.” He stopped and took me up, and the light came tumbling down the steps on me too, and I could look down at Caddy and Jason and Quentin and Versh. Father turned toward the steps. “You must be quiet, though.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “他们做到了。”父亲说。昆丁来了，父亲说：“今晚你可以在厨房吃晚饭。”他停下来，把我抱起来，灯光也从台阶上滚落到我身上，我可以低头看着凯蒂、杰生、昆丁和弗许。父亲转向台阶。“不过，你必须保持安静。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Why must we be quiet, Father.” Caddy said. “Have we got company.”
paragraphs.zh: “为什么我们必须保持安静，神父。”凯蒂说。“我们有人陪伴吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Yes.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “I told you they was company.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉过你他们是同伴。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “You did not.” Caddy said, “I was the one that said there was. I said I would”
paragraphs.zh: “你没有。”凯蒂说：“我是那个说有的人。我说过我会的”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Father said. They hushed and Father opened the door and we crossed the back porch and went in to the kitchen. Dilsey was there, and Father put me in the chair and closed the apron down and pushed it to the table, where supper was. It was steaming up.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”父亲说。他们安静下来，父亲打开门，我们穿过后门廊，走进厨房。迪尔西在那里，父亲把我放在椅子上，拉上围裙，推到餐桌上，那里是晚饭的地方。热气腾腾了。

paragraphs.en: “You mind Dilsey, now.” Father said. “Dont let them make any more noise than they can help, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在你介意迪尔西了。”父亲说。“别让他们发出超出他们所能的噪音，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, sir.” Dilsey said. Father went away.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生。”迪尔西说道。父亲走了。

paragraphs.en: “Remember to mind Dilsey, now.” he said behind us. I leaned my face over where the supper was. It steamed up on my face.
paragraphs.zh: “现在记住迪尔西。”他在我们身后说道。我把脸凑到吃晚饭的地方。它在我脸上冒出蒸汽。

paragraphs.en: “Let them mind me tonight, Father.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “今晚就让他们来管我吧，神父。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I wont.” Jason said. “I’m going to mind Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不会。”杰生说道。“我会介意迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “You’ll have to, if Father says so.” Caddy said. “Let them mind me, Father.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果父亲这么说，你就必须这样做。”凯蒂说。“让他们管管我吧，神父。”

paragraphs.en: “I wont.” Jason said, “I wont mind you.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不会。”杰生说：“我不介意你。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Father said. “You all mind Caddy, then. When they are done, bring them up the back stairs, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”父亲说。“那么，你们都介意凯蒂。当他们完成后，把他们带上后楼梯，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, sir.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “There.” Caddy said, “Now I guess you’ll mind me.”
paragraphs.zh: “那里。”凯蒂说：“现在我想你会介意我了。”

paragraphs.en: “You all hush, now.” Dilsey said. “You got to be quiet tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “你们都安静，现在。”迪尔西说道。“今晚你一定要安静。”

paragraphs.en: “Why do we have to be quiet tonight.” Caddy whispered.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么今晚我们必须保持安静。”凯蒂小声说道。

paragraphs.en: “Never you mind.” Dilsey said, “You’ll know in the Lawd’s own time.” She brought my bowl. The steam from it came and tickled my face. “Come here, Versh.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “没关系。”迪尔西说：“等劳德到时候你就会知道了。”她给我带来了碗。蒸汽从里面冒出来，弄得我的脸发痒。“弗许，过来。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “When is the Lawd’s own time, Dilsey.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “什么时候是劳德自己的时间，迪尔西。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “It’s Sunday.” Quentin said. “Dont you know anything.”
paragraphs.zh: “今天是周日。”昆丁说道。“你什么都不知道吗。”

paragraphs.en: “Shhhhhh.” Dilsey said. “Didn’t Mr Jason say for you all to be quiet. Eat your supper, now. Here, Versh. Git his spoon.” Versh’s hand came with the spoon, into the bowl. The spoon came up to my mouth. The steam tickled into my mouth. Then we quit eating and we looked at each other and we were quiet, and then we heard it again and I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘嘘。”迪尔西说道。“杰生先生不是让你们都安静吗？现在吃晚饭吧。来，弗许。拿起勺子。”弗许的手拿着勺子，伸进了碗里。勺子就到了我嘴边。蒸汽让我的嘴发痒。然后我们不再吃东西，我们互相看着对方，安静下来，然后我们又听到了声音，我开始哭了。

paragraphs.en: “What was that.” Caddy said. She put her hand on my hand.
paragraphs.zh: “那是什么。”凯蒂说。她把手放在我的手上。

paragraphs.en: “That was Mother.” Quentin said. The spoon came up and I ate, then I cried again.
paragraphs.zh: “那是妈妈。”昆丁说道。勺子端上来，我吃了，然后我又哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Caddy said. But I didn’t hush and she came and put her arms around me. Dilsey went and closed both the doors and then we couldn’t hear it.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”凯蒂说。但我并没有安静下来，她走过来，用双臂搂住了我。迪尔西走过去关上了两扇门，然后我们就听不到了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, now.” Caddy said. I hushed and ate. Quentin wasn’t eating, but Jason was.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，现在。”凯蒂说。我安静地吃东西。昆丁没有吃饭，杰生却在吃饭。

paragraphs.en: “That was Mother.” Quentin said. He got up.
paragraphs.zh: “那是妈妈。”昆丁说道。他站了起来。

paragraphs.en: “You set right down.” Dilsey said. “They got company in there, and you in them muddy clothes. You set down too, Caddy, and get done eating.”
paragraphs.zh: “你就下来吧。”迪尔西说道。“他们在那里有人陪伴，你也穿着沾满泥的衣服。凯蒂，你也坐下来，吃完饭。”

paragraphs.en: “She was crying.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “她在哭。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “It was somebody singing.” Caddy said. “Wasn’t it, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “有人在唱歌。”凯蒂说。“不是吗，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “You all eat your supper, now, like Mr Jason said.” Dilsey said. “You’ll know in the Lawd’s own time.” Caddy went back to her chair.
paragraphs.zh: “现在你们都吃晚饭了，就像杰生先生说的。”迪尔西说道。“到了劳德的时间你就会知道了。”凯蒂回到椅子上。

paragraphs.en: “I told you it was a party.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉过你这是一个聚会。”她说。

paragraphs.en: Versh said, “He done et all that.”
paragraphs.zh: 弗许说：“他做了这一切。”

paragraphs.en: “Bring his bowl here.” Dilsey said. The bowl went away.
paragraphs.zh: “把他的碗拿过来。”迪尔西说道。碗消失了。

paragraphs.en: “Dilsey.” Caddy said, “Quentin’s not eating his supper. Hasn’t he got to mind me.”
paragraphs.zh: “迪尔西。”凯蒂说：“昆丁没吃晚饭，他不是来管我的吗。”

paragraphs.en: “Eat your supper, Quentin.” Dilsey said, “You all got to get done and get out of my kitchen.”
paragraphs.zh: “昆丁，吃晚饭了。”迪尔西说：“你们都得完成任务并离开我的厨房。”

paragraphs.en: “I dont want any more supper.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “我不想再吃晚饭了。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “You’ve got to eat if I say you have.” Caddy said. “Hasn’t he, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果我说你吃的话，你就得吃。”凯蒂说。“不是吗，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: The bowl steamed up to my face, and Versh’s hand dipped the spoon in it and the steam tickled into my mouth.
paragraphs.zh: 碗里冒着热气，到了我的脸上，弗许的手把勺子伸进了碗里，蒸汽让我的嘴里痒痒的。

paragraphs.en: “I dont want any more.” Quentin said. “How can they have a party when Damuddy’s sick.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不再想要了。”昆丁说道。“外婆生病了，他们怎么能聚会呢。”

paragraphs.en: “They’ll have it down stairs.” Caddy said. “She can come to the landing and see it. That’s what I’m going to do when I get my nightie on.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们会把它放在楼下的。”凯蒂说。“她可以到楼梯平台来看看。这就是我穿上睡衣后要做的事。”

paragraphs.en: “Mother was crying.” Quentin said. “Wasn’t she crying, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈哭了。”昆丁说道。“她不是在哭吗，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont you come pestering at me, boy.” Dilsey said. “I got to get supper for all them folks soon as you all get done eating.”
paragraphs.zh: “你小子，别来纠缠我。”迪尔西说道。“等你们吃完后，我得去给大家准备晚饭。”

paragraphs.en: After a while even Jason was through eating, and he began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 过了一会儿，杰生也吃完了，他开始哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Now you got to tune up.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “现在你必须调整一下。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “He does it every night since Damuddy was sick and he cant sleep with her.” Caddy said. “Cry baby.”
paragraphs.zh: “自从外婆生病后，他每天晚上都这样做，不能和她一起睡觉。”凯蒂说。“哭吧宝贝。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m going to tell on you.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我要告发你。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: He was crying. “You’ve already told.” Caddy said. “There’s not anything else you can tell, now.”
paragraphs.zh: 他在哭。“你已经说过了。”凯蒂说。“现在你没有什么可以说的了。”

paragraphs.en: “You all needs to go to bed.” Dilsey said. She came and lifted me down and wiped my face and hands with a warm cloth. “Versh, can you get them up the back stairs quiet. You, Jason, shut up that crying.”
paragraphs.zh: “你们都该去睡觉了。”迪尔西说道。她走过来把我抱起来，用温暖的布擦了擦我的脸和手。“弗许，你能不能让他们安静地上后楼梯。你，杰生，别再哭了。”

paragraphs.en: “It’s too early to go to bed now.” Caddy said. “We dont ever have to go to bed this early.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在睡觉还太早了。”凯蒂说。“我们从来不用这么早睡觉。”

paragraphs.en: “You is tonight.” Dilsey said. “Your pa say for you to come right on up stairs when you et supper. You heard him.”
paragraphs.zh: “今晚就是你。”迪尔西说道。“你爸爸让你吃晚饭的时候直接上楼来。你听到了。”

paragraphs.en: “He said to mind me.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “他说要管我。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not going to mind you.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我不会介意你的。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “You have to.” Caddy said. “Come on, now. You have to do like I say.”
paragraphs.zh: “你必须这么做。”凯蒂说。“来吧，现在。你必须按照我说的去做。”

paragraphs.en: “Make them be quiet, Versh.” Dilsey said. “You all going to be quiet, aint you.”
paragraphs.zh: “让他们安静点，弗许。”迪尔西说道。“你们都安静点，不是吗。”

paragraphs.en: “What do we have to be so quiet for, tonight.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “今晚我们为什么要这么安静呢？”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Your mommer aint feeling well.” Dilsey said. “You all go on with Versh, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “你妈妈身体不太舒服。”迪尔西说道。“现在你们都继续跟弗许在一起吧。”

paragraphs.en: “I told you Mother was crying.” Quentin said. Versh took me up and opened the door onto the back porch. We went out and Versh closed the door black. I could smell Versh and feel him. “You all be quiet, now. We’re not going up stairs yet. Mr Jason said for you to come right up stairs. He said to mind me. I’m not going to mind you. But he said for all of us to. Didn’t he, Quentin.” I could feel Versh’s head. I could hear us. “Didn’t he, Versh. Yes, that’s right. Then I say for us to go out doors a while. Come on.” Versh opened the door and we went out.
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉过你，妈妈在哭。”昆丁说道。弗许把我抱起来，打开后廊的门。我们出去了，弗许把门关上了。我能闻到弗许的味道，感觉到他。“现在你们都安静。我们还不上楼。杰生先生让你们直接上楼。他说要管我。我不会管你们。但他让我们所有人都管。不是吗，昆丁。”我能感觉到弗许的头。我能听到我们的声音。“不是吗，弗许。是的，没错。那我说我们出去一会儿吧。来吧。”弗许打开门，我们出去了。

paragraphs.en: We went down the steps.
paragraphs.zh: 我们走下台阶。

paragraphs.en: “I expect we’d better go down to Versh’s house, so we’ll be quiet.” Caddy said. Versh put me down and Caddy took my hand and we went down the brick walk.
paragraphs.zh: “我想我们最好去弗许家，这样我们就不会安静了。”凯蒂说。弗许把我放下，凯蒂拉着我的手，我们沿着砖砌的小路走下去。

paragraphs.en: “Come on.” Caddy said, “That frog’s gone. He’s hopped way over to the garden, by now. Maybe we’ll see another one.” Roskus came with the milk buckets. He went on. Quentin wasn’t coming with us. He was sitting on the kitchen steps. We went down to Versh’s house. I liked to smell Versh’s house. There was a fire in it and T. P. squatting in his shirt tail in front of it, chunking it into a blaze.
paragraphs.zh: “来吧。”凯蒂说：“那只青蛙不见了。他现在已经跳到花园了。也许我们会看到另一只。”罗斯库斯带着牛奶桶来了。他继续说下去。昆丁没有和我们一起去。他坐在厨房的台阶上。我们去了弗许家。我喜欢闻弗许家的味道。里面着火了，蒂·皮穿着衬衫下摆蹲在火前，把火烧成碎片。

paragraphs.en: Then I got up and T. P. dressed me and we went to the kitchen and ate. Dilsey was singing and I began to cry and she stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 然后我起身，蒂·皮给我穿好衣服，然后我们去厨房吃饭。迪尔西在唱歌，我开始哭，她停了下来。

paragraphs.en: “Keep him away from the house, now.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “现在就让他远离房子。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “We cant go that way.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “我们不能走那条路。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: We played in the branch.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在溪沟玩。

paragraphs.en: “We cant go around yonder.” T. P. said. “Dont you know mammy say we cant.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们不能绕过去。”蒂·皮说。“你不知道妈妈说我们不能。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey was singing in the kitchen and I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西在厨房里唱歌，我开始哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” T. P. said. “Come on. Lets go down to the barn.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”蒂·皮说。“走吧。我们去谷仓吧。”

paragraphs.en: Roskus was milking at the barn. He was milking with one hand, and groaning. Some birds sat on the barn door and watched him. One of them came down and ate with the cows. I watched Roskus milk while T. P. was feeding Queenie and Prince. The calf was in the pig pen. It nuzzled at the wire, bawling.
paragraphs.zh: 罗斯库斯正在谷仓挤奶。他用一只手挤奶，并呻吟着。一些鸟儿停在谷仓门上看着他。其中一个下来和牛一起吃饭。当蒂·皮喂奎妮和普林斯时，我看着罗斯库斯挤奶。小牛在猪圈里。它用鼻子蹭着电线，嚎叫着。

paragraphs.en: “T. P.” Roskus said. T. P. said Sir, in the barn. Fancy held her head over the door, because T. P. hadn’t fed her yet. “Git done there.” Roskus said. “You got to do this milking. I cant use my right hand no more.”
paragraphs.zh: “蒂·皮”罗斯库斯说。蒂·皮先生说，在谷仓里。花式把头靠在门上，因为蒂·皮还没有给她喂饭。“Git 已经完成了。”罗斯库斯说道。“你必须做这个挤奶。我不能再用我的右手了。”

paragraphs.en: T. P. came and milked.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮来挤奶。

paragraphs.en: “Whyn’t you get the doctor.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么不去找医生。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “Doctor cant do no good.” Roskus said. “Not on this place.”
paragraphs.zh: “医生不能无济于事。”罗斯库斯说道。“不在这个地方。”

paragraphs.en: “What wrong with this place.” T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “这个地方出了什么问题。”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: “Taint no luck on this place.” Roskus said. “Turn that calf in if you done.”
paragraphs.zh: “这个地方不要沾染任何运气。”罗斯库斯说道。“如果你完成了，就把那头小牛交出来。”

paragraphs.en: Taint no luck on this place, Roskus said. The fire rose and fell behind him and Versh, sliding on his and Versh’s face. Dilsey finished putting me to bed. The bed smelled like T. P. I liked it.
paragraphs.zh: 罗斯库斯说，这个地方运气不好。火焰在他和弗许身后升起又落下，滑过他和弗许的脸。迪尔西把我哄上床睡觉了。床闻起来有蒂·皮的味道，我喜欢。

paragraphs.en: “What you know about it.” Dilsey said. “What trance you been in.”
paragraphs.zh: “你对此了解多少。”迪尔西说道。“你现在处于什么恍惚状态。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont need no trance.” Roskus said. “Aint the sign of it laying right there on that bed. Aint the sign of it been here for folks to see fifteen years now.”
paragraphs.zh: “不需要恍惚。”罗斯库斯说道。“那张床上不是有它的标志吗？现在人们看到它的标志已经有十五年了。”

paragraphs.en: “Spose it is.” Dilsey said. “It aint hurt none of you and yourn, is it. Versh working and Frony married off your hands and T. P. getting big enough to take your place when rheumatism finish getting you.”
paragraphs.zh: “假设是这样。”迪尔西说道。“这不会伤害你和你的孩子，是吗？弗许工作了，弗罗妮嫁给了你的手，当风湿病彻底治愈你时，蒂·皮变得足够大，可以取代你的位置。”

paragraphs.en: “They been two, now.” Roskus said. “Going to be one more. I seen the sign, and you is too.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在他们是两个人了。”罗斯库斯说道。“又是一个。我看到了这个牌子，你也看到了。”

paragraphs.en: “I heard a squinch owl that night.” T. P. said. “Dan wouldn’t come and get his supper, neither. Wouldn’t come no closer than the barn. Begun howling right after dark. Versh heard him.”
paragraphs.zh: “那天晚上我听到了角猫头鹰的叫声。”蒂·皮说。“丹也不会来吃晚饭。不会比谷仓更近。天黑后就开始嚎叫。弗许听到了他的声音。”

paragraphs.en: “Going to be more than one more.” Dilsey said. “Show me the man what aint going to die, bless Jesus.”
paragraphs.zh: “将会不止一个。”迪尔西说道。“让我看看这个人什么不会死，祝福耶稣。”

paragraphs.en: “Dying aint all.” Roskus said.
paragraphs.zh: “死亡并不是全部。”罗斯库斯说道。

paragraphs.en: “I knows what you thinking.” Dilsey said. “And they aint going to be no luck in saying that name, lessen you going to set up with him while he cries.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道你在想什么。”迪尔西说道。“他们不会很幸运地说出这个名字，减少你在他哭泣时与他交往的机会。”

paragraphs.en: “They aint no luck on this place.” Roskus said. “I seen it at first but when they changed his name I knowed it.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们在这个地方运气不好。”罗斯库斯说道。“我一开始就看到了，但当他们改了名字后我就知道了。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush your mouth.” Dilsey said. She pulled the covers up. It smelled like T. P. “You all shut up now, till he get to sleep.”
paragraphs.zh: “闭嘴。”迪尔西说道。她把被子拉起来。闻起来就像蒂·皮“你们现在都闭嘴，直到他睡觉。”

paragraphs.en: “I seen the sign.” Roskus said.
paragraphs.zh: “我看到了这个标志。”罗斯库斯说道。

paragraphs.en: “Sign T. P. got to do all your work for you.” Dilsey said. Take him and Quentin down to the house and let them play with Luster, where Frony can watch them, T. P., and go and help your pa.
paragraphs.zh: “标志蒂·皮必须为你做所有的工作。”迪尔西说道。带他和昆丁到家里去，让他们和勒斯特一起玩，弗罗妮可以在那里看着他们，蒂·皮，然后去帮助你爸爸。

paragraphs.en: We finished eating. T. P. took Quentin up and we went down to T. P.’s house. Luster was playing in the dirt. T. P. put Quentin down and she played in the dirt too. Luster had some spools and he and Quentin fought and Quentin had the spools. Luster cried and Frony came and gave Luster a tin can to play with, and then I had the spools and Quentin fought me and I cried.
paragraphs.zh: 我们吃完了。蒂·皮带着昆丁上去，我们下楼去了蒂·皮的家。勒斯特正在泥土里玩耍。蒂·皮把昆丁放下，她也在泥土里玩耍。勒斯特有​​一些线轴，他和昆丁打架，昆丁得到了线轴。勒斯特哭了，弗罗妮过来给了勒斯特一个锡罐让他玩，然后我拿着线轴，昆丁和我打架，我哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Frony said, “Aint you shamed of yourself. Taking a baby’s play pretty.” She took the spools from me and gave them back to Quentin.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”弗罗妮说：“你不是为自己感到羞耻吗？把婴儿的游戏看得太漂亮了。”她从我手里拿走了线轴，还给了昆丁。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, now.” Frony said, “Hush, I tell you.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，现在。”弗罗妮说：“嘘，我告诉你。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush up.” Frony said. “You needs whipping, that’s what you needs.” She took Luster and Quentin up. “Come on here.” she said. We went to the barn. T. P. was milking the cow. Roskus was sitting on the box.
paragraphs.zh: “安静点。”弗罗妮说。“你需要鞭打，这就是你所需要的。”她带着勒斯特和昆丁上去。“到这里来吧。”她说。我们去了谷仓。蒂·皮正在给奶牛挤奶。罗斯库斯坐在箱子上。

paragraphs.en: “What’s the matter with him now.” Roskus said.
paragraphs.zh: “他现在怎么了。”罗斯库斯说道。

paragraphs.en: “You have to keep him down here.” Frony said. “He fighting these babies again. Taking they play things. Stay here with T. P. now, and see can you hush a while.”
paragraphs.zh: “你必须把他留在这里。”弗罗妮说。“他又和这些婴儿打架了。带着他们玩东西。现在和蒂·皮呆在这儿，看看你能不能安静一会儿。”

paragraphs.en: “Clean that udder good now.” Roskus said. “You milked that young cow dry last winter. If you milk this one dry, they aint going to be no more milk.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在就把乳房清理干净。”罗斯库斯说道。“去年冬天你把那头小奶牛的奶挤干了。如果你把这头奶牛挤干了，它们就不再是牛奶了。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey was singing.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西在唱歌。

paragraphs.en: “Not around yonder.” T. P. said. “Dont you know mammy say you cant go around there.”
paragraphs.zh: “不在那边。”蒂·皮说。“你不知道妈妈说你不能去那儿吗？”

paragraphs.en: They were singing.
paragraphs.zh: 他们在唱歌。

paragraphs.en: “Come on.” T. P. said. “Lets go play with Quentin and Luster. Come on.”
paragraphs.zh: “来吧。”蒂·皮说。“我们去和昆丁、勒斯特一起玩吧。走吧。”

paragraphs.en: Quentin and Luster were playing in the dirt in front of T. P.’s house. There was a fire in the house, rising and falling, with Roskus sitting black against it.
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁和勒斯特正在蒂·皮家门前的泥土里玩耍。房子里着火了，忽高忽低，罗斯库斯黑色地坐在火边。

paragraphs.en: “That’s three, thank the Lawd.” Roskus said. “I told you two years ago. They aint no luck on this place.”
paragraphs.zh: “这是三个，谢谢法律。”罗斯库斯说道。“我两年前就告诉过你了。他们在这个地方运气不好。”

paragraphs.en: “Whyn’t you get out, then.” Dilsey said. She was undressing me. “Your bad luck talk got them Memphis notions into Versh. That ought to satisfy you.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你为什么不出去。”迪尔西说道。她正在给我脱衣服。“你的霉运之言让他们对孟菲斯观念产生了弗许。这应该让你满意。”

paragraphs.en: “If that all the bad luck Versh have.” Roskus said.
paragraphs.zh: “如果那样的话，弗许就全都倒霉了。”罗斯库斯说道。

paragraphs.en: Frony came in.
paragraphs.zh: 弗罗妮进来了。

paragraphs.en: “You all done.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你们都完成了。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “T. P. finishing up.” Frony said. “Miss Cahline want you to put Quentin to bed.”
paragraphs.zh: “蒂·皮完成了。”弗罗妮说。“卡琳小姐要你哄昆丁上床睡觉。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m coming just as fast as I can.” Dilsey said. “She ought to know by this time I aint got no wings.”
paragraphs.zh: “我会尽快赶来的。”迪尔西说道。“她现在应该知道我没有翅膀了。”

paragraphs.en: “That’s what I tell you.” Roskus said. “They aint no luck going be on no place where one of they own chillens’ name aint never spoke.”
paragraphs.zh: “这就是我告诉你的。”罗斯库斯说道。“如果他们的名字从未被提及，他们就不会走运。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Dilsey said. “Do you want to get him started”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”迪尔西说道。“你想让他开始吗”

paragraphs.en: “Raising a child not to know its own mammy’s name.” Roskus said.
paragraphs.zh: “抚养孩子不知道自己妈妈的名字。”罗斯库斯说道。

paragraphs.en: “Dont you bother your head about her.” Dilsey said. “I raised all of them and I reckon I can raise one more. Hush now. Let him get to sleep if he will.”
paragraphs.zh: “你别为她操心了。”迪尔西说道。“我把它们全都养大了，我想我还能再养一只。现在安静点。如果他愿意的话，就让他去睡觉吧。”

paragraphs.en: “Saying a name.” Frony said. “He dont know nobody’s name.”
paragraphs.zh: “说个名字。”弗罗妮说。“他不知道任何人的名字。”

paragraphs.en: “You just say it and see if he dont.” Dilsey said. “You say it to him while he sleeping and I bet he hear you.”
paragraphs.zh: “你说吧，看他不说。”迪尔西说道。“你在他睡觉的时候对他说这句话，我打赌他会听到。”

paragraphs.en: “He know lot more than folks thinks.” Roskus said. “He knowed they time was coming, like that pointer done. He could tell you when hisn coming, if he could talk. Or yours. Or mine.”
paragraphs.zh: “他知道的比人们想象的要多得多。”罗斯库斯说道。“他知道他们的时间即将到来，就像那个指针一样。如果他能说话，他就能告诉你他什么时候来。或者你的。或者我的。”

paragraphs.en: “You take Luster outen that bed, mammy.” Frony said. “That boy conjure him.”
paragraphs.zh: “你把勒斯特从床上带出来，妈妈。”弗罗妮说。“那个男孩召唤了他。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush your mouth.” Dilsey said, “Aint you got no better sense than that. What you want to listen to Roskus for, anyway. Get in, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “闭嘴。”迪尔西说：“你就没有比这更明智的了。无论如何，你想听罗斯库斯的事。上车，班吉。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey pushed me and I got in the bed, where Luster already was. He was asleep. Dilsey took a long piece of wood and laid it between Luster and me. “Stay on your side now.” Dilsey said “Luster little, and you don’t want to hurt him.”
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西推了我一把，我就上了床，勒斯特已经在床上了。他睡着了。迪尔西拿了一根长木头，把它放在勒斯特和我之间。“现在就站在你这边吧。”迪尔西说：“勒斯特很小，你不想伤害他。”

paragraphs.en: You can’t go yet, T. P. said. Wait.
paragraphs.zh: 你还不能走，蒂·皮说。等待。

paragraphs.en: We looked around the corner of the house and watched the carriages go away.
paragraphs.zh: 我们环顾房子的拐角处，看着马车远去。

paragraphs.en: “Now.” T. P. said. He took Quentin up and we ran down to the corner of the fence and watched them pass. “There he go,” T. P. said. “See that one with the glass in it. Look at him. He laying in there. See him.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在。”蒂·皮说。他把昆丁抱起来，我们跑到栅栏的一角，看着他们经过。“他走了，”蒂·皮说。“看看那个里面装着玻璃的。看看他。他躺在那里。看到他。”

paragraphs.en: Come on, Luster said, I going to take this here ball down home, where I wont lose it. Naw, sir, you cant have it. If them men sees you with it, they’ll say you stole it. Hush up, now. You cant have it. What business you got with it. You cant play no ball.
paragraphs.zh: 来吧，勒斯特说，我要把这个球带回家，在那里我不会失去它。不，先生，你不能拥有它。如果那些人看到你拿着它，他们会说你偷了它。安静点，现在。你不能拥有它。你拿它做什么生意。你不能不打球。

paragraphs.en: Frony and T. P. were playing in the dirt by the door. T. P. had lightning bugs in a bottle.
paragraphs.zh: 弗罗妮和蒂·皮正在门边的泥土里玩耍。蒂·皮的瓶子里有闪电虫。

paragraphs.en: “How did you all get back out.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “你们都是怎么回来的。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “We’ve got company.” Caddy said. “Father said for us to mind me tonight. I expect you and T. P. will have to mind me too.”
paragraphs.zh: “我们有同伴。”凯蒂说。“父亲让我们今晚照顾我。我希望你和蒂·皮也必须照顾我。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m not going to mind you.” Jason said. “Frony and T. P. dont have to either.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不会介意你的。”杰生说道。“弗罗妮和蒂·皮也不必这么做。”

paragraphs.en: “They will if I say so.” Caddy said. “Maybe I wont say for them to.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果我这么说，他们就会的。”凯蒂说。“也许我不会让他们这么做。”

paragraphs.en: “T. P. dont mind nobody.” Frony said. “Is they started the funeral yet.”
paragraphs.zh: “蒂·皮不介意任何人。”弗罗妮说。“葬礼开始了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “What’s a funeral.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “什么是葬礼。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “Didn’t mammy tell you not to tell them.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈没告诉你不要告诉他们吗？”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “Where they moans.” Frony said. “They moaned two days on Sis Beulah Clay.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们呻吟的地方。”弗罗妮说。“他们在比尤拉·克莱姐妹身上呻吟了两天。”

paragraphs.en: They moaned at Dilsey’s house. Dilsey was moaning. When Dilsey moaned Luster said, Hush, and we hushed, and then I began to cry and Blue howled under the kitchen steps. Then Dilsey stopped and we stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 他们在迪尔西家里呻吟。迪尔西呻吟着。当迪尔西呻吟着时，勒斯特说：“嘘，我们就安静吧，然后我开始哭泣，布鲁在厨房的台阶下嚎叫。”然后迪尔西停了下来，我们也停了下来。

paragraphs.en: “Oh.” Caddy said, “That’s niggers. White folks dont have funerals.”
paragraphs.zh: “哦。”凯蒂说：“那是黑鬼。白人没有葬礼。”

paragraphs.en: “Mammy said us not to tell them, Frony.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈让我们不要告诉他们，弗罗妮。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “Tell them what.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “告诉他们什么。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: Dilsey moaned, and when it got to the place I began to cry and Blue howled under the steps. Luster, Frony said in the window, Take them down to the barn. I cant get no cooking done with all that racket. That hound too. Get them outen here.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西呻吟着，当它到达那个地方时，我开始哭泣，布鲁在台阶下嚎叫。勒斯特，弗罗妮在窗口说，带他们去谷仓。这么吵闹我根本没法做饭。那只猎犬也是。把他们带出去。

paragraphs.en: I aint going down there, Luster said. I might meet pappy down there. I seen him last night, waving his arms in the barn.
paragraphs.zh: 我不会去那里，勒斯特说。我可能会在那里遇见爸爸。昨晚我看见他在谷仓里挥舞着双臂。

paragraphs.en: “I like to know why not.” Frony said. “White folks dies too. Your grandmammy dead as any nigger can get, I reckon.”
paragraphs.zh: “我想知道为什么不。”弗罗妮说。“白人也会死。我想，你的祖母死得像任何一个黑鬼一样。”

paragraphs.en: “Dogs are dead.” Caddy said, “And when Nancy fell in the ditch and Roskus shot her and the buzzards came and undressed her.”
paragraphs.zh: “狗都死了。”凯蒂说：“当南希掉进沟里，罗斯库斯开枪射杀她时，秃鹰就来了，脱掉了她的衣服。”

paragraphs.en: The bones rounded out of the ditch, where the dark vines were in the black ditch, into the moonlight, like some of the shapes had stopped. Then they all stopped and it was dark, and when I stopped to start again I could hear Mother, and feet walking fast away, and I could smell it. Then the room came, but my eyes went shut. I didn’t stop. I could smell it. T. P. unpinned the bed clothes.
paragraphs.zh: 那些骨头从沟里滚出，黑色的沟里有黑色的藤蔓，融入到月光里，像是有一些形状停了下来。然后他们都停了下来，天黑了，当我停下来重新开始时，我能听到母亲的声音，脚步声快步走开，我能闻到它的味道。然后房间来了，但我的眼睛闭上了。我没有停下来。我能闻到它的味道。蒂·皮解开床上的衣服。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” he said, “Shhhhhhhh.”
But I could smell it. T. P. pulled me up and he put on my clothes fast.
paragraphs.zh: 但我能闻到它的味道。蒂·皮把我拉起来，飞快地给我穿上衣服。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Benjy.” he said. “We going down to our house. You want to go down to our house, where Frony is. Hush. Shhhhh.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”他说。“我们去我们家。你想去我们家，弗罗妮在那里。嘘。嘘。”

paragraphs.en: He laced my shoes and put my cap on and we went out. There was a light in the hall. Across the hall we could hear Mother.
paragraphs.zh: 他给我系好鞋带，戴上帽子，我们就出去了。大厅里亮着灯。穿过大厅我们就能听到母亲的声音。

paragraphs.en: “Shhhhhh, Benjy.” T. P. said, “We’ll be out in a minute.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”蒂·皮说：“我们一会儿就出去。”

paragraphs.en: A door opened and I could smell it more than ever, and a head came out. It wasn’t Father. Father was sick there.
paragraphs.zh: 一扇门打开了，我比以往任何时候都能闻到更浓的气味，一个头探了出来。那不是父亲。父亲在那里病了。

paragraphs.en: “Can you take him out of the house.”
paragraphs.zh: “你能把他带出家门吗？”

paragraphs.en: “That’s where we going.” T. P. said. Dilsey came up the stairs.
paragraphs.zh: “这就是我们要去的地方。”蒂·皮说。迪尔西走上楼梯。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” she said, “Hush. Take him down home, T. P. Frony fixing him a bed. You all look after him, now. Hush, Benjy. Go on with T. P.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”她说：“嘘。带他回家吧，蒂·皮·弗罗妮正在给他准备一张床。现在你们都照顾他。嘘，班吉。继续和蒂·皮在一起吧。”

paragraphs.en: She went where we could hear Mother.
paragraphs.zh: 她走到我们能听到母亲声音的地方。

paragraphs.en: “Better keep him there.” It wasn’t Father. He shut the door, but I could still smell it.
paragraphs.zh: “最好把他留在那里。”那不是父亲。他关上了门，但我仍然能闻到那股味道。

paragraphs.en: We went down stairs. The stairs went down into the dark and T. P. took my hand, and we went out the door, out of the dark. Dan was sitting in the back yard, howling.
paragraphs.zh: 我们下了楼梯。楼梯下到黑暗中，蒂·皮拉着我的手，我们出了门，走出了黑暗。丹坐在后院里嚎叫着。

paragraphs.en: “He smell it.” T. P. said. “Is that the way you found it out.”
paragraphs.zh: “他闻到了。”蒂·皮说。“你就是这么发现的。”

paragraphs.en: We went down the steps, where our shadows were.
paragraphs.zh: 我们走下台阶，那里有我们的影子。

paragraphs.en: “I forgot your coat.” T. P. said. “You ought to had it. But I aint going back.”
paragraphs.zh: “我忘了你的外套。”蒂·皮说。“你应该拥有它。但我不会回去。”

paragraphs.en: Dan howled.
paragraphs.zh: 丹嚎叫起来。

paragraphs.en: “Hush now.” T. P. said. Our shadows moved, but Dan’s shadow didn’t move except to howl when he did.
paragraphs.zh: “现在安静点。”蒂·皮说。我们的影子动了，但丹的影子却一动不动，只是在他动的时候嚎叫起来。

paragraphs.en: “I cant take you down home, bellering like you is.” T. P. said. “You was bad enough before you got that bullfrog voice. Come on.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不能带你回家，像你这样大喊大叫。”蒂·皮说。“在你发出牛蛙般的声音之前，你就已经够糟糕了。来吧。”

paragraphs.en: We went along the brick walk, with our shadows. The pig pen smelled like pigs. The cow stood in the lot, chewing at us. Dan howled.
paragraphs.zh: 我们带着自己的影子沿着砖砌的小路走着。猪圈里有猪的味道。那头牛站在空地上，咀嚼着我们。丹嚎叫着。

paragraphs.en: “You going to wake the whole town up.” T. P. said. “Cant you hush.”
paragraphs.zh: “你会把整个小镇都吵醒的。”蒂·皮说。“你能不能安静点。”

paragraphs.en: We saw Fancy, eating by the branch. The moon shone on the water when we got there.
paragraphs.zh: 我们看到花式在溪沟旁吃东西。当我们到达那里时，月亮照在水面上。

paragraphs.en: “Naw, sir.” T. P. said, “This too close. We cant stop here. Come on. Now, just look at you. Got your whole leg wet. Come on, here.” Dan howled.
paragraphs.zh: “不，先生。”蒂·皮说：“太近了。我们不能停在这里。来吧。现在，看看你。你的整条腿都湿了。来吧，这里。”丹嚎叫着。

paragraphs.en: The ditch came up out of the buzzing grass. The bones rounded out of the black vines.
paragraphs.zh: 沟渠从嗡嗡作响的草丛中升起。骨头从黑色的藤蔓中伸出来。

paragraphs.en: “Now.” T. P. said. “Beller your head off if you want to. You got the whole night and a twenty acre pasture to beller in.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在。”蒂·皮说。“贝勒，如果你愿意的话，你就别想了。你可以享受整个晚上和二十英亩的牧场。”

paragraphs.en: T. P. lay down in the ditch and I sat down, watching the bones where the buzzards ate Nancy, flapping black and slow and heavy out of the ditch.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮躺在沟里，我坐下来，看着秃鹰吃掉南希的骨头，黑色的翅膀缓慢而沉重地从沟里飞了出来。

paragraphs.en: I had it when we was down here before, Luster said. I showed it to you. Didn’t you see it. I took it out of my pocket right here and showed it to you.
paragraphs.zh: “我们以前来这儿的时候我就吃过它，”勒斯特说。我给你看了。你没看到吗。我就在这里从口袋里拿出它给你看。

paragraphs.en: “Do you think buzzards are going to undress Damuddy.” Caddy said. “You’re crazy.”
paragraphs.zh: “你以为秃鹰会脱外婆的衣服吗？”凯蒂说。“你疯了。”

paragraphs.en: “You’re a skizzard.” Jason said. He began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: “你是一只雪橇犬。”杰生说道。他开始哭泣。

paragraphs.en: “You’re a knobnot.” Caddy said. Jason cried. His hands were in his pockets.
paragraphs.zh: “你就是个旋钮。”凯蒂说。杰生哭了。他的双手插在口袋里。

paragraphs.en: “Jason going to be rich man.” Versh said. “He holding his money all the time.”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生要成为有钱人了。”弗许说道。“他一直拿着钱。”

paragraphs.en: Jason cried.
paragraphs.zh: 杰生哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Now you’ve got him started.” Caddy said. “Hush up, Jason. How can buzzards get in where Damuddy is. Father wouldn’t let them. Would you let a buzzard undress you. Hush up, now.”
