paragraphs.zh: “现在你已经让他开始了。”凯蒂说。“杰生，小声点。外婆那里，秃鹰怎么可能进来。爸爸不让。你让秃鹰脱你的衣服好吗？快给我安静点。”

paragraphs.en: Jason hushed. “Frony said it was a funeral.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: 杰生沉默了。“弗罗妮说这是一场葬礼。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Well it’s not.” Caddy said. “It’s a party. Frony dont know anything about it. He wants your lightning bugs, T. P. Let him hold it a while.”
paragraphs.zh: “嗯，不是的。”凯蒂说。“这是一个聚会。弗罗妮对此一无所知。他想要你的闪电虫，蒂·皮让他持有一会儿。”

paragraphs.en: T. P. gave me the bottle of lightning bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮给了我一瓶闪电虫。

paragraphs.en: “I bet if we go around to the parlor window we can see something.” Caddy said. “Then you’ll believe me.”
paragraphs.zh: “我敢打赌，如果我们绕到客厅的窗户，我们就能看到一些东西。”凯蒂说。“那你就相信我了。”

paragraphs.en: “I already knows.” Frony said. “I dont need to see.”
paragraphs.zh: “我已经知道了。”弗罗妮说。“我不需要看。”

paragraphs.en: “You better hush your mouth, Frony.” Versh said. “Mammy going whip you.”
paragraphs.zh: “你最好闭嘴，弗罗妮。”弗许说道。“妈妈要鞭打你了。”

paragraphs.en: “What is it.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “那是什么。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I knows what I knows.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “我知道我所知道的。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “Come on.” Caddy said, “Let’s go around to the front.”
paragraphs.zh: “来吧。”凯蒂说：“我们绕到前面去吧。”

paragraphs.en: We started to go.
paragraphs.zh: 我们开始出发。

paragraphs.en: “T. P. wants his lightning bugs.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “蒂·皮想要他的闪电虫。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “Let him hold it a while longer, T. P.” Caddy said. “We’ll bring it back.”
paragraphs.zh: “让他再坚持一会儿，蒂·皮”凯蒂说。“我们会把它带回来。”

paragraphs.en: “You all never caught them.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “你们都没有抓住他们。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “If I say you and T. P. can come too, will you let him hold it.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我说你和蒂·皮也可以来，你会让他拿着吗。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Aint nobody said me and T. P. got to mind you.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “没有人说我，蒂·皮会介意你。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “If I say you dont have to, will you let him hold it.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “如果我说不用，你就让他拿着吧。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “All right.” Frony said. “Let him hold it, T. P. We going to watch them moaning.”
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”弗罗妮说。“让他握住它，蒂·皮，我们要看着他们呻吟。”

paragraphs.en: “They aint moaning.” Caddy said. “I tell you it’s a party. Are they moaning, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们没有呻吟。”凯蒂说。“我告诉你这是一个聚会。他们在呻吟吗，弗许。”

paragraphs.en: “We aint going to know what they doing, standing here.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “我们不会知道他们站在这里做什么。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “Come on.” Caddy said. “Frony and T. P. dont have to mind me. But the rest of us do. You better carry him, Versh. It’s getting dark.”
paragraphs.zh: “来吧。”凯蒂说。“弗罗妮和蒂·皮不必介意我。但我们其他人会介意。弗许，你最好抱着他。天快黑了。”

paragraphs.en: Versh took me up and we went on around the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许把我抱起来，我们继续绕着厨房走。

paragraphs.en: When we looked around the corner we could see the lights coming up the drive. T. P. went back to the cellar door and opened it.
paragraphs.zh: 当我们环顾拐角处时，我们可以看到车道上有灯光。蒂·皮回到地窖门并打开它。

paragraphs.en: You know what’s down there, T. P. said. Soda water. I seen Mr Jason come up with both hands full of them. Wait here a minute.
paragraphs.zh: 你知道下面有什么，蒂·皮说。汽水。我看到杰生先生双手捧满了它们。在这里等一下。

paragraphs.en: T. P. went and looked in the kitchen door. Dilsey said, What are you peeping in here for. Where’s Benjy.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮走到厨房门里看去。迪尔西说，你偷看这里做什么。班吉在哪里。

paragraphs.en: He out here, T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: 他在这里，蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: Go on and watch him, Dilsey said. Keep him out the house now.
paragraphs.zh: 继续看着他，迪尔西说。现在把他赶出家门。

paragraphs.en: Yessum, T. P. said. Is they started yet.
paragraphs.zh: 是的，蒂·皮说。他们开始了吗？

paragraphs.en: You go on and keep that boy out of sight, Dilsey said. I got all I can tend to.
paragraphs.zh: “你继续，让那个男孩远离我的视线，”迪尔西说。我已经得到了我能做的一切。

paragraphs.en: A snake crawled out from under the house. Jason said he wasn’t afraid of snakes and Caddy said he was but she wasn’t and Versh said they both were and Caddy said to be quiet, like father said.
paragraphs.zh: 一条蛇从房子下面爬了出来。杰生说他不怕蛇，凯蒂说他害怕，但她不怕，弗许说他们都害怕，凯蒂说要安静，就像父亲说的那样。

paragraphs.en: You aint got to start bellering now, T. P. said. You want some this sassprilluh.
paragraphs.zh: “你现在不必开始咆哮，”蒂·皮说。你想要一些这种sassrilluh。

paragraphs.en: It tickled my nose and eyes.
paragraphs.zh: 它让我的鼻子和眼睛发痒。

paragraphs.en: If you aint going to drink it, let me get to it, T. P. said. All right, here tis. We better get another bottle while aint nobody bothering us. You be quiet, now.
paragraphs.zh: “如果你不打算喝的话，那就让我来喝吧，”蒂·皮说。好吧，这里是。我们最好再买一瓶，趁没人打扰我们。你现在安静点。

paragraphs.en: We stopped under the tree by the parlor window. Versh set me down in the wet grass. It was cold. There were lights in all the windows.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在客厅窗边的树下停了下来。弗许把我放在湿漉漉的草地上。天气很冷。所有的窗户都亮着灯。

paragraphs.en: “That’s where Damuddy is.” Caddy said. “She’s sick every day now. When she gets well we’re going to have a picnic.”
paragraphs.zh: “那就是外婆所在的地方。”凯蒂说。“她现在每天都生病。等她康复了，我们就去野餐。”

paragraphs.en: “I knows what I knows.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “我知道我所知道的。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: The trees were buzzing, and the grass.
paragraphs.zh: 树木嗡嗡作响，草地也嗡嗡作响。

paragraphs.en: “The one next to it is where we have the measles.” Caddy said. “Where do you and T. P. have the measles, Frony.”
paragraphs.zh: “旁边的那个就是我们感染麻疹的地方。”凯蒂说。“弗罗妮，你和蒂·皮哪里得麻疹了。”

paragraphs.en: “Has them just wherever we is, I reckon.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “我想无论我们在哪里都有它们。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “They haven’t started yet.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “他们还没有开始。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: They getting ready to start, T. P. said. You stand right here now while I get that box so we can see in the window. Here, les finish drinking this here sassprilluh. It make me feel just like a squinch owl inside.
paragraphs.zh: “他们正准备出发，”蒂·皮说。我去拿那个盒子的时候你站在这里，这样我们就可以从窗户里看到。在这里，les 喝完这里的sassrilluh。这让我感觉自己就像一只内陷的猫头鹰。

paragraphs.en: We drank the sassprilluh and T. P. pushed the bottle through the lattice, under the house, and went away. I could hear them in the parlor and I clawed my hands against the wall. T. P. dragged the box. He fell down, and he began to laugh. He lay there, laughing into the grass. He got up and dragged the box under the window, trying not to laugh.
paragraphs.zh: 我们喝了萨斯普里鲁酒，蒂·皮把瓶子推过格子，推到房子下面，然后就走了。我在客厅里能听到他们的声音，我把手抓在墙上。蒂·皮拖着盒子。他摔倒了，然后开始大笑。他躺在那里，对着草地大笑。他起身，把盒子拖到窗下，强忍着不笑。

paragraphs.en: “I skeered I going to holler.” T. P. said. “Git on the box and see is they started.”
paragraphs.zh: “我本来想大声喊叫。”蒂·皮说。“打开盒子，看看他们是否开始了。”

paragraphs.en: “They haven’t started because the band hasn’t come yet.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “他们还没有开始，因为乐队还没有来。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “They aint going to have no band.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “他们不会没有乐队。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “How do you know.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “你怎么知道。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “I knows what I knows.” Frony said.
paragraphs.zh: “我知道我所知道的。”弗罗妮说。

paragraphs.en: “You dont know anything.” Caddy said. She went to the tree. “Push me up, Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “你什么都不知道。”凯蒂说。她走向那棵树。“弗许，推我起来。”

paragraphs.en: “Your paw told you to stay out that tree.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “你的爪子告诉你不要靠近那棵树。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “That was a long time ago.” Caddy said. “I expect he’s forgotten about it. Besides, he said to mind me tonight. Didn’t he say to mind me tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “那是很久以前的事了。”凯蒂说。“我想他已经忘了这件事了。再说了，他说过今晚要管我的。他不是说过今晚要管我的吗。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m not going to mind you.” Jason said. “Frony and T. P. are not going to either.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不会介意你的。”杰生说道。“弗罗妮和蒂·皮也不会去。”

paragraphs.en: “Push me up, Versh.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “弗许，推我起来。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “All right.” Versh said. “You the one going to get whipped. I aint.” He went and pushed Caddy up into the tree to the first limb. We watched the muddy bottom of her drawers. Then we couldn’t see her. We could hear the tree thrashing.
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”弗许说道。“你会被鞭打。我不会。”他走过去把凯蒂推到树的第一根树枝上。我们看着她抽屉底部的泥泞。然后我们就看不见她了。我们能听到树的摇晃声。

paragraphs.en: “Mr Jason said if you break that tree he whip you.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “杰生先生说，如果你打破那棵树，他就会鞭打你。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “I’m going to tell on her too.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我也要告发她。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: The tree quit thrashing. We looked up into the still branches.
paragraphs.zh: 树停止了摇晃。我们抬头望向静止的树枝。

paragraphs.en: “What you seeing.” Frony whispered.
paragraphs.zh: “你看到了什么。”弗罗妮低声说道。

paragraphs.en: I saw them. Then I saw Caddy, with flowers in her hair, and a long veil like shining wind. Caddy Caddy
paragraphs.zh: 我看到他们了。然后我看到了凯蒂，她的头发上插着鲜花，长长的头纱像风一样闪闪发光。凯蒂凯蒂

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” T. P. said, “They going to hear you. Get down quick.” He pulled me. Caddy. I clawed my hands against the wall Caddy. T. P. pulled me.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”蒂·皮说：“他们会听到你的。快下来。”他拉了我。凯蒂。我用手抓着凯蒂的墙。蒂·皮拉了我。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” he said, “Hush. Come on here quick.” He pulled me on. Caddy “Hush up, Benjy. You want them to hear you. Come on, les drink some more sassprilluh, then we can come back if you hush. We better get one more bottle or we both be hollering. We can say Dan drunk it. Mr Quentin always saying he so smart, we can say he sassprilluh dog, too.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”他说：“嘘。快点过来。”他拉着我。凯蒂“安静点，班吉。你想让他们听到你的声音。来吧，我们再喝点sassprelluh，如果你安静的话我们就可以回来。我们最好再拿一瓶，否则我们俩都会大喊大叫。我们可以说丹喝了它。昆丁先生总是说他很聪明，我们也可以说他是sassprelluh狗。”

paragraphs.en: The moonlight came down the cellar stairs. We drank some more sassprilluh.
paragraphs.zh: 月光从地窖的楼梯上洒下来。我们又喝了一些sassrilluh。

paragraphs.en: “You know what I wish.” T. P. said. “I wish a bear would walk in that cellar door. You know what I do. I walk right up to him and spit in he eye. Gimme that bottle to stop my mouth before I holler.”
paragraphs.zh: “你知道我的愿望。”蒂·皮说。“我希望有一只熊走进那个地窖门。你知道我做了什么。我径直走到他面前，朝他的眼睛吐口水。在我喊叫之前，把瓶子给我，让我闭嘴。”

paragraphs.en: T. P. fell down. He began to laugh, and the cellar door and the moonlight jumped away and something hit me.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮摔倒了。他开始大笑，地窖门和月光跳开了，有什么东西击中了我。

paragraphs.en: “Hush up.” T. P. said, trying not to laugh, “Lawd, they’ll all hear us. Get up.” T. P. said, “Get up, Benjy, quick.” He was thrashing about and laughing and I tried to get up. The cellar steps ran up the hill in the moonlight and T. P. fell up the hill, into the moonlight, and I ran against the fence and T. P. ran behind me saying “Hush up hush up” Then he fell into the flowers, laughing, and I ran into the box. But when I tried to climb onto it it jumped away and hit me on the back of the head and my throat made a sound. It made the sound again and I stopped trying to get up, and it made the sound again and I began to cry. But my throat kept on making the sound while T. P. was pulling me. It kept on making it and I couldn’t tell if I was crying or not, and T. P. fell down on top of me, laughing, and it kept on making the sound and Quentin kicked T. P. and Caddy put her arms around me, and her shining veil, and I couldn’t smell trees anymore and I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: “安静点。”蒂·皮强忍着不笑，说道：“老天，他们都会听到我们的。起来吧。”蒂·皮说：“班吉，快起来。”他又打又笑，我试图站起来。地窖的台阶在月光下跑上山，蒂·皮掉到山上，掉进月光里，我跑到栅栏上，蒂·皮跑到我后面说“嘘嘘嘘”然后他掉进花丛里，笑着，我跑进了盒子里。但当我试图爬上它时，它跳开了，击中了我的后脑勺，我的喉咙发出了声音。它又发出声音，我不再试图站起来，它又发出声音，我开始哭泣。但蒂·皮拉着我的时候，我的喉咙一直发出声音。它继续发出声音，我不知道我是否在哭，蒂·皮倒在我身上，笑着，它继续发出声音，昆丁踢蒂·皮，凯蒂用她的手臂搂住我，还有她闪亮的面纱，我再也闻不到树的味道了，我开始哭。

paragraphs.en: Benjy, Caddy said, Benjy. She put her arms around me again, but I went away. “What is it, Benjy.” she said, “Is it this hat.” She took her hat off and came again, and I went away.
paragraphs.zh: 班吉，凯蒂说，班吉。她再次用双臂搂住我，但我却走开了。“什么事啊，班吉。”她说：“是这顶帽子吗？”她摘下帽子又来了，我就走了。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” she said, “What is it, Benjy. What has Caddy done.”
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”她说：“班吉，这是什么？凯蒂做了什么。”

paragraphs.en: “He dont like that prissy dress.” Jason said. “You think you’re grown up, dont you. You think you’re better than anybody else, dont you. Prissy.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不喜欢那件过于拘谨的衣服。”杰生说道。“你认为你已经长大了，不是吗。你认为你比其他人都优秀，不是吗。普里西。”

paragraphs.en: “You shut your mouth.” Caddy said, “You dirty little beast. Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “你闭嘴。”凯蒂说：“你这个肮脏的小畜生。班吉。”

paragraphs.en: “Just because you are fourteen, you think you’re grown up, dont you.” Jason said. “You think you’re something. Dont you.”
paragraphs.zh: “就因为你十四岁了，你就觉得自己长大了，不是吗？”杰生说道。“你以为你很了不起。不是吗。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Benjy.” Caddy said. “You’ll disturb Mother. Hush.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”凯蒂说。“你会打扰妈妈的。嘘。”

paragraphs.en: But I didn’t hush, and when she went away I followed, and she stopped on the stairs and waited and I stopped too.
paragraphs.zh: 但我并没有安静下来，当她走开时，我也跟着走，她在楼梯上停了下来，等待着，我也停了下来。

paragraphs.en: “What is it, Benjy.” Caddy said, “Tell Caddy. She’ll do it. Try.”
paragraphs.zh: “什么事啊，班吉。”凯蒂说：“告诉凯蒂。她会做到的。试试吧。”

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Why are you teasing him.” Mother said. “Bring him here.”
paragraphs.zh: “你为什么要捉弄他。”妈妈说。“把他带到这里来。”

paragraphs.en: We went to Mother’s room, where she was lying with the sickness on a cloth on her head.
paragraphs.zh: 我们去了母亲的房间，她躺在那里，头上盖着布，病痛缠身。

paragraphs.en: “What is the matter now.” Mother said. “Benjamin.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在是怎么回事。”妈妈说。“本杰明。”

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” Caddy said. She came again, but I went away.
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”凯蒂说。她又来了，我却走了。

paragraphs.en: “You must have done something to him.” Mother said. “Why wont you let him alone, so I can have some peace. Give him the box and please go on and let him alone.”
paragraphs.zh: “你肯定对他做了什么。”妈妈说。“你为什么不让他一个人呆着，这样我就可以安心了。把盒子给他，请继续，让他一个人呆着。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy got the box and set it on the floor and opened it. It was full of stars. When I was still, they were still. When I moved, they glinted and sparkled. I hushed.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂拿起盒子，把它放在地板上，然后打开它。里面布满了星星。当我静止时，他们也静止。当我移动时，它们闪闪发光。我沉默了。

paragraphs.en: Then I heard Caddy walking and I began again.
paragraphs.zh: 然后我听到凯蒂走路的声音，我又开始了。

paragraphs.en: “Benjamin.” Mother said, “Come here.” I went to the door. “You, Benjamin.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “本杰明。”妈妈说：“过来吧。”我走到门口。“你，本杰明。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “What is it now.” Father said, “Where are you going.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在怎么样了。”父亲说：“你要去哪里？”

paragraphs.en: “Take him downstairs and get someone to watch him, Jason.” Mother said. “You know I’m ill, yet you”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生，把他带到楼下，让人看管他。”妈妈说。“你知道我病了，但你”

paragraphs.en: Father shut the door behind us.
paragraphs.zh: 父亲关上了我们身后的门。

paragraphs.en: “T. P.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “蒂·皮”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Sir.” T. P. said downstairs.
paragraphs.zh: “先生。”蒂·皮在楼下说道。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy’s coming down.” Father said. “Go with T. P.”
paragraphs.zh: “班吉要下来了。”父亲说。“和蒂·皮一起去”

paragraphs.en: I went to the bathroom door. I could hear the water.
paragraphs.zh: 我走到浴室门口。我能听到水声。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” T. P. said downstairs.
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”蒂·皮在楼下说道。

paragraphs.en: I could hear the water. I listened to it.
paragraphs.zh: 我能听到水声。我听了。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” T. P. said downstairs.
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”蒂·皮在楼下说道。

paragraphs.en: I listened to the water.
paragraphs.zh: 我听着水声。

paragraphs.en: I couldn’t hear the water, and Caddy opened the door.
paragraphs.zh: 我听不到水声，凯蒂打开了门。

paragraphs.en: “Why, Benjy.” she said. She looked at me and I went and she put her arms around me. “Did you find Caddy again.” she said. “Did you think Caddy had run away.” Caddy smelled like trees.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么，班吉。”她说。她看着我，我走了过去，她用双臂搂住了我。“你又找到凯蒂了吗？”她说。“你以为凯蒂逃跑了吗？”凯蒂闻起来像树。

paragraphs.en: We went to Caddy’s room. She sat down at the mirror. She stopped her hands and looked at me.
paragraphs.zh: 我们去了凯蒂的房间。她在镜子前坐下。她停下了双手，看着我。

paragraphs.en: “Why, Benjy. What is it.” she said. “You mustn’t cry. Caddy’s not going away. See here.” she said. She took up the bottle and took the stopper out and held it to my nose. “Sweet. Smell. Good.”
paragraphs.zh: “为什么，班吉。这是什么？”她说。“你不许哭。凯蒂不会消失。看这里。”她说。她拿起瓶子，拔掉瓶塞，放在我的鼻子边。“甜。闻起来。好。”

paragraphs.en: I went away and I didn’t hush, and she held the bottle in her hand, looking at me.
paragraphs.zh: 我走开了，我没有安静，她手里拿着瓶子，看着我。

paragraphs.en: “Oh.” she said. She put the bottle down and came and put her arms around me. “So that was it. And you were trying to tell Caddy and you couldn’t tell her. You wanted to, but you couldn’t, could you. Of course Caddy wont. Of course Caddy wont. Just wait till I dress.”
paragraphs.zh: “哦。”她说。她放下瓶子，过来用双臂搂住我。“就是这样。你想告诉凯蒂，但你不能告诉她。你想告诉，但你不能，可以吗？当然凯蒂不会。当然凯蒂不会。等我穿好衣服再说。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy dressed and took up the bottle again and we went down to the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂穿好衣服，再次拿起瓶子，我们去了厨房。

paragraphs.en: “Dilsey.” Caddy said, “Benjy’s got a present for you.” She stooped down and put the bottle in my hand. “Hold it out to Dilsey, now.” Caddy held my hand out and Dilsey took the bottle.
paragraphs.zh: “迪尔西。”凯蒂说：“班吉给你准备了一份礼物。”她弯下腰，把瓶子放在我手里。“现在就交给迪尔西吧。”凯蒂伸出我的手，迪尔西接过瓶子。

paragraphs.en: “Well I’ll declare.” Dilsey said, “If my baby aint give Dilsey a bottle of perfume. Just look here, Roskus.”
paragraphs.zh: “那我就宣布吧。”迪尔西说：“如果我的宝贝不给迪尔西一瓶香水。看看这里，罗斯库斯。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy smelled like trees. “We dont like perfume ourselves.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂闻起来像树。“我们自己不喜欢香水。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: She smelled like trees.
paragraphs.zh: 她闻起来像树。

paragraphs.en: “Come on, now.” Dilsey said, “You too big to sleep with folks. You a big boy now. Thirteen years old. Big enough to sleep by yourself in Uncle Maury’s room.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，现在。”迪尔西说道：“你太大了，不能和人一起睡。你现在已经是个大男孩了。十三岁了。大到可以自己睡在莫里舅舅的房间里了。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: Uncle Maury was sick. His eye was sick, and his mouth. Versh took his supper up to him on the tray.
paragraphs.zh: 莫里舅舅生病了。他的眼睛有病，他的嘴也有病。弗许把托盘里的晚饭端到他面前。

paragraphs.en: “Maury says he’s going to shoot the scoundrel.” Father said. “I told him he’d better not mention it to Patterson before hand.” He drank.
paragraphs.zh: “莫里说他要枪杀这个恶棍。”父亲说。“我告诉他最好不要事先向帕特森提起这件事。”他喝了。

paragraphs.en: “Jason.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “杰生。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Shoot who, Father.” Quentin said. “What’s Uncle Maury going to shoot him for.”
paragraphs.zh: “开枪打死谁，神父。”昆丁说道。“莫里舅舅为什么要开枪打他。”

paragraphs.en: “Because he couldn’t take a little joke.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “因为他开不起小玩笑。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “Jason.” Mother said, “How can you. You’d sit right there and see Maury shot down in ambush, and laugh.”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生。”母亲说：“你怎么能这样呢？你就坐在那儿，看着莫里被埋伏击倒，还笑呢。”

paragraphs.en: “Then Maury’d better stay out of ambush.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “那莫里最好别被埋伏。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “Shoot who, Father.” Quentin said, “Who’s Uncle Maury going to shoot.”
paragraphs.zh: “开枪打死谁，神父。”昆丁道：“莫里舅舅要对谁开枪。”

paragraphs.en: “Nobody.” Father said. “I dont own a pistol.”
paragraphs.zh: “没人。”父亲说。“我没有手枪。”

paragraphs.en: Mother began to cry. “If you begrudge Maury your food, why aren’t you man enough to say so to his face. To ridicule him before the children, behind his back.”
paragraphs.zh: 母亲开始哭泣。“如果你吝惜莫里的食物，你为什么没有足够的男子气概当着他的面这么说。在孩子们面前嘲笑他，在他的背后嘲笑他。”

paragraphs.en: “Of course I dont.” Father said, “I admire Maury. He is invaluable to my own sense of racial superiority. I wouldn’t swap Maury for a matched team. And do you know why, Quentin.”
paragraphs.zh: “我当然不知道。”父亲说：“我钦佩莫里。他对我自己的种族优越感来说是无价的。我不会用莫里去换一个匹配的球队。你知道为什么吗，昆丁。”

paragraphs.en: “No, sir.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “不，先生。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: “Et ego in arcadia I have forgotten the latin for hay.” Father said. “There, there.” he said, “I was just joking.” He drank and set the glass down and went and put his hand on Mother’s shoulder.
paragraphs.zh: “在阿卡迪亚，我忘记了拉丁语中的干草。”父亲说。“那里，那里。”他说：“我只是开玩笑。”他喝了一口，放下杯子，走过去，把手搭在母亲的肩膀上。

paragraphs.en: “It’s no joke.” Mother said. “My people are every bit as well born as yours. Just because Maury’s health is bad.”
paragraphs.zh: “这不是玩笑。”妈妈说。“我的族人出生得和你的族人一样好。只是因为莫里的身体不好。”

paragraphs.en: “Of course.” Father said. “Bad health is the primary reason for all life. Created by disease, within putrefaction, into decay. Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “当然。”父亲说。“健康状况不佳是所有生命的主要原因。由疾病造成，在腐烂中，进入腐烂。弗许。”

paragraphs.en: “Sir.” Versh said behind my chair.
paragraphs.zh: “先生。”弗许在我的椅子后面说道。

paragraphs.en: “Take the decanter and fill it.”
paragraphs.zh: “把瓶子拿来，装满。”

paragraphs.en: “And tell Dilsey to come and take Benjamin up to bed.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “并告诉迪尔西过来带本杰明上床睡觉。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “You a big boy.” Dilsey said, “Caddy tired sleeping with you. Hush now, so you can go to sleep.” The room went away, but I didn’t hush, and the room came back and Dilsey came and sat on the bed, looking at me.
paragraphs.zh: “你真是个大男孩了。”迪尔西说：“凯蒂和你一起睡很累了。嘘，你可以去睡觉了。”房间消失了，但我没有安静，房间又回来了，迪尔西过来坐在床上，看着我。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you going to be a good boy and hush.” Dilsey said. “You aint, is you. See can you wait a minute, then.”
paragraphs.zh: “你是不是会做一个好孩子，安静点。”迪尔西说道。“你不是，就是你。那你能等一下吗？”

paragraphs.en: She went away. There wasn’t anything in the door. Then Caddy was in it.
paragraphs.zh: 她走了。门里什么也没有。然后凯蒂就在其中。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Caddy said. “I’m coming.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”凯蒂说。“我来了。”

paragraphs.en: I hushed and Dilsey turned back the spread and Caddy got in between the spread and the blanket. She didn’t take off her bathrobe.
paragraphs.zh: 我安静下来，迪尔西把床单翻开，凯蒂则站在床单和毯子之间。她没有脱掉浴袍。

paragraphs.en: “Now.” she said, “Here I am.” Dilsey came with a blanket and spread it over her and tucked it around her.
paragraphs.zh: “现在。”她说：“我在这里。”迪尔西拿来一条毯子，给她盖上，盖在她身上。

paragraphs.en: “He be gone in a minute.” Dilsey said. “I leave the light on in your room.”
paragraphs.zh: “他一会儿就走。”迪尔西说道。“我让你房间里的灯开着。”

paragraphs.en: “All right.” Caddy said. She snuggled her head beside mine on the pillow. “Goodnight, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “好吧。”凯蒂说。她把头靠在我的枕头上。“晚安，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “Goodnight, honey.” Dilsey said. The room went black. Caddy smelled like trees.
paragraphs.zh: “晚安，亲爱的。”迪尔西说道。房间一片漆黑。凯蒂闻起来像树。

paragraphs.en: We looked up into the tree where she was.
paragraphs.zh: 我们抬头望向她所在的那棵树。

paragraphs.en: “What she seeing, Versh.” Frony whispered.
paragraphs.zh: “她看到了什么，弗许。”弗罗妮低声说道。

paragraphs.en: “Shhhhhhh.” Caddy said in the tree. Dilsey said,
paragraphs.zh: “嘘嘘。”凯蒂在树上说道。迪尔西说，

paragraphs.en: “You come on here.” She came around the corner of the house. “Whyn’t you all go on up stairs, like your paw said, stead of slipping out behind my back. Where’s Caddy and Quentin.”
paragraphs.zh: “你过来一下。”她从房子的拐角处走过来。“为什么你们不都上楼去，就像你们爪子说的那样，而不是背着我溜出去。凯蒂和昆丁在哪里。”

paragraphs.en: “I told her not to climb up that tree.” Jason said. “I’m going to tell on her.”
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉她不要爬那棵树。”杰生说道。“我要告发她。”

paragraphs.en: “Who in what tree.” Dilsey said. She came and looked up into the tree. “Caddy.” Dilsey said. The branches began to shake again.
paragraphs.zh: “谁在哪棵树上。”迪尔西说道。她走过来，抬头看着树。“凯蒂。”迪尔西说道。树枝又开始摇晃。

paragraphs.en: “You, Satan.” Dilsey said. “Come down from there.”
paragraphs.zh: “你，撒旦。”迪尔西说道。“从那里下来吧。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Caddy said, “Dont you know Father said to be quiet.” Her legs came in sight and Dilsey reached up and lifted her out of the tree.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”凯蒂说：“你不知道父亲说过要保持安静吗？”她的双腿出现在眼前，迪尔西伸手将她从树上抱了出来。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you got any better sense than to let them come around here.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你有没有比让他们来这里更明智的做法呢？”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “I couldn’t do nothing with her.” Versh said.
paragraphs.zh: “我对她无能为力。”弗许说道。

paragraphs.en: “What you all doing here.” Dilsey said. “Who told you to come up to the house.”
paragraphs.zh: “你们都在这里做什么。”迪尔西说道。“谁叫你到家里来的。”

paragraphs.en: “She did.” Frony said. “She told us to come.”
paragraphs.zh: “她做到了。”弗罗妮说。“她叫我们来的。”

paragraphs.en: “Who told you you got to do what she say.” Dilsey said. “Get on home, now.” Frony and T. P. went on. We couldn’t see them when they were still going away.
paragraphs.zh: “谁告诉你你必须按她说的做。”迪尔西说道。“现在就回家吧。”弗罗妮和蒂·皮继续说道。当他们还在走的时候我们就看不到他们了。

paragraphs.en: “Out here in the middle of the night.” Dilsey said. She took me up and we went to the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: “半夜就到这里来了。”迪尔西说道。她把我抱起来，我们去了厨房。

paragraphs.en: “Slipping out behind my back.” Dilsey said. “When you knowed it’s past your bedtime.”
paragraphs.zh: “背着我溜出去。”迪尔西说道。“当你知道已经过了睡觉时间的时候。”

paragraphs.en: “Shhhh, Dilsey.” Caddy said. “Dont talk so loud. We’ve got to be quiet.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，迪尔西。”凯蒂说。“别这么大声。我们必须保持安静。”

paragraphs.en: “You hush your mouth and get quiet, then.” Dilsey said. “Where’s Quentin.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你就闭嘴，安静点。”迪尔西说道。“昆丁在哪儿。”

paragraphs.en: “Quentin’s mad because he had to mind me tonight.” Caddy said. “He’s still got T. P.’s bottle of lightning bugs.”
paragraphs.zh: “昆丁很生气，因为他今晚必须管我。”凯蒂说。“他还保留着蒂·皮的那瓶闪电虫。”

paragraphs.en: “I reckon T. P. can get along without it.” Dilsey said. “You go and find Quentin, Versh. Roskus say he seen him going towards the barn.” Versh went on. We couldn’t see him.
paragraphs.zh: “我想蒂·皮没有它也能过得去。”迪尔西说道。“弗许，你去找昆丁。罗斯库斯说他看到他朝谷仓走去。”弗许继续说道。我们看不到他。

paragraphs.en: “They’re not doing anything in there.” Caddy said. “Just sitting in chairs and looking.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们在那里什么也没做。”凯蒂说。“只是坐在椅子上看。”

paragraphs.en: “They dont need no help from you all to do that.” Dilsey said. We went around the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: “他们不需要你们所有人的帮助就能做到这一点。”迪尔西说道。我们绕着厨房转了一圈。

paragraphs.en: Where you want to go now, Luster said. You going back to watch them knocking ball again. We done looked for it over there. Here. Wait a minute. You wait right here while I go back and get that ball. I done thought of something.
paragraphs.zh: “你现在想去哪里，”勒斯特说。你回去看他们再次击球。我们在那里找到了。这里。等一下。你就在这里等着，我回去拿球。我确实想到了一件事。

paragraphs.en: The kitchen was dark. The trees were black on the sky. Dan came waddling out from under the steps and chewed my ankle. I went around the kitchen, where the moon was. Dan came scuffling along, into the moon.
paragraphs.zh: 厨房里很暗。天空中的树木是黑色的。丹摇摇晃晃地从台阶下走出来，咬住了我的脚踝。我绕着厨房转了一圈，那里有月亮。丹拖着脚步，走进了月亮。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” T. P. said in the house.
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”蒂·皮在屋里说道。

paragraphs.en: The flower tree by the parlor window wasn’t dark, but the thick trees were. The grass was buzzing in the moonlight where my shadow walked on the grass.
paragraphs.zh: 客厅窗边的花树并不黑暗，但茂密的树木却很黑暗。月光下，小草嗡嗡作响，我的影子在草地上行走。

paragraphs.en: “You, Benjy.” T. P. said in the house. “Where you hiding. You slipping off. I knows it.”
paragraphs.zh: “你，班吉。”蒂·皮在屋里说道。“你藏在哪里。你溜走了。我知道。”

paragraphs.en: Luster came back. Wait, he said. Here. Dont go over there. Miss Quentin and her beau in the swing yonder. You come on this way. Come back here, Benjy.
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特回来了。等等，他说。这里。别去那里。昆丁小姐和她的男友在那边的秋千上。你就这样过来吧。回来吧，班吉。

paragraphs.en: It was dark under the trees. Dan wouldn’t come. He stayed in the moonlight. Then I could see the swing and I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 树下天黑了。丹不会来。他留在了月光下。然后我看到了秋千，我开始哭了。

paragraphs.en: Come away from there, Benjy, Luster said. You know Miss Quentin going to get mad.
paragraphs.zh: 离开那里，班吉，勒斯特说。你知道昆丁小姐会生气的。

paragraphs.en: It was two now, and then one in the swing. Caddy came fast, white in the darkness.
paragraphs.zh: 现在是两个，然后是秋千上的一个。凯蒂来得很快，在黑暗中显得苍白。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy,” she said. “How did you slip out. Where’s Versh.”
paragraphs.zh: “班吉，”她说。“你怎么溜出去的。弗许呢。”

paragraphs.en: She put her arms around me and I hushed and held to her dress and tried to pull her away.
paragraphs.zh: 她用双臂搂住我，我安静下来，抓住她的衣服，试图把她拉开。

paragraphs.en: “Why, Benjy.” she said. “What is it. T. P.” she called.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么，班吉。”她说。“这是什么。蒂·皮”她喊道。

paragraphs.en: The one in the swing got up and came, and I cried and pulled Caddy’s dress.
paragraphs.zh: 秋千上的人起身过来，我哭着拉扯凯蒂的衣服。

paragraphs.en: “Benjy.” Caddy said. “It’s just Charlie. Dont you know Charlie.”
paragraphs.zh: “班吉。”凯蒂说。“这只是查理。你不认识查理吗。”

paragraphs.en: “Where’s his nigger.” Charlie said. “What do they let him run around loose for.”
paragraphs.zh: “他的黑鬼在哪儿？”查理说。“他们让他到处乱跑干什么？”

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Benjy.” Caddy said. “Go away, Charlie. He doesn’t like you.” Charlie went away and I hushed. I pulled at Caddy’s dress.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”凯蒂说。“走开，查理。他不喜欢你。”查理走了，我沉默了。我拉着凯蒂的裙子。

paragraphs.en: “Why, Benjy.” Caddy said. “Aren’t you going to let me stay here and talk to Charlie awhile.”
paragraphs.zh: “为什么，班吉。”凯蒂说。“你不让我留在这里和查理谈谈吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Call that nigger.” Charlie said. He came back. I cried louder and pulled at Caddy’s dress.
paragraphs.zh: “叫那个黑鬼。”查理说。他回来了。我哭得更大声，拉扯凯蒂的裙子。

paragraphs.en: “Go away, Charlie.” Caddy said. Charlie came and put his hands on Caddy and I cried more. I cried loud.
paragraphs.zh: “走开，查理。”凯蒂说。查理走过来，把手放在凯蒂身上，我哭得更厉害了。我大声哭了。

paragraphs.en: “No, no.” Caddy said. “No. No.”
paragraphs.zh: “不，不。”凯蒂说。“不，不。”

paragraphs.en: “He cant talk.” Charlie said. “Caddy.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不会说话。”查理说。“凯蒂。”

paragraphs.en: “Are you crazy.” Caddy said. She began to breathe fast. “He can see. Dont. Dont.” Caddy fought. They both breathed fast. “Please. Please.” Caddy whispered.
paragraphs.zh: “你疯了吗？”凯蒂说。她开始呼吸急促。“他能看见。看不到。看不到。”凯蒂战斗了。两人的呼吸都急促起来。“求你了。求你了。”凯蒂小声说道。

paragraphs.en: “Send him away.” Charlie said.
paragraphs.zh: “把他送走吧。”查理说。

paragraphs.en: “I will.” Caddy said. “Let me go.”
paragraphs.zh: “我会的。”凯蒂说。“放开我。”

paragraphs.en: “Will you send him away.” Charlie said.
paragraphs.zh: “你送他走吧。”查理说。

paragraphs.en: “Yes.” Caddy said. “Let me go.” Charlie went away. “Hush.” Caddy said. “He’s gone.” I hushed. I could hear her and feel her chest going.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”凯蒂说。“放开我。”查理走了。“嘘。”凯蒂说。“他走了。”我沉默了。我能听到她的声音，感觉到她的胸口在跳动。

paragraphs.en: “I’ll have to take him to the house.” she said. She took my hand. “I’m coming.” she whispered.
paragraphs.zh: “我得带他去家里。”她说。她握住我的手。“我来了。”她低声说道。

paragraphs.en: “Wait.” Charlie said. “Call the nigger.”
paragraphs.zh: “等等。”查理说。“叫黑鬼来。”

paragraphs.en: “No.” Caddy said. “I’ll come back. Come on, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “不。”凯蒂说。“我会回来的。加油，班吉。”

paragraphs.en: “Caddy.” Charlie whispered, loud. We went on. “You better come back. Are you coming back.” Caddy and I were running. “Caddy.” Charlie said. We ran out into the moonlight, toward the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: “凯蒂。”查理大声低声说道。我们继续前行。“你最好回来。你回来吗？”凯蒂和我正在跑步。“凯蒂。”查理说。我们趁着月光跑向厨房。

paragraphs.en: “Caddy.” Charlie said.
paragraphs.zh: “凯蒂。”查理说。

paragraphs.en: Caddy and I ran. We ran up the kitchen steps, onto the porch, and Caddy knelt down in the dark and held me. I could hear her and feel her chest. “I wont.” she said. “I wont anymore, ever. Benjy. Benjy.” Then she was crying, and I cried, and we held each other. “Hush.” she said. “Hush. I wont anymore.” So I hushed and Caddy got up and we went into the kitchen and turned the light on and Caddy took the kitchen soap and washed her mouth at the sink, hard. Caddy smelled like trees.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂和我跑了。我们跑上厨房的台阶，跑到门廊上，凯蒂在黑暗中跪下来抱住我。我能听到她的声音并感觉到她的胸部。“我不会。”她说。“我不会了，永远不会了。班吉。班吉。”然后她哭了，我也哭了，我们抱在一起。“嘘。”她说。“嘘。我不会再这样了。”于是我安静下来，凯蒂站起来，我们走进厨房，打开灯，凯蒂拿起厨房肥皂，在水槽边用力地漱口。凯蒂闻起来像树。

paragraphs.en: I kept a telling you to stay away from there, Luster said. They sat up in the swing, quick. Quentin had her hands on her hair. He had a red tie.
paragraphs.zh: “我一直告诉你要远离那里，”勒斯特说。他们很快就在秋千上坐了起来。昆丁把手放在头发上。他有一条红色领带。

paragraphs.en: You old crazy loon, Quentin said. I’m going to tell Dilsey about the way you let him follow everywhere I go. I’m going to make her whip you good.
paragraphs.zh: “你这个老疯子，”昆丁说。我要告诉迪尔西，你让他跟着我到处走。我会让她好好鞭打你。

paragraphs.en: “I couldn’t stop him.” Luster said. “Come on here, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “我无法阻止他。”勒斯特说。“班吉，过来一下。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes you could.” Quentin said. “You didn’t try. You were both snooping around after me. Did Grandmother send you all out here to spy on me.” She jumped out of the swing. “If you dont take him right away this minute and keep him away, I’m going to make Jason whip you.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，你可以。”昆丁说道。“你们没有尝试，你们都在监视我。难道是祖母派你们来监视我的。”她从秋千上跳了下来。“如果你现在不立即把他带走并远离他，我会让杰生鞭打你。”

paragraphs.en: “I cant do nothing with him.” Luster said. “You try it if you think you can.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不能对他做什么。”勒斯特说。“如果你认为可以的话，你就试试吧。”

paragraphs.en: “Shut your mouth.” Quentin said. “Are you going to get him away.”
paragraphs.zh: “闭嘴。”昆丁说道。“你要赶他走吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Ah, let him stay.” he said. He had a red tie. The sun was red on it. “Look here, Jack.” He struck a match and put it in his mouth. Then he took the match out of his mouth. It was still burning. “Want to try it.” he said. I went over there. “Open your mouth.” he said. I opened my mouth. Quentin hit the match with her hand and it went away.
paragraphs.zh: “啊，就让他留下吧。”他说。他有一条红色领带。太阳照在上面，是红色的。“看这里，杰克。”他划了一根火柴，放进嘴里。然后他把火柴从嘴里拿出来。它仍然在燃烧。“想尝试一下。”他说。我去了那里。“张开嘴。”他说。我张开嘴。昆丁用手划火柴，火柴就消失了。

paragraphs.en: “Goddamn you.” Quentin said. “Do you want to get him started. Dont you know he’ll beller all day. I’m going to tell Dilsey on you.” She went away running.
paragraphs.zh: “该死的你。”昆丁说道。“你想让他开始吗？你不知道他会整天吵闹吗？我要把你的事告诉迪尔西。”她跑开了。

paragraphs.en: “Here, kid.” he said. “Hey. Come on back. I aint going to fool with him.”
paragraphs.zh: “在这里，孩子。”他说。“嘿。回来吧。我不会跟他开玩笑的。”

paragraphs.en: Quentin ran on to the house. She went around the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁跑进屋。她在厨房里转了一圈。

paragraphs.en: “You played hell then, Jack.” he said. “Aint you.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你就玩得很尽兴了，杰克。”他说。“不是你吗。”

paragraphs.en: “He cant tell what you saying.” Luster said. “He deef and dumb.”
paragraphs.zh: “他听不懂你在说什么。”勒斯特说。“他又聋又哑。”

paragraphs.en: “Is.” he said. “How long’s he been that way.”
paragraphs.zh: “是。”他说。“他这样多久了。”

paragraphs.en: “Been that way thirty-three years today.” Luster said. “Born looney. Is you one of them show folks.”
paragraphs.zh: “今天已经这样三十三年了。”勒斯特说。“天生疯子。你是表演者之一吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Why.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “为什么。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “I dont ricklick seeing you around here before.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我以前从来没有在这儿见过你。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Well, what about it.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “嗯，那又怎样呢。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Nothing.” Luster said. “I going tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “没什么。”勒斯特说。“我今晚就去。”

paragraphs.en: He looked at me.
paragraphs.zh: 他看着我。

paragraphs.en: “You aint the one can play a tune on that saw, is you.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “能用那把锯子弹奏曲子的人不是你，是你。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “It’ll cost you a quarter to find that out.” he said. He looked at me. “Why dont they lock him up.” he said. “What’d you bring him out here for.”
paragraphs.zh: “你要花二十五美分硬币的时间才能找到答案。”他说。他看着我。“他们为什么不把他锁起来。”他说。“你带他来这里干什么。”

paragraphs.en: “You aint talking to me.” Luster said. “I cant do nothing with him. I just come over here looking for a quarter I lost so I can go to the show tonight. Look like now I aint going to get to go.” Luster looked on the ground. “You aint got no extra quarter, is you.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “你不跟我说话。”勒斯特说。“我对他无能为力。我只是来这里寻找我失去的二十五美分硬币，这样我就可以去看今晚的演出。看起来现在我不打算走了。”勒斯特看着地面。“你没有多余的硬币，是吗？”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “No.” he said. “I aint.”
paragraphs.zh: “不。”他说。“我不是。”

paragraphs.en: “I reckon I just have to find that other one, then.” Luster said. He put his hand in his pocket. “You dont want to buy no golf ball neither, does you.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我想我只需要找到另一个了。”勒斯特说。他把手伸进口袋。“你也不想买高尔夫球，不是吗。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “What kind of ball.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “什么样的球。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Golf ball.” Luster said. “I dont want but a quarter.”
paragraphs.zh: “高尔夫球。”勒斯特说。“我只想要二十五美分硬币。”

paragraphs.en: “What for.” he said. “What do I want with it.”
paragraphs.zh: “干什么。”他说。“我想要它做什么。”

paragraphs.en: “I didn’t think you did.” Luster said. “Come on here, mulehead.” he said. “Come on here and watch them knocking that ball. Here. Here something you can play with along with that jimson weed.” Luster picked it up and gave it to me. It was bright.
paragraphs.zh: “我没想到你这么做了。”勒斯特说。“过来吧，骡子。”他说。“过来，看他们敲那个球。这里。这里有一些你可以和曼陀罗一起玩的东西。”勒斯特捡起它并交给了我。天很亮。

paragraphs.en: “Where’d you get that.” he said. His tie was red in the sun, walking.
paragraphs.zh: “你从哪里得到的。”他说。他走路时的领带在阳光下呈红色。

paragraphs.en: “Found it under this here bush.” Luster said. “I thought for a minute it was that quarter I lost.”
paragraphs.zh: “在这灌木丛下找到的。”勒斯特说。“我想了一分钟，这就是我输掉的那个二十五美分硬币。”

paragraphs.en: He came and took it.
paragraphs.zh: 他过来拿走了它。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Luster said. “He going to give it back when he done looking at it.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”勒斯特说。“他看完后会把它还给我。”

paragraphs.en: “Agnes Mabel Becky.” he said. He looked toward the house.
paragraphs.zh: “艾格尼丝·梅布尔·贝基。”他说。他看向房子。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Luster said. “He fixing to give it back.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”勒斯特说。“他决定把它还给我。”

paragraphs.en: He gave it to me and I hushed.
paragraphs.zh: 他把它给了我，我沉默了。

paragraphs.en: “Who come to see her last night.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “昨晚谁来看她了。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “I dont know.” Luster said. “They comes every night she can climb down that tree. I dont keep no track of them.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道。”勒斯特说。“他们每天晚上都会来，她可以从那棵树上爬下来。我没有记录他们的踪迹。”

paragraphs.en: “Damn if one of them didn’t leave a track.” he said. He looked at the house. Then he went and lay down in the swing. “Go away.” he said. “Dont bother me.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果其中一个没有留下痕迹就该死。”他说。他看着房子。然后他走过去躺在秋千上。“离开。”他说。“别打扰我。”

paragraphs.en: “Come on here.” Luster said. “You done played hell now. Time Miss Quentin get done telling on you.”
paragraphs.zh: “到这里来吧。”勒斯特说。“你现在已经玩够了。昆丁小姐也该别再告发你了。”

paragraphs.en: We went to the fence and looked through the curling flower spaces. Luster hunted in the grass.
paragraphs.zh: 我们走到栅栏前，透过卷曲的花丛往外看。勒斯特在草地上寻找。

paragraphs.en: “I had it right here.” he said. I saw the flag flapping, and the sun slanting on the broad grass.
paragraphs.zh: “我就在这里。”他说。我看见旗帜在飘扬，阳光斜照在宽阔的草地上。

paragraphs.en: “They’ll be some along soon.” Luster said. “There some now, but they going away. Come on and help me look for it.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们很快就会来的。”勒斯特说。“现在有一些，但他们已经消失了。来帮我找找吧。”

paragraphs.en: We went along the fence.
paragraphs.zh: 我们沿着栅栏走。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Luster said. “How can I make them come over here, if they aint coming. Wait. They’ll be some in a minute. Look yonder. Here they come.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”勒斯特说。“如果他们不来，我怎么能让他们到这里来。等等。他们一会儿就会来的。看那边。他们来了。”

paragraphs.en: I went along the fence, to the gate, where the girls passed with their booksatchels. “You, Benjy.” Luster said. “Come back here.”
paragraphs.zh: 我沿着栅栏走到门口，女孩们拿着书包从那里经过。“你，班吉。”勒斯特说。“回到这里吧。”

paragraphs.en: You cant do no good looking through the gate, T. P. said. Miss Caddy done gone long ways away. Done got married and left you. You cant do no good, holding to the gate and crying. She cant hear you.
paragraphs.zh: 蒂·皮说，从大门往外看是没有好处的。凯蒂小姐已经走得很远了。多恩结婚了，离开了你。你不能做任何事，抱着门哭。她听不到你说话。

paragraphs.en: What is it he wants, T. P. Mother said. Cant you play with him and keep him quiet.
paragraphs.zh: “他想要什么？”蒂·皮妈妈说。你不能和他一起玩并让他保持安静吗？

paragraphs.en: He want to go down yonder and look through the gate, T. P. said.
paragraphs.zh: “他想去那边看看，”蒂·皮说。

paragraphs.en: Well, he cannot do it, Mother said. It’s raining. You will just have to play with him and keep him quiet. You, Benjamin.
paragraphs.zh: 好吧，他做不到，妈妈说。下雨了。你只需要和他一起玩并让他保持安静。你，本杰明。

paragraphs.en: Aint nothing going to quiet him, T. P. said. He think if he down to the gate, Miss Caddy come back.
paragraphs.zh: 没有什么能让他安静下来，蒂·皮说。他想如果他到了大门，凯蒂小姐就会回来。

paragraphs.en: Nonsense, Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: 胡说，妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: I could hear them talking. I went out the door and I couldn’t hear them, and I went down to the gate, where the girls passed with their booksatchels. They looked at me, walking fast, with their heads turned. I tried to say, but they went on, and I went along the fence, trying to say, and they went faster. Then they were running and I came to the corner of the fence and I couldn’t go any further, and I held to the fence, looking after them and trying to say.
paragraphs.zh: 我能听到他们说话。我出了门，听不到他们的声音，然后我走到门口，女孩们拿着书包从那里经过。他们扭着头看着我，快步走着。我试图说，但他们继续前进，我沿着栅栏走，试图说，他们走得更快。然后他们就跑了，我来到了栅栏的角落，我不能再往前走了，我扶着栅栏，看着他们，试图说些什么。

paragraphs.en: “You, Benjy.” T. P. said. “What you doing, slipping out. Dont you know Dilsey whip you.”
paragraphs.zh: “你，班吉。”蒂·皮说。“你在做什么，溜出去。你不知道迪尔西会鞭打你吗。”

paragraphs.en: “You cant do no good, moaning and slobbering through the fence.” T. P. said. “You done skeered them chillen. Look at them, walking on the other side of the street.”
paragraphs.zh: “隔着栅栏呻吟、流口水，你不可能做任何事。”蒂·皮说。“你已经让他们冷了。看看他们，走在街道的另一边。”

paragraphs.en: How did he get out, Father said. Did you leave the gate unlatched when you came in, Jason.
paragraphs.zh: 父亲说，他是怎么出去的？杰生，你进来的时候没有关门吗？

paragraphs.en: Of course not, Jason said. Dont you know I’ve got better sense than to do that. Do you think I wanted anything like this to happen. This family is bad enough, God knows. I could have told you, all the time. I reckon you’ll send him to Jackson, now. If Mrs Burgess dont shoot him first.
paragraphs.zh: 当然不是，杰生说。难道你不知道我比这样做更明智吗？你认为我希望这样的事情发生吗？这个家庭已经够糟糕了，天知道。我本可以一直告诉你。我想你现在会把他送到杰克逊去。如果伯吉斯夫人不先开枪打死他的话。

paragraphs.en: Hush, Father said.
paragraphs.zh: 嘘，父亲说。

paragraphs.en: I could have told you, all the time, Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我本可以一直告诉你，”杰生说。

paragraphs.en: It was open when I touched it, and I held to it in the twilight. I wasn’t crying, and I tried to stop, watching the girls coming along in the twilight. I wasn’t crying.
paragraphs.zh: 当我触碰它时，它已经打开了，我在暮色中握住了它。我没有哭，我试图停下来，看着女孩们在暮色中走过来。我没有哭。

paragraphs.en: “There he is.”
paragraphs.zh: “他在那儿。”

paragraphs.en: They stopped.
paragraphs.zh: 他们停了下来。

paragraphs.en: “He cant get out. He wont hurt anybody, anyway. Come on.”
paragraphs.zh: “他出不去。反正他不会伤害任何人。来吧。”

paragraphs.en: “I’m scared to. I’m scared. I’m going to cross the street.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不敢。我很害怕。我要过马路。”

paragraphs.en: “He cant get out.”
paragraphs.zh: “他出不去。”

paragraphs.en: I wasn’t crying.
paragraphs.zh: 我没有哭。

paragraphs.en: “Dont be a ’fraid cat. Come on.”
paragraphs.zh: “别做一只‘害怕的猫’。来吧。”

paragraphs.en: They came on in the twilight. I wasn’t crying, and I held to the gate. They came slow.
paragraphs.zh: 他们在暮色中赶来。我没有哭，我紧紧抓住门。他们来得很慢。

paragraphs.en: “I’m scared.”
paragraphs.zh: “我很害怕。”

paragraphs.en: “He wont hurt you. I pass here every day. He just runs along the fence.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不会伤害你。我每天都经过这里。他只是沿着栅栏跑。”

paragraphs.en: They came on. I opened the gate and they stopped, turning. I was trying to say, and I caught her, trying to say, and she screamed and I was trying to say and trying and the bright shapes began to stop and I tried to get out. I tried to get it off of my face, but the bright shapes were going again. They were going up the hill to where it fell away and I tried to cry. But when I breathed in, I couldn’t breathe out again to cry, and I tried to keep from falling off the hill and I fell off the hill into the bright, whirling shapes.
paragraphs.zh: 他们来了。我打开门，他们停下来，转身。我试图说话，我抓住了她，试图说话，她尖叫起来，我试图说话，尝试，明亮的形状开始停止，我试图逃脱。我试图把它从脸上抹掉，但明亮的形状又消失了。他们正在上山，直到山塌下来的地方，我想哭。但当我吸气时，我再也无法呼气哭泣，我努力避免从山上掉下来，结果我从山上掉下来，变成了明亮的、旋转的形状。

paragraphs.en: Here, loony, Luster said. Here come some. Hush your slobbering and moaning, now.
paragraphs.zh: 在这里，疯子，勒斯特说。来一些。现在就别流口水和呻吟了。

paragraphs.en: They came to the flag. He took it out and they hit, then he put the flag back.
paragraphs.zh: 他们来到了旗帜面前。他把旗子拿出来，他们打了，然后他把旗子放了回去。

paragraphs.en: “Mister.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “先生。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: He looked around. “What.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: 他环顾四周。“什么。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Want to buy a golf ball.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “想买一个高尔夫球。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Let’s see it.” he said. He came to the fence and Luster reached the ball through.
paragraphs.zh: “让我们看看吧。”他说。他来到了围栏边，勒斯特将球击了过去。

paragraphs.en: “Where’d you get it.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “你从哪里得到的。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “Found it.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “找到了。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “I know that.” he said. “Where. In somebody’s golf bag.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道。”他说。“在哪里。在某人的高尔夫球包里。”

paragraphs.en: “I found it laying over here in the yard.” Luster said. “I’ll take a quarter for it.”
paragraphs.zh: “我发现它就在院子里。”勒斯特说。“我愿意花二十五美分硬币的钱。”

paragraphs.en: “What makes you think it’s yours.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “是什么让你认为这是你的。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “I found it.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我找到了。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Then find yourself another one.” he said. He put it in his pocket and went away.
paragraphs.zh: “那你再找一个吧。”他说。他把它放进口袋里就走了。

paragraphs.en: “I got to go to that show tonight.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “今晚我必须去看那个演出。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “That so.” he said. He went to the table. “Fore, caddie.” he said. He hit.
paragraphs.zh: “原来如此。”他说。他走到桌边。“前排，球童。”他说。他击中了。

paragraphs.en: “I’ll declare.” Luster said. “You fusses when you dont see them and you fusses when you does. Why cant you hush. Dont you reckon folks gets tired of listening to you all the time. Here. You dropped your jimson weed.” He picked it up and gave it back to me. “You needs a new one. You ’bout wore that one out.” We stood at the fence and watched them.
paragraphs.zh: “我宣布。”勒斯特说。“当你看不到他们时，你会大惊小怪，当你看到他们时，你也会大惊小怪。你为什么不能安静点。你不认为人们已经厌倦了一直听你说话。在这里。你把你的曼森草掉了。”他把它捡起来并还给了我。“你需要一件新的。你快把那件穿坏了。”我们站在栅栏旁看着他们。

paragraphs.en: “That white man hard to get along with.” Luster said. “You see him take my ball.” They went on. We went on along the fence. We came to the garden and we couldn’t go any further. I held to the fence and looked through the flower spaces. They went away.
paragraphs.zh: “那个白人很难相处。”勒斯特说。“你看到他拿走了我的球。”他们继续前行。我们沿着栅栏继续前行。我们来到花园，不能再往前走了。我扶着栅栏，透过花丛往外看。他们走了。

paragraphs.en: “Now you aint got nothing to moan about.” Luster said. “Hush up. I the one got something to moan over, you aint. Here. Whyn’t you hold on to that weed. You be bellering about it next.” He gave me the flower. “Where you heading now.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在你没有什么可抱怨的了。”勒斯特说。“闭嘴。我是有事要抱怨的，你不是。在这里。你为什么不抓住那棵大麻呢。接下来你就为它大喊大叫。”他把花给了我。“你现在要去哪里。”

paragraphs.en: Our shadows were on the grass. They got to the trees before we did. Mine got there first. Then we got there, and then the shadows were gone. There was a flower in the bottle. I put the other flower in it.
paragraphs.zh: 草地上有我们的影子。他们比我们先到树上。我的先到了。然后我们到了那里，然后影子就消失了。瓶子里有一朵花。我把另一朵花放进去。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you a grown man, now.” Luster said. “Playing with two weeds in a bottle. You know what they going to do with you when Miss Cahline die. They going to send you to Jackson, where you belong. Mr Jason say so. Where you can hold the bars all day long with the rest of the looneys and slobber. How you like that.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在你是不是一个成年人了。”勒斯特说。“在瓶子里玩两根野草。你知道卡琳小姐死后他们会怎么处理你。他们会把你送到杰克逊，你所属的地方。杰生先生这么说。在那里你可以和其他疯子和流口水的人一起整天拿着酒吧。你多么喜欢这样。”

paragraphs.en: Luster knocked the flowers over with his hand. “That’s what they’ll do to you at Jackson when you starts bellering.”
paragraphs.zh: 勒斯特用手把花打翻了。“当你开始咆哮时，这就是杰克逊他们会对你做的事情。”

paragraphs.en: I tried to pick up the flowers. Luster picked them up, and they went away. I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 我试着去摘花。勒斯特把他们抱起来，然后他们就走了。我开始哭泣。

paragraphs.en: “Beller.” Luster said. “Beller. You want something to beller about. All right, then. Caddy.” he whispered. “Caddy. Beller now. Caddy.”
paragraphs.zh: “贝勒。”勒斯特说。“贝勒。你想要一些值得贝勒的事情。好吧，凯蒂。”他低声说道。“凯蒂。现在是贝勒。凯蒂。”

paragraphs.en: “Luster.” Dilsey said from the kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: “勒斯特。”迪尔西在厨房里说道。

paragraphs.en: The flowers came back.
paragraphs.zh: 花又回来了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Luster said. “Here they is. Look. It’s fixed back just like it was at first. Hush, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”勒斯特说。“他们在这里。看。它又像原来一样固定回去了。嘘，现在。”

paragraphs.en: “You, Luster.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你，勒斯特。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Luster said. “We coming. You done played hell. Get up.” He jerked my arm and I got up. We went out of the trees. Our shadows were gone.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”勒斯特说。“我们来了。你玩完了。起来吧。”他猛地拉动我的手臂，我站了起来。我们走出了树林。我们的影子消失了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Luster said. “Look at all them folks watching you. Hush.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”勒斯特说。“看看那些人都在看着你。嘘。”

paragraphs.en: “You bring him on here.” Dilsey said. She came down the steps.
paragraphs.zh: “你把他带到这里来。”迪尔西说道。她走下台阶。

paragraphs.en: “What you done to him now.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “你现在对他做了什么。”她说。

paragraphs.en: “Aint done nothing to him.” Luster said. “He just started bellering.”
paragraphs.zh: “没有对他做什么。”勒斯特说。“他刚刚开始咆哮。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes you is.” Dilsey said. “You done something to him. Where you been.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，你是。”迪尔西说道。“你对他做了什么。你去哪儿了。”

paragraphs.en: “Over yonder under them cedars.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “那边有雪松树。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Getting Quentin all riled up.” Dilsey said. “Why cant you keep him away from her. Dont you know she dont like him where she at.”
paragraphs.zh: “把昆丁都激怒了。”迪尔西说道。“为什么你不能让他远离她。你难道不知道她不喜欢他现在的处境吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Got as much time for him as I is.” Luster said. “He aint none of my uncle.”
paragraphs.zh: “和我一样有足够的时间陪伴他。”勒斯特说。“他不是我叔叔。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont you sass me, nigger boy.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “别骂我，黑鬼。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “I aint done nothing to him.” Luster said. “He was playing there, and all of a sudden he started bellering.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有对他做什么。”勒斯特说。“他正在那里玩耍，突然他开始大喊大叫。”

paragraphs.en: “Is you been projecking with his graveyard.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你是不是在用他的墓地进行投影？”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “I aint touched his graveyard.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我没有碰过他的墓地。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Dont lie to me, boy.” Dilsey said. We went up the steps and into the kitchen. Dilsey opened the firedoor and drew a chair up in front of it and I sat down. I hushed.
paragraphs.zh: “别对我撒谎，孩子。”迪尔西说道。我们走上台阶，走进厨房。迪尔西打开防火门，拉了一把椅子到门前，我坐下来。我沉默了。

paragraphs.en: What you want to get her started for, Dilsey said. Whyn’t you keep him out of there.
paragraphs.zh: “你想让她开始做什么，”迪尔西说。你为什么不让他远离那里。

paragraphs.en: He was just looking at the fire, Caddy said. Mother was telling him his new name. We didn’t mean to get her started.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂说，他只是看着火。母亲正在告诉他他的新名字。我们并不是故意让她开始的。

paragraphs.en: I knows you didn’t, Dilsey said. Him at one end of the house and her at the other. You let my things alone, now. Dont you touch nothing till I get back.
paragraphs.zh: 我知道你没有，迪尔西说。他在房子的一端，她在另一端。现在你把我的东西放一边吧。在我回来之前，不要碰任何东西。

paragraphs.en: “Aint you shamed of yourself.” Dilsey said. “Teasing him.” She set the cake on the table.
paragraphs.zh: “你不是为自己感到羞耻吗？”迪尔西说道。“逗他。”她把蛋糕放在桌子上。

paragraphs.en: “I aint been teasing him.” Luster said. “He was playing with that bottle full of dogfennel and all of a sudden he started up bellering. You heard him.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有戏弄他。”勒斯特说。“他正在玩那个装满狗茴香的瓶子，突然他开始大喊大叫。你听到他的声音了。”

paragraphs.en: “You aint done nothing to his flowers.” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你没有对他的花做任何事。”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “I aint touched his graveyard.” Luster said. “What I want with his truck. I was just hunting for that quarter.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有碰过他的墓地。”勒斯特说。“我想要他的卡车。我只是在寻找那枚硬币。”

paragraphs.en: “You lost it, did you.” Dilsey said. She lit the candles on the cake. Some of them were little ones. Some were big ones cut into little pieces. “I told you to go put it away. Now I reckon you want me to get you another one from Frony.”
paragraphs.zh: “你把它弄丢了，是吗？”迪尔西说道。她点燃了蛋糕上的蜡烛。其中一些是小孩子。有些是大块的，切成小块。“我告诉过你把它收起来。现在我想你想让我从弗罗妮那里再给你拿一张。”

paragraphs.en: “I got to go to that show, Benjy or no Benjy.” Luster said. “I aint going to follow him around day and night both.”
paragraphs.zh: “无论班吉与否，我都得去看那个演出。”勒斯特说。“我不会日夜跟着他。”

paragraphs.en: “You going to do just what he want you to, nigger boy.” Dilsey said. “You hear me.”
paragraphs.zh: “你就按照他的要求去做吧，黑鬼男孩。”迪尔西说道。“你听我说。”

paragraphs.en: “Aint I always done it.” Luster said. “Dont I always does what he wants. Dont I, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不是一直都是这么做的吗？”勒斯特说。“我不是总是按照他的意愿行事吗？我不是吗，班吉。”

paragraphs.en: “Then you keep it up.” Dilsey said. “Bringing him in here, bawling and getting her started too. You all go ahead and eat this cake, now, before Jason come. I dont want him jumping on me about a cake I bought with my own money. Me baking a cake here, with him counting every egg that comes into this kitchen. See can you let him alone now, less you dont want to go to that show tonight.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你就继续坚持吧。”迪尔西说道。“把他带过来，大哭大闹，也让她开始。现在，在杰生来之前，你们都吃这个蛋糕。我不想让他因为我用自己的钱买的蛋糕而对我大发雷霆。我在这里烤蛋糕，他数着进入厨房的每个鸡蛋。你看你现在能不能别管他了，免得你今晚不想去看那个节目。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey went away.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西走了。

paragraphs.en: “You cant blow out no candles.” Luster said. “Watch me blow them out.” He leaned down and puffed his face. The candles went away. I began to cry. “Hush.” Luster said. “Here. Look at the fire whiles I cuts this cake.”
paragraphs.zh: “你不能吹灭蜡烛。”勒斯特说。“看我把他们消灭掉。”他弯下腰​​，鼓起了脸。蜡烛消失了。我开始哭泣。“嘘。”勒斯特说。“这里。我切蛋糕的时候看火。”

paragraphs.en: I could hear the clock, and I could hear Caddy standing behind me, and I could hear the roof. It’s still raining, Caddy said. I hate rain. I hate everything. And then her head came into my lap and she was crying, holding me, and I began to cry. Then I looked at the fire again and the bright, smooth shapes went again. I could hear the clock and the roof and Caddy.
paragraphs.zh: 我能听到时钟的声音，我能听到凯蒂站在我身后的声音，我还能听到屋顶的声音。凯蒂说，雨还在下。我讨厌下雨。我讨厌一切。然后她的头靠在我的腿上，她抱着我哭了，我也开始哭。然后我再次看着火，明亮、光滑的形状又消失了。我能听到时钟、屋顶和凯蒂的声音。

paragraphs.en: I ate some cake. Luster’s hand came and took another piece. I could hear him eating. I looked at the fire.
paragraphs.zh: 我吃了一些蛋糕。勒斯特的手伸了过来，又拿走了一块。我能听到他吃东西的声音。我看着火。

paragraphs.en: A long piece of wire came across my shoulder. It went to the door, and then the fire went away. I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 一根长长的金属丝搭在我的肩膀上。它走到门口，然后火就灭了。我开始哭泣。

paragraphs.en: “What you howling for now.” Luster said. “Look there.” The fire was there. I hushed. “Cant you set and look at the fire and be quiet like mammy told you.” Luster said. “You ought to be ashamed of yourself. Here. Here’s you some more cake.”
paragraphs.zh: “你现在嚎叫什么。”勒斯特说。“看那儿。”火就在那里。我沉默了。“你能不能像妈妈告诉你的那样，看着火，保持安静。”勒斯特说。“你应该为自己感到羞耻。给你。这是你的更多蛋糕。”

paragraphs.en: “What you done to him now.” Dilsey said. “Cant you never let him alone.”
paragraphs.zh: “你现在对他做了什么。”迪尔西说道。“你就不能永远让他一个人呆着吗？”

paragraphs.en: “I was just trying to get him to hush up and not sturb Miss Cahline.” Luster said. “Something got him started again.”
paragraphs.zh: “我只是想让他闭嘴，不要打扰卡琳小姐。”勒斯特说。“有些事情让他重新开始了。”

paragraphs.en: “And I know what that something name.” Dilsey said. “I’m going to get Versh to take a stick to you when he comes home. You just trying yourself. You been doing it all day. Did you take him down to the branch.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道那个东西叫什么名字。”迪尔西说道。“弗许回家后我会让他拿棍子打你。你只是在尝试自己。你已经这样做了一整天了。你带他去溪沟了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Nome.” Luster said. “We been right here in this yard all day, like you said.”
paragraphs.zh: “诺姆。”勒斯特说。“就像你说的，我们一整天都在这个院子里。”

paragraphs.en: His hand came for another piece of cake. Dilsey hit his hand. “Reach it again, and I chop it right off with this here butcher knife.” Dilsey said. “I bet he aint had one piece of it.”
paragraphs.zh: 他的手又伸过来拿一块蛋糕。迪尔西击中了他的手。“再伸手，我就用这把屠刀把它砍下来。”迪尔西说道。“我敢打赌他连一块都没有。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes he is.” Luster said. “He already had twice as much as me. Ask him if he aint.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，他是。”勒斯特说。“他已经是我的两倍了。问问他是不是。”

paragraphs.en: “Reach hit one more time.” Dilsey said. “Just reach it.”
paragraphs.zh: “再击中一次。”迪尔西说道。“只要到达就可以了。”

paragraphs.en: That’s right, Dilsey said. I reckon it’ll be my time to cry next. Reckon Maury going to let me cry on him a while, too.
paragraphs.zh: 是的，迪尔西说。我想接下来就是我哭泣的时候了。我想莫里也会让我在他身上哭一会儿。

paragraphs.en: His name’s Benjy now, Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂说，他现在的名字叫班吉。

paragraphs.en: How come it is, Dilsey said. He aint wore out the name he was born with yet, is he.
paragraphs.zh: 怎么会这样，迪尔西说道。他还没有磨损他与生俱来的名字，是吗？

paragraphs.en: Benjamin came out of the bible, Caddy said. It’s a better name for him than Maury was.
paragraphs.zh: 本杰明来自圣经，凯蒂说。这对他来说比“莫里”更好。

paragraphs.en: How come it is, Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: 怎么会这样，迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: Mother says it is, Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 妈妈说是的，凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: Huh, Dilsey said. Name aint going to help him. Hurt him, neither. Folks dont have no luck, changing names. My name been Dilsey since fore I could remember and it be Dilsey when they’s long forgot me.
paragraphs.zh: 嗯，迪尔西说道。名字对他没有帮助。伤害他，也不行。人们没有运气，改变名字。从我记事起，我的名字就叫迪尔西，而当他们早已忘记我时，我的名字就是迪尔西。

paragraphs.en: How will they know it’s Dilsey, when it’s long forgot, Dilsey, Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂说，他们怎么知道这是迪尔西，因为人们早已忘记了迪尔西。

paragraphs.en: It’ll be in the Book, honey, Dilsey said. Writ out.
paragraphs.zh: 亲爱的，这会写在书中，迪尔西说。写出来。

paragraphs.en: Can you read it, Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 你能读一下吗，凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: Wont have to, Dilsey said. They’ll read it for me. All I got to do is say Ise here.
paragraphs.zh: 不必，迪尔西说。他们会读给我听。我所要做的就是在这里说一诚。

paragraphs.en: The long wire came across my shoulder, and the fire went away. I began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 长长的电线越过我的肩膀，火就消失了。我开始哭泣。

paragraphs.en: Dilsey and Luster fought.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西和勒斯特打了起来。

paragraphs.en: “I seen you.” Dilsey said. “Oho, I seen you.” She dragged Luster out of the corner, shaking him. “Wasn’t nothing bothering him, was they. You just wait till your pappy come home. I wish I was young like I use to be, I’d tear them years right off your head. I good mind to lock you up in that cellar and not let you go to that show tonight, I sho is.”
paragraphs.zh: “我看见你了。”迪尔西说道。“哦哦，我看到你了。”她把勒斯特从角落里拖了出来，摇晃着他。“没有什么事情困扰他，是吗？你只要等你爸爸回家就可以了。我希望我像以前一样年轻，我会把你的岁月从你头上撕下来。我很介意把你锁在那个地窖里，不让你今晚去看演出，我肯定是这样。”

paragraphs.en: “Ow, mammy.” Luster said. “Ow, mammy.”
paragraphs.zh: “哎呀，妈妈。”勒斯特说。“哎呀，妈妈。”

paragraphs.en: I put my hand out to where the fire had been.
paragraphs.zh: 我把手伸向着火的地方。

paragraphs.en: “Catch him.” Dilsey said. “Catch him back.”
paragraphs.zh: “抓住他。”迪尔西说道。“把他抓回来。”

paragraphs.en: My hand jerked back and I put it in my mouth and Dilsey caught me. I could still hear the clock between my voice. Dilsey reached back and hit Luster on the head. My voice was going loud every time.
paragraphs.zh: 我的手猛地向后一缩，把它放进嘴里，迪尔西抓住了我。我的声音中仍然能听到时钟的声音。迪尔西向后伸手，击中了勒斯特的头部。每次我的声音都很大。

paragraphs.en: “Get that soda.” Dilsey said. She took my hand out of my mouth. My voice went louder then and my hand tried to go back to my mouth, but Dilsey held it. My voice went loud. She sprinkled soda on my hand.
paragraphs.zh: “拿苏打水来。”迪尔西说道。她把我的手从我嘴里拿开。我的声音更大了，我的手试图回到我的嘴里，但迪尔西握住了它。我的声音很大。她把苏打水洒在我的手上。

paragraphs.en: “Look in the pantry and tear a piece off of that rag hanging on the nail.” she said. “Hush, now. You dont want to make your ma sick again, does you. Here, look at the fire. Dilsey make your hand stop hurting in just a minute. Look at the fire.” She opened the fire door. I looked at the fire, but my hand didn’t stop and I didn’t stop. My hand was trying to go to my mouth but Dilsey held it.
paragraphs.zh: “到食品储藏室里去看看，把挂在钉子上的抹布撕下来一块。”她说。“嘘，现在。你不想让你妈妈又生病了，是吗？来，看看火。迪尔西让你的手在一分钟内不再疼痛。看看火。”她打开了防火门。我看着火，但我的手没有停，我也没有停下。我的手试图伸进嘴里，但迪尔西握住了它。

paragraphs.en: She wrapped the cloth around it. Mother said,
paragraphs.zh: 她用布包裹住它。妈妈说，

paragraphs.en: “What is it now. Cant I even be sick in peace. Do I have to get up out of bed to come down to him, with two grown negroes to take care of him.”
paragraphs.zh: “现在怎么了？我连生病都不能安心吗？我必须从床上起来才能到他身边，还有两个成年黑人来照顾他吗？”

paragraphs.en: “He all right now.” Dilsey said. “He going to quit. He just burnt his hand a little.”
paragraphs.zh: “他现在没事了。”迪尔西说道。“他要放弃了。他只是把手烫伤了一点。”

paragraphs.en: “With two grown negroes, you must bring him into the house, bawling.” Mother said. “You got him started on purpose, because you know I’m sick.” She came and stood by me. “Hush.” she said. “Right this minute. Did you give him this cake.”
paragraphs.zh: “有两个成年黑人，你必须把他带进屋，一边哭一边喊。”妈妈说。“你故意让他开始的，因为你知道我病了。”她走过来站在我身边。“嘘。”她说。“就在这一刻。你给他这个蛋糕了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “I bought it.” Dilsey said. “It never come out of Jason’s pantry. I fixed him some birthday.”
paragraphs.zh: “我买了。”迪尔西说道。“它从来没有从杰生的储藏室里出来过。我给他安排了一个生日。”

paragraphs.en: “Do you want to poison him with that cheap store cake.” Mother said. “Is that what you are trying to do. Am I never to have one minute’s peace.”
paragraphs.zh: “你想用商店里那块便宜的蛋糕毒死他吗？”妈妈说。“这就是你想做的事吗？难道我就永远得不到一分钟的平静吗？”

paragraphs.en: “You go on back up stairs and lay down.” Dilsey said. “It’ll quit smarting him in a minute now, and he’ll hush. Come on, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “你回到楼梯上躺下。”迪尔西说道。“一分钟后他就会不再感到刺痛了，他就会安静下来。来吧，现在。”

paragraphs.en: “And leave him down here for you all to do something else to.” Mother said. “How can I lie there, with him bawling down here. Benjamin. Hush this minute.”
paragraphs.zh: “把他留在这里，让你们去做别的事。”妈妈说。“我怎么能躺在那里，而他却在这儿嚎啕大哭。本杰明。安静一下。”

paragraphs.en: “They aint nowhere else to take him.” Dilsey said. “We aint got the room we use to have. He cant stay out in the yard, crying where all the neighbors can see him.”
paragraphs.zh: “他们没有其他地方可以带他去。”迪尔西说道。“我们没有得到以前的房间了。他不能呆在院子里，在所有邻居都能看到他的地方哭泣。”

paragraphs.en: “I know, I know.” Mother said. “It’s all my fault. I’ll be gone soon, and you and Jason will both get along better.” She began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: “我知道，我知道。”妈妈说。“都是我的错，我很快就会走了，你和杰生都会相处得更好。”她开始哭泣。

paragraphs.en: “You hush that, now.” Dilsey said. “You’ll get yourself down again. You come on back up stairs. Luster going to take him to the liberry and play with him till I get his supper done.”
paragraphs.zh: “你现在别再说了。”迪尔西说道。“你会再下来。你回到楼梯上来。勒斯特要带他去图书馆和他一起玩，直到我把他的晚饭吃完。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey and Mother went out.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西和母亲出去了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush up.” Luster said. “You hush up. You want me to burn your other hand for you. You aint hurt. Hush up.”
paragraphs.zh: “安静点。”勒斯特说。“你安静点。你想让我为你烧掉你的另一只手。你没有受伤。安静点。”

paragraphs.en: “Here.” Dilsey said. “Stop crying, now.” She gave me the slipper, and I hushed. “Take him to the liberry.” she said. “And if I hear him again, I going to whip you myself.”
paragraphs.zh: “这里。”迪尔西说道。“现在别哭了。”她把拖鞋递给我，我就安静了。“带他去自由城。”她说。“如果我再听到他的声音，我就会亲手鞭打你。”

paragraphs.en: We went to the library. Luster turned on the light. The windows went black, and the dark tall place on the wall came and I went and touched it. It was like a door, only it wasn’t a door.
paragraphs.zh: 我们去了图书馆。勒斯特打开灯。窗户变黑了，墙上那个黑暗的高处出现了，我走过去摸了摸它。它就像一扇门，但它不是门。

paragraphs.en: The fire came behind me and I went to the fire and sat on the floor, holding the slipper. The fire went higher. It went onto the cushion in Mother’s chair.
paragraphs.zh: 火从我身后升起，我走到火边，拿着拖鞋坐在地板上。火烧得更高了。它落在母亲椅子的垫子上。

paragraphs.en: “Hush up.” Luster said. “Cant you never get done for a while. Here I done built you a fire, and you wont even look at it.”
paragraphs.zh: “安静点。”勒斯特说。“你就不能一时半会儿干不完的事吗？我给你生了一堆火，你连看都不看一眼。”

paragraphs.en: Your name is Benjy. Caddy said. Do you hear. Benjy. Benjy.
paragraphs.zh: 你的名字是班吉。凯蒂说。你听到了吗。班吉。班吉。

paragraphs.en: Dont tell him that, Mother said. Bring him here.
paragraphs.zh: 别告诉他这个，妈妈说。带他来这里。

paragraphs.en: Caddy lifted me under the arms.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂把我抱在腋下。

paragraphs.en: Get up, Mau—I mean Benjy, she said.
paragraphs.zh: 起来，毛——我是说班吉，她说。

paragraphs.en: Dont try to carry him, Mother said. Cant you lead him over here. Is that too much for you to think of.
paragraphs.zh: 别试图抱他，妈妈说。你不能带他到这里来吗？这对你来说是不是太多了？

paragraphs.en: I can carry him, Caddy said. “Let me carry him up, Dilsey.”
paragraphs.zh: “我可以抱他，”凯蒂说。“让我把他抱上去吧，迪尔西。”

paragraphs.en: “Go on, Minute.” Dilsey said. “You aint big enough to tote a flea. You go on and be quiet, like Mr. Jason said.”
paragraphs.zh: “继续吧，分钟。”迪尔西说道。“你的体型还不足以携带一只跳蚤。你继续保持安静，就像杰生先生说的那样。”

paragraphs.en: There was a light at the top of the stairs. Father was there, in his shirt sleeves. The way he looked said Hush. Caddy whispered,
paragraphs.zh: 楼梯顶上有一盏灯。父亲就在那里，穿着衬衫。从他的表情来看，别出声。凯蒂小声说道，

paragraphs.en: “Is Mother sick.”
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈生病了吗？”

paragraphs.en: Versh set me down and we went into Mother’s room. There was a fire. It was rising and falling on the walls. There was another fire in the mirror. I could smell the sickness. It was a cloth folded on Mother’s head. Her hair was on the pillow. The fire didn’t reach it, but it shone on her hand, where her rings were jumping.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许把我放下，我们走进母亲的房间。发生了火灾。它在墙上升起又落下。镜子里又燃起了一团火。我能闻到那股恶心的味道。那是一块布，叠在母亲的头上。她的头发落在枕头上。火焰没有烧到它，但它照到了她的手上，她的戒指在跳动。

paragraphs.en: “Come and tell Mother goodnight.” Caddy said. We went to the bed. The fire went out of the mirror. Father got up from the bed and lifted me up and Mother put her hand on my head.
paragraphs.zh: “过来跟妈妈说晚安。”凯蒂说。我们走到床边。火从镜子里熄灭了。父亲从床上起来，把我抱起来，母亲把手放在我的头上。

paragraphs.en: “What time is it.” Mother said. Her eyes were closed.
paragraphs.zh: “现在几点了。”妈妈说。她的眼睛闭着。

paragraphs.en: “Ten minutes to seven.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “差十分钟就七点了。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “It’s too early for him to go to bed.” Mother said. “He’ll wake up at daybreak, and I simply cannot bear another day like today.”
paragraphs.zh: “他睡觉还太早了。”妈妈说。“他会在天亮时醒来，我实在无法忍受再有像今天这样的一天。”

paragraphs.en: “There, there.” Father said. He touched Mother’s face.
paragraphs.zh: “那里，那里。”父亲说。他摸了摸妈妈的脸。

paragraphs.en: “I know I’m nothing but a burden to you.” Mother said. “But I’ll be gone soon. Then you will be rid of my bothering.”
paragraphs.zh: “我知道我对你来说只是一个负担。”妈妈说。“不过我很快就会走了，这样你就可以摆脱我的困扰了。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Father said. “I’ll take him downstairs awhile.” He took me up. “Come on, old fellow. Let’s go downstairs awhile. We’ll have to be quiet while Quentin is studying, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”父亲说。“我一会儿送他下楼去。”他把我抱起来。“走吧，老家伙，我们下楼去一会儿吧，昆丁读书的时候我们得安静点。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy went and leaned her face over the bed and Mother’s hand came into the firelight. Her rings jumped on Caddy’s back.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂走过去，把脸靠在床上，母亲的手伸进了火光里。她的戒指跳到了凯蒂的背上。

paragraphs.en: Mother’s sick, Father said. Dilsey will put you to bed. Where’s Quentin.
paragraphs.zh: 母亲病了，父亲说。迪尔西会让你上床睡觉。昆丁在哪里。

paragraphs.en: Versh getting him, Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许抓住了他，迪尔西说。

paragraphs.en: Father stood and watched us go past. We could hear Mother in her room. Caddy said “Hush.” Jason was still climbing the stairs. He had his hands in his pockets.
paragraphs.zh: 父亲站着看着我们过去。我们可以听到母亲在她房间里的声音。凯蒂说：“嘘。”杰生还在爬楼梯。他双手插在口袋里。

paragraphs.en: “You all must be good tonight.” Father said. “And be quiet, so you wont disturb Mother.”
paragraphs.zh: “今晚你们一定要好好表现。”父亲说。“小点声，免得打扰妈妈。”

paragraphs.en: “We’ll be quiet.” Caddy said. “You must be quiet now, Jason.” she said. We tiptoed.
paragraphs.zh: “我们会安静的。”凯蒂说。“杰生，你现在必须安静了。”她说。我们踮起脚尖。

paragraphs.en: We could hear the roof. I could see the fire in the mirror too. Caddy lifted me again.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以听到屋顶的声音。我也能在镜子里看到火焰。凯蒂再次举起我。

paragraphs.en: “Come on, now.” she said. “Then you can come back to the fire. Hush, now.”
paragraphs.zh: “来吧，现在。”她说。“然后你就可以回到火边了。安静，现在。”

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Benjy.” Caddy said. “Mother wants you a minute. Like a good boy. Then you can come back. Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”凯蒂说。“妈妈要你等一下。像个好孩子一样。然后你就可以回来了。班吉。”

paragraphs.en: Caddy let me down, and I hushed.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂让我失望了，我沉默了。

paragraphs.en: “Let him stay here, Mother. When he’s through looking at the fire, then you can tell him.”
paragraphs.zh: “让他留在这里，妈妈。等他看完火，你就可以告诉他了。”

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Mother said. Caddy stooped and lifted me. We staggered. “Candace.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”妈妈说。凯蒂弯下腰抱起我。我们摇摇晃晃。“坎迪斯。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Caddy said. “You can still see it. Hush.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”凯蒂说。“你还是能看到它。嘘。”

paragraphs.en: “Bring him here.” Mother said. “He’s too big for you to carry. You must stop trying. You’ll injure your back. All of our women have prided themselves on their carriage. Do you want to look like a washer-woman.”
paragraphs.zh: “把他带到这里来。”妈妈说。“他太大了，你搬不动。你必须停止尝试。你会伤到你的背。我们所有的女人都以自己的马车为荣。你想看起来像个洗衣妇吗？”

paragraphs.en: “He’s not too heavy.” Caddy said. “I can carry him.”
paragraphs.zh: “他不太重。”凯蒂说。“我可以抱着他。”

paragraphs.en: “Well, I dont want him carried, then.” Mother said. “A five year old child. No, no. Not in my lap. Let him stand up.”
paragraphs.zh: “好吧，那我不想把他抱起来。”妈妈说。“一个五岁的孩子。不，不。不在我腿上。让他站起来。”

paragraphs.en: “If you’ll hold him, he’ll stop.” Caddy said. “Hush.” she said. “You can go right back. Here. Here’s your cushion. See.”
paragraphs.zh: “如果你抓住他，他就会停下来。”凯蒂说。“嘘。”她说。“你可以回去了。这里。这是你的坐垫。看。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont, Candace.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “别这样，坎迪斯。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Let him look at it and he’ll be quiet.” Caddy said. “Hold up just a minute while I slip it out. There, Benjy. Look.”
paragraphs.zh: “让他看看，他就会安静下来。”凯蒂说。“等一下，我把它拿出来。那里，班吉。看。”

paragraphs.en: I looked at it and hushed.
paragraphs.zh: 我看着它，沉默了。

paragraphs.en: “You humour him too much.” Mother said. “You and your father both. You dont realise that I am the one who has to pay for it. Damuddy spoiled Jason that way and it took him two years to outgrow it, and I am not strong enough to go through the same thing with Benjamin.”
paragraphs.zh: “你太迁就他了。”妈妈说。“你和你父亲，你们都不知道，我才是要为此付出代价的人。外婆那样惯坏了杰生，他花了两年的时间才摆脱了它，而我还没有强大到可以和本杰明经历同样的事情。”

paragraphs.en: “You dont need to bother with him.” Caddy said. “I like to take care of him. Dont I, Benjy.”
paragraphs.zh: “你不用理他。”凯蒂说。“我喜欢照顾他。不是吗，班吉。”

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Mother said. “I told you not to call him that. It was bad enough when your father insisted on calling you by that silly nickname, and I will not have him called by one. Nicknames are vulgar. Only common people use them. Benjamin.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”妈妈说。“我告诉过你不要这么叫他，你父亲非要叫你这个傻绰号就已经够糟糕的了，我不会再叫他了。绰号很粗俗，只有老百姓才用。本杰明。”她说。

paragraphs.en: “Look at me.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “看着我。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Benjamin.” she said. She took my face in her hands and turned it to hers.
paragraphs.zh: “本杰明。”她说。她双手捧住我的脸，然后把它转向她的脸。

paragraphs.en: “Benjamin.” she said. “Take that cushion away, Candace.”
paragraphs.zh: “本杰明。”她说。“坎迪斯，把那个垫子拿开。”

paragraphs.en: “He’ll cry.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “他会哭的。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “Take that cushion away, like I told you.” Mother said. “He must learn to mind.”
paragraphs.zh: “把那个垫子拿开，就像我告诉你的那样。”妈妈说。“他必须学会介意。”

paragraphs.en: The cushion went away.
paragraphs.zh: 坐垫消失了。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Benjy.” Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，班吉。”凯蒂说。

paragraphs.en: “You go over there and sit down.” Mother said. “Benjamin.” She held my face to hers.
paragraphs.zh: “你去那边坐下吧。”妈妈说。“本杰明。”她把我的脸贴在她的脸上。

paragraphs.en: “Stop that.” she said. “Stop it.”
paragraphs.zh: “别这样了。”她说。“别说了。”

paragraphs.en: But I didn’t stop and Mother caught me in her arms and began to cry, and I cried. Then the cushion came back and Caddy held it above Mother’s head. She drew Mother back in the chair and Mother lay crying against the red and yellow cushion.
paragraphs.zh: 但我没有停下来，妈妈把我抱在怀里哭起来，我也哭了。然后垫子又回来了，凯蒂把它举过母亲的头顶。她把母亲拉回椅子上，母亲躺在红黄相间的垫子上哭泣。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Mother.” Caddy said. “You go upstairs and lay down, so you can be sick. I’ll go get Dilsey.” She led me to the fire and I looked at the bright, smooth shapes. I could hear the fire and the roof.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，妈妈。”凯蒂说。“你上楼躺下，免得生病。我去叫迪尔西。”她把我带到火边，我看着那些明亮、光滑的形状。我能听到火声和屋顶的声音。

paragraphs.en: Father took me up. He smelled like rain.
paragraphs.zh: 父亲把我抱了起来。他闻起来像雨的味道。

paragraphs.en: “Well, Benjy.” he said. “Have you been a good boy today.”
paragraphs.zh: “嗯，班吉。”他说。“你今天是个好孩子吗？”

paragraphs.en: Caddy and Jason were fighting in the mirror.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂和杰生在镜子里打架。

paragraphs.en: “You, Caddy.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “你，凯蒂。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: They fought. Jason began to cry.
paragraphs.zh: 他们打架了。杰生哭了。

paragraphs.en: “Caddy.” Father said. Jason was crying. He wasn’t fighting anymore but we could see Caddy fighting in the mirror and Father put me down and went into the mirror and fought too. He lifted Caddy up. She fought. Jason lay on the floor, crying. He had the scissors in his hand. Father held Caddy.
paragraphs.zh: “凯蒂。”父亲说。杰生哭了。他不再打架了，但我们可以看到凯蒂在镜子里打架，父亲把我放下，走进镜子里也打架。他把凯蒂举了起来。她战斗了。杰生趴在地上哭。他手里拿着剪刀。父亲抱着凯蒂。

paragraphs.en: “He cut up all Benjy’s dolls.” Caddy said. “I’ll slit his gizzle.”
paragraphs.zh: “他把班吉的玩偶都切碎了。”凯蒂说。“我要切开他的喉咙。”

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “I will.” Caddy said. “I will.” She fought. Father held her. She kicked at Jason. He rolled into the corner, out of the mirror. Father brought Caddy to the fire. They were all out of the mirror. Only the fire was in it. Like the fire was in a door.
paragraphs.zh: “我会的。”凯蒂说。“我会。”她战斗了。父亲抱着她。她踢了杰生一脚。他滚到角落里，出了镜子。父亲把凯蒂带到了火边。他们都走出了镜子。只有火在里面。就像火在门里一样。

paragraphs.en: “Stop that.” Father said. “Do you want to make Mother sick in her room.”
paragraphs.zh: “别这样了。”父亲说。“你想让妈妈在她的房间里生病吗？”

paragraphs.en: Caddy stopped. “He cut up all the dolls Mau—Benjy and I made.” Caddy said. “He did it just for meanness.”
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂停了下来。“他把我和毛班吉制作的所有玩偶都切碎了。”凯蒂说。“他这么做只是为了卑鄙。”

paragraphs.en: “I didn’t.” Jason said. He was sitting up, crying. “I didn’t know they were his. I just thought they were some old papers.”
paragraphs.zh: “我没有。”杰生说道。他坐起来，哭了。“我不知道它们是他的。我只是以为它们是一些旧报纸。”

paragraphs.en: “You couldn’t help but know.” Caddy said. “You did it just.”
paragraphs.zh: “你无法不知道。”凯蒂说。“你刚刚做到了。”

paragraphs.en: “Hush.” Father said. “Jason.” he said.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘。”父亲说。“杰生。”他说。

paragraphs.en: “I’ll make you some more tomorrow.” Caddy said. “We’ll make a lot of them. Here, you can look at the cushion, too.”
paragraphs.zh: “明天我再给你做一些。”凯蒂说。“我们会做很多。在这里，你也可以看看垫子。”

paragraphs.en: Jason came in.
paragraphs.zh: 杰生进来了。

paragraphs.en: I kept telling you to hush, Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我一直告诉你要安静，”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: What’s the matter now, Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “现在怎么了？”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “He just trying hisself.” Luster said. “That the way he been going on all day.”
paragraphs.zh: “他只是在尝试自己。”勒斯特说。“他一整天都是这样的。”

paragraphs.en: “Why dont you let him alone, then.” Jason said. “If you cant keep him quiet, you’ll have to take him out to the kitchen. The rest of us cant shut ourselves up in a room like Mother does.”
paragraphs.zh: “那你为什么不放过他呢。”杰生说道。“如果你不能让他安静，你就得带他去厨房。我们其他人不能像母亲那样把自己关在房间里。”

paragraphs.en: “Mammy say keep him out the kitchen till she get supper.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “妈妈说，在她吃晚饭之前，别让他进厨房。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Then play with him and keep him quiet.” Jason said. “Do I have to work all day and then come home to a mad house.” He opened the paper and read it.
paragraphs.zh: “那就陪他玩，让他安静。”杰生说道。“我必须工作一整天，然后回到一个疯人院吗？”他打开报纸阅读起来。

paragraphs.en: You can look at the fire and the mirror and the cushion too, Caddy said. You wont have to wait until supper to look at the cushion, now. We could hear the roof. We could hear Jason too, crying loud beyond the wall.
paragraphs.zh: “你也可以看看火、镜子和垫子，”凯蒂说。现在，您不必等到晚餐才能查看垫子。我们可以听到屋顶的声音。我们也能听到杰生在墙外大声哭泣。

paragraphs.en: Dilsey said, “You come, Jason. You letting him alone, is you.”
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西说道：“杰生，你来吧，你放任他不管，是你。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Where Quentin.” Dilsey said. “Supper near bout ready.”
paragraphs.zh: “昆丁在哪里。”迪尔西说道。“晚饭快准备好了。”

paragraphs.en: “I dont know’m.” Luster said. “I aint seen her.”
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道。”勒斯特说。“我没见过她。”

paragraphs.en: Dilsey went away. “Quentin.” she said in the hall. “Quentin. Supper ready.”
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西走了。“昆丁。”她在大厅里说道。“昆丁，晚饭准备好了。”

paragraphs.en: We could hear the roof. Quentin smelled like rain, too.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以听到屋顶的声音。昆丁也有雨的味道。

paragraphs.en: What did Jason do, he said.
paragraphs.zh: 杰生做了什么，他说。

paragraphs.en: He cut up all Benjy’s dolls, Caddy said.
paragraphs.zh: 凯蒂说，他把班吉的所有玩偶都切碎了。

paragraphs.en: Mother said to not call him Benjy, Quentin said. He sat on the rug by us. I wish it wouldn’t rain, he said. You cant do anything.
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁说，妈妈说不要叫他班吉。他坐在我们旁边的地毯上。我希望不要下雨，他说。你什么也做不了。

paragraphs.en: You’ve been in a fight, Caddy said. Haven’t you.
paragraphs.zh: 你们一直在打架，凯蒂说。你没有吗。

paragraphs.en: It wasn’t much, Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁说，这并不多。

paragraphs.en: You can tell it, Caddy said. Father’ll see it.
paragraphs.zh: 你可以说出来，凯蒂说。父亲会看到的。

paragraphs.en: I dont care, Quentin said. I wish it wouldn’t rain.
paragraphs.zh: “我不在乎，”昆丁说。我希望不要下雨。

paragraphs.en: Quentin said, “Didn’t Dilsey say supper was ready.”
paragraphs.zh: 昆丁道：“迪尔西不是说晚饭已经做好了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum.” Luster said. Jason looked at Quentin. Then he read the paper again. Quentin came in. “She say it bout ready.” Luster said. Quentin jumped down in Mother’s chair. Luster said,
paragraphs.zh: “是的。”勒斯特说。杰生看着昆丁。然后他又读了一遍报纸。昆丁进来了。“她说已经准备好了。”勒斯特说。昆丁跳到母亲的椅子上。勒斯特说，

paragraphs.en: “Mr Jason.”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生先生。”

paragraphs.en: “What.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “什么。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “Let me have two bits.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “给我两块吧。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “What for.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “干什么。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “To go to the show tonight.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “今晚去看演出。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “I thought Dilsey was going to get a quarter from Frony for you.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我以为迪尔西会从弗罗妮那里得到二十五美分硬币给你。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “She did.” Luster said. “I lost it. Me and Benjy hunted all day for that quarter. You can ask him.”
paragraphs.zh: “她做到了。”勒斯特说。“我把它弄丢了。我和班吉整天都在寻找那个硬币。你可以问他。”

paragraphs.en: “Then borrow one from him.” Jason said. “I have to work for mine.” He read the paper. Quentin looked at the fire. The fire was in her eyes and on her mouth. Her mouth was red.
paragraphs.zh: “那就向他借一个吧。”杰生说道。“我必须为我自己工作。”他读了报纸。昆丁看着火。她的眼睛里、嘴里都燃烧着火焰。她的嘴红了。

paragraphs.en: “I tried to keep him away from there.” Luster said.
paragraphs.zh: “我试图让他远离那里。”勒斯特说。

paragraphs.en: “Shut your mouth.” Quentin said. Jason looked at her.
paragraphs.zh: “闭嘴。”昆丁说道。杰生看着她。

paragraphs.en: “What did I tell you I was going to do if I saw you with that show fellow again.” he said. Quentin looked at the fire. “Did you hear me.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “我告诉过你，如果我再次看到你和那个表演者在一起，我会怎么做。”他说。昆丁看着火。“你听到我说话了吗？”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “I heard you.” Quentin said. “Why dont you do it, then.”
paragraphs.zh: “我听到了。”昆丁说道。“那你为什么不这么做呢。”

paragraphs.en: “Dont you worry.” Jason said.
paragraphs.zh: “别担心。”杰生说道。

paragraphs.en: “I’m not.” Quentin said. Jason read the paper again.
paragraphs.zh: “我不是。”昆丁说道。杰生又看了一遍报纸。

paragraphs.en: I could hear the roof. Father leaned forward and looked at Quentin.
paragraphs.zh: 我能听到屋顶的声音。父亲倾身向前，看着昆丁。

paragraphs.en: Hello, he said. Who won.
paragraphs.zh: 你好，他说。谁赢了。

paragraphs.en: “Nobody.” Quentin said. “They stopped us. Teachers.”
paragraphs.zh: “没人。”昆丁说道。“他们阻止了我们。老师们。”

paragraphs.en: “Who was it.” Father said. “Will you tell.”
paragraphs.zh: “是谁啊。”父亲说。“你愿意告诉吗？”

paragraphs.en: “It was all right.” Quentin said. “He was as big as me.”
paragraphs.zh: “没问题。”昆丁说道。“他和我一样大。”

paragraphs.en: “That’s good.” Father said. “Can you tell what it was about.”
paragraphs.zh: “那就好。”父亲说。“你能告诉我那是关于什么的吗？”

paragraphs.en: “It wasn’t anything.” Quentin said. “He said he would put a frog in her desk and she wouldn’t dare to whip him.”
paragraphs.zh: “没什么。”昆丁说道。“他说他会在她的桌子上放一只青蛙，她就不敢鞭打他。”

paragraphs.en: “Oh.” Father said. “She. And then what.”
paragraphs.zh: “哦。”父亲说。“她。然后呢。”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, sir.” Quentin said. “And then I kind of hit him.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生。”昆丁说道。“然后我就打了他。”

paragraphs.en: We could hear the roof and the fire, and a snuffling outside the door.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以听到屋顶和火的声音，以及门外的抽气声。

paragraphs.en: “Where was he going to get a frog in November.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “十一月份他去哪里买青蛙呢？”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “I dont know, sir.” Quentin said.
paragraphs.zh: “我不知道，先生。”昆丁说道。

paragraphs.en: We could hear them.
paragraphs.zh: 我们能听到他们的声音。

paragraphs.en: “Jason.” Father said. We could hear Jason.
paragraphs.zh: “杰生。”父亲说。我们可以听到杰生的声音。

paragraphs.en: “Jason.” Father said. “Come in here and stop that.”
paragraphs.zh: “杰生。”父亲说。“进来吧，阻止这一切。”

paragraphs.en: We could hear the roof and the fire and Jason.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以听到屋顶的声音、火的声音和杰生的声音。

paragraphs.en: “Stop that, now.” Father said. “Do you want me to whip you again.” Father lifted Jason up into the chair by him. Jason snuffled. We could hear the fire and the roof. Jason snuffled a little louder.
paragraphs.zh: “别这样了，现在。”父亲说。“你还想让我再鞭打你吗？”父亲把杰生扶到他身边的椅子上。杰生吸了吸鼻子。我们可以听到火声和屋顶的声音。杰生吸鼻子的声音更大了一些。

paragraphs.en: “One more time.” Father said. We could hear the fire and the roof.
paragraphs.zh: “再来一次。”父亲说。我们可以听到火声和屋顶的声音。

paragraphs.en: Dilsey said, All right. You all can come on to supper.
paragraphs.zh: 迪尔西说，好吧。大家可以过来吃晚饭了。

paragraphs.en: Versh smelled like rain. He smelled like a dog, too. We could hear the fire and the roof.
paragraphs.zh: 弗许闻起来像雨。他也闻起来像狗。我们可以听到火声和屋顶的声音。

paragraphs.en: We could hear Caddy walking fast. Father and Mother looked at the door. Caddy passed it, walking fast, She didn’t look. She walked fast.
paragraphs.zh: 我们可以听到凯蒂快步走着。爸爸和妈妈看着门口。凯蒂快步走过，她没有看。她走得很快。

paragraphs.en: “Candace.” Mother said. Caddy stopped walking.
paragraphs.zh: “坎迪斯。”妈妈说。凯蒂停下脚步。

paragraphs.en: “Yes, Mother.” she said.
paragraphs.zh: “是的，妈妈。”她说。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Caroline.” Father said.
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，卡罗琳。”父亲说。

paragraphs.en: “Come here.” Mother said.
paragraphs.zh: “过来。”妈妈说。

paragraphs.en: “Hush, Caroline.” Father said. “Let her alone.”
paragraphs.zh: “嘘，卡罗琳。”父亲说。“让她一个人静一静吧。”
