paragraphs.en: “Never you mind about dat,” Dilsey said. “Queenie know mo bout whar she gwine dan you does. All you got to do is set dar en hold dem reins. You knows de way, now?”
paragraphs.zh: “别介意这些，”迪尔西说。“奎妮知道她和你做什么。你所要做的就是设置好并握住他们的缰绳。你现在知道路了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum. Same way T. P. goes ev’y Sunday.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，蒂·皮每个星期天都这样。”

paragraphs.en: “Den you do de same thing dis Sunday.”
paragraphs.zh: “周日你也会做同样的事情。”

paragraphs.en: “Cose I is. Aint I drove fer T. P. mo’n a hund’ed times?”
paragraphs.zh: “因为我是。我不是开车去蒂·皮莫恩一百次了吗？”

paragraphs.en: “Den do hit again,” Dilsey said. “G’awn, now. En ef you hurts Benjy, nigger boy, I dont know whut I do. You bound fer de chain gang, but I’ll send you dar fo even chain gang ready fer you.”
paragraphs.zh: “巢穴确实再次袭击了，”迪尔西说。“戈恩，现在。如果你伤害了班吉，黑鬼男孩，我不知道我该怎么办。你束缚了铁链帮，但我会派给你，甚至连铁链帮都准备好了。”

paragraphs.en: “Yessum,” Luster said. “Hum up, Queenie.”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，”勒斯特说。“哼，奎妮。”

paragraphs.en: He flapped the lines on Queenie’s broad back and the surrey lurched into motion.
paragraphs.zh: 他拍打奎妮宽阔的背上的绳子，萨里船猛地开始移动。

paragraphs.en: “You, Luster!” Dilsey said.
paragraphs.zh: “你，勒斯特！”迪尔西说道。

paragraphs.en: “Hum up, dar!” Luster said. He flapped the lines again. With subterranean rumblings Queenie jogged slowly down the drive and turned into the street, where Luster exhorted her into a gait resembling a prolonged and suspended fall in a forward direction.
paragraphs.zh: “哼，亲爱的！”勒斯特说。他又拍打着绳子。伴随着地下的隆隆声，奎妮慢慢地沿着车道慢跑，拐进街道，勒斯特劝告她采取一种类似长时间悬吊的向前跌倒的步态。

paragraphs.en: Ben quit whimpering. He sat in the middle of the seat, holding the repaired flower upright in his fist, his eyes serene and ineffable. Directly before him Luster’s bullet head turned backward continually until the house passed from view, then he pulled to the side of the street and while Ben watched him he descended and broke a switch from a hedge. Queenie lowered her head and fell to cropping the grass until Luster mounted and hauled her head up and harried her into motion again, then he squared his elbows and with the switch and the reins held high he assumed a swaggering attitude out of all proportion to the sedate clopping of Queenie’s hooves and the organlike basso of her internal accompaniment. Motors passed them, and pedestrians; once a group of half grown negroes:
paragraphs.zh: 本停止了呜咽。他坐在座位正中，手中握着那朵修好的花，目光平静，不可言喻。就在他面前，勒斯特的子弹头不断向后转动，直到房子从视野中消失，然后他把车开到街边，当本看着他时，他下降并折断了树篱上的一根开关。奎妮低下头，倒地割草，直到勒斯特骑上马，把她的头抬起来，催促她再次行动起来，然后他摆好手肘，把开关和缰绳举得高高的，他摆出一种大摇大摆的态度，与奎妮平静的马蹄声和她内部伴奏的管风琴般的低音完全不成比例。汽车从他们身边经过，还有行人；曾经有一群半成年的黑人：

paragraphs.en: “Dar Luster. Whar you gwine, Luster? To de boneyard?”
paragraphs.zh: “达勒斯特。勒斯特，你去哪儿？去墓地？”

paragraphs.en: “Hi,” Luster said, “Aint de same boneyard y’all headed fer. Hum up, elefump.”
paragraphs.zh: “嗨，”勒斯特说，“你们不是去同一个墓地。哼，小家伙。”

paragraphs.en: They approached the square, where the Confederate soldier gazed with empty eyes beneath his marble hand into wind and weather. Luster took still another notch in himself and gave the impervious Queenie a cut with the switch, casting his glance about the square. “Dar Mr Jason’s car,” he said then he spied another group of negroes. “Les show dem niggers how quality does, Benjy,” he said, “Whut you say?” He looked back. Ben sat, holding the flower in his fist, his gaze empty and untroubled. Luster hit Queenie again and swung her to the left at the monument.
paragraphs.zh: 他们走近广场，南军士兵在他大理石般的手掌下用空洞的眼睛凝视着风和天气。勒斯特又向自己进了一步，用开关切了一下不为所动的奎妮，同时扫视了广场。“杰生先生的车。”他说道，然后他发现了另一群黑人。“班吉，让黑人看看质量如何，”他说，“你说什么？”他回头看了一眼。本坐在那里，手里握着花，眼神空洞而平静。勒斯特再次击中了奎妮，并将她甩向纪念碑左侧。

paragraphs.en: For an instant Ben sat in an utter hiatus. Then he bellowed. Bellow on bellow, his voice mounted, with scarce interval for breath. There was more than astonishment in it, it was horror; shock; agony eyeless, tongueless; just sound, and Luster’s eyes backrolling for a white instant. “Gret God,” he said, “Hush! Hush! Gret God!” He whirled again and struck Queenie with the switch. It broke and he cast it away and with Ben’s voice mounting toward its unbelievable crescendo Luster caught up the end of the reins and leaned forward as Jason came jumping across the square and onto the step.
paragraphs.zh: 有一瞬间，本完全陷入了沉默。然后他怒吼道。他吼叫着，声音越来越大，几乎没有喘息的时间。里面不仅有惊讶，还有恐惧。震惊;痛苦无眼无舌；只听一声响动，勒斯特的双眼瞬间翻白。“上帝啊，”他说，“嘘！嘘！上帝啊！”他再次旋转，用开关击中了奎妮。它断了，他把它扔掉，随着本的声音越来越强，勒斯特抓住了缰绳的末端，向前倾身，杰生跳过广场，跳上台阶。

paragraphs.en: With a backhanded blow he hurled Luster aside and caught the reins and sawed Queenie about and doubled the reins back and slashed her across the hips. He cut her again and again, into a plunging gallop, while Ben’s hoarse agony roared about them, and swung her about to the right of the monument. Then he struck Luster over the head with his fist.
paragraphs.zh: 他反手一击，把勒斯特扔到一边，抓住缰绳，把奎妮锯开，然后把缰绳折回来，从她的臀部划过去。他一次又一次地刺伤她，让她猛冲过去，而本嘶哑的痛苦在他们周围咆哮，把她甩到了纪念碑的右边。然后他用拳头击打勒斯特的头部。

paragraphs.en: “Dont you know any better than to take him to the left?” he said. He reached back and struck Ben, breaking the flower stalk again. “Shut up!” he said, “Shut up!” He jerked Queenie back and jumped down. “Get to hell on home with him. If you ever cross that gate with him again, I’ll kill you!”
paragraphs.zh: “你难道不知道把他带到左边更好吗？”他说。他向后伸手打了本，再次折断了花茎。“住口！”他说：“闭嘴！”他猛地把奎妮拉了回来，跳了下去。“和他一起滚回家吧。如果你再和他一起跨过那扇门，我就杀了你！”

paragraphs.en: “Yes, suh!” Luster said. He took the reins and hit Queenie with the end of them. “Git up! Git up, dar! Benjy, fer God’s sake!”
paragraphs.zh: “是的，先生！”勒斯特说。他接过缰绳，用缰绳末端击中了奎妮。“站起来！站起来，亲爱的！班吉，看在上帝份上！”

paragraphs.en: Ben’s voice roared and roared. Queenie moved again, her feet began to clop-clop steadily again, and at once Ben hushed. Luster looked quickly back over his shoulder, then he drove on. The broken flower drooped over Ben’s fist and his eyes were empty and blue and serene again as cornice and façade flowed smoothly once more from left to right; post and tree, window and doorway, and signboard, each in its ordered place.
paragraphs.zh: 班吉的声音一声接一声地吼叫。奎妮又动了，蹄子重新发出稳定的得得声，班吉立刻安静下来。勒斯特迅速扭头朝肩后看了一眼，又赶着车往前走。折断的花垂在班吉的拳头上，他的蓝眼睛又空空的，又安详了；屋檐和门面再次从左到右平稳地流过，柱子和树，窗户和门口，还有招牌，一一各在它应在的位置。
